title: 自我介绍
documentTitle: 土家族传统故事: 说话者介绍

sections.description: 这是田荆贵先生的自我介绍，是他预先准备好的文本，在手稿中他使用了汉字来代表土家语词汇的发音。
sections.meta:
龙山县靛房镇田荆贵先生
记录日期 30 五月 2002

rows.translation: 我叫田荆贵，土家族，龙山县靛房镇人。今年72岁。
rows.tujia: nga2 tian3jing1gui2 jie3-la1, bi2zi1ka3, long3sang1 xian2 dian2huan3 zeng2-nie3 luo4, long3bei3 nie3 hi2 nie1 se1tong1.
rows.english: My name is Tian Jinggui. I am Tujia, from Dianfang Township in Longshan County. I am now 72.

rows.translation: 1950年参加工作以后一直做农村工作。曾任过县委书记、县长、副州长、州政协副主席。
rows.tujia: la2 ge1 ong1 long1 sa3 ri1-lie3, yi2si1 long3cun1-nie3 sa3 ri1-la1, xian2wei1 su1ji1, xian2zang1, hu2zou1zang1, zeng2xie3 hu2zu1xi3 la1 dang1-lie3.
rows.english: From 1950 onwards I was engaged in village work. I served as the County Party Secretary, County Governor, Vice-Governor of Xiangxi Prefecture, and Vice-Chairman of the Prefectural Chinese People's Political Consultative Committee.

rows.translation: 1991年退休，从事研究土家族工作：出版了《中国土家族习俗》、《中国土家族历史人物》、《湖南省志·民族志·土家族篇》。
rows.tujia: la2 ge1 ge1 la2 long1 tui2xiu1, me3-lie1 bi2zi1ka3 ze2-la1: "zong1guai3 bi2zi1ka3 xing2-nie3-xi2", "zong1guai3 bi2zi1ka3 di1ga3-nie3 luo4", "hu3lang3 seng1 zi2 ming3cu3 zi2 bi2zi1ka3-nie3 ci1pu1" zu2-lie3;
rows.english: I retired in 1991, and have been engaged in Tujia research, publishing 'The Customs of the Tujia People of China', 'Historical Figures among the Tujia People of China', and the Tujia section of 'Hunan Province Records: Ethnic Records'.

rows.translation: 写了《土家族族源综述》《土家族摆手歌舞简介》等资料。下面讲一些事情...
rows.tujia: "bi2zi1ka3-nie3 geng1ba1 lun2weng3", "bai1sou1 guo1wu1 jian4gai2" zi1liao2 dian2 a2-lie3. xia2mian1 jian1 yi3xie1 si2qing3...
rows.english: I also wrote 'A Discussion of Tujia Origins' and 'A Brief Introduction to the Tujia Baishou Songs and Dances'. I'm going to talk about some other things below...

sections.title: 1.1.1: 自我介绍
sections.meta_en:
Tian Jinggui, Dianfang Township, Longshan County
recorded on 30 May 2002
sections.description_en: Mr Tian briefly introduces himself in this text. This is a prepared text, written down using Chinese characters as phonetic aide-memoires to indicate Tujia words.

sections.description: 这段描述田先生童年时代的艰苦，他是在龙山县靛房镇中心村长大的。这是田先生预先准备好的文本，在手稿中他使用了汉字来代表土家语词汇的发音。
sections.meta:
龙山县靛房镇田荆贵先生
记录日期 30 五月 2002

rows.translation: 我童年，我童年时，我小的时候我家没有田地。
rows.tujia: nga2 bo1li3, nga2 bo1li3-die1-zu2, nga2 bi2kui1-zu2, ang2 cu1 se3ke1 pe2ti1 tai2,
rows.english: When I was a child, during my childhood, when I was small, our family had no land.

rows.translation: 父亲母亲要给人家做工，种别人的田土，挖蕨打葛过日子。
rows.tujia: a1nie3, a1nie3 a3ba1 luo4die1 bo3 hu3ri1, luo4-nie3 se3ke1 pe2ti1 ri1, tuo2ga1 a3bu3 di3 mo3 nie4ka1.
rows.english: My parents had to work for others, renting and planting other people's fields, and digging bracken and kudzu vine to get by.

rows.translation: 我5岁时，就帮助父母亲煮饭炒菜，做洗碗筷等的家务活。
rows.tujia: nga2 ong1 se1tong1-zu2, nie3ba3 da4xi4 mo3 zi3 luo2, ha1ce1 luo2, qie3bi2 bu1zi1 wo1, cuo4-nie3 ye3 ri1.
rows.english: When I was five, I began helping my parents with the cooking, washing-up, and other household chores.

rows.translation: 后来，有了一个妹妹和一个弟弟，全家五口人吃饭，日子难度。
rows.tujia: ta1nie1, rong4 ang1ngai4 lao4 xiao2, la2 cuo4 luo4 ong1 la1hu3 zi3 ga2, nie4ka1-xi2 lang1.
rows.english: Later, my younger brother and sister arrived, and with five mouths to feed, life was very hard.

rows.translation: 父母亲常年穿草鞋，我和弟妹从来没有穿过好的鞋袜。
rows.tujia: nie3ba3 la2 long1 duo3 ji3ku3 da2, nga2, ang1ngai4, rong4 yi2si1 cuo3xie2 qi2la1 cai2 da2-bo3-da2.
rows.english: My parents wore straw sandals all year round, and my brother, sister and I never wore good shoes or socks.

rows.translation: 到冷天，手脚冻得像红萝卜。父母勤劳，虽吃粗粮野菜，都没有挨饿。
rows.tujia: sa4-zu2 ye4-lie3, jie2 ji3 sa4 mo3 la1be1 mian1jie1 da4ze3. nie3ba3 hang2la3 me2di1, zi3 cu3ga3la2 ga2, kang3ku1-nie3 ha1ce1 ga2 mo3 li2a4-bo3-da2.
rows.english: In cold weather, our hands and feet turned the colour of carrots. My parents worked hard, so although we ate coarse food and wild vegetables, we never starved.

rows.translation: 父母不识字，吃了很多亏。
rows.tujia: nie3ba3 ci1ci1 ha1tai2, qian2la2bu1 qi2kui1-bo3-la1.
rows.english: As my parents were illiterate, they were often at a disadvantage and suffered many hardships.

rows.translation: 我6岁时，听父亲说，“就算我要讨米也要叫儿子读书。”
rows.tujia: nga2 wo3 se1tong1-zu2, a3ba1 li3-xi2 xi4: "nga2 zi3 guo2-duo3 luo4bi3 duo3 ci1tu1."
rows.english: When I was six, my father told me he decided that even if he had to beg for food, he would still pay to send me to school.

rows.translation: 我7岁时，父亲就送我到私塾读书。我很听父母和老师的话，努力读书。
rows.tujia: nga2 nie3 se1tong1-zu2, a3ba1 nga2 si1su1 wo2tu1 si2-alie3 ci1tu1, nga2 nie3ba3-nie3, po2ga1-nie3 sa3 ru3-xi2 ca2, xie1qi1 si4-bo3 ci1tu1.
rows.english: When I was seven, he sent me to a private school. I was very obedient to my parents and my teacher, and studied hard.

rows.translation: 第一年，就读完了《三字经》、《百家姓》。10岁时，读完四书五经和增广贤文，
rows.tujia: zi1ge1 la2 long1 sang1zi2jing1 be2jia1xing2 tu1-ji2-liao3, hi2 se1tong1-zu2, si2su1wu1jing1, zeng1guan1xian3weng3 tu1-ji2-lie3.
rows.english: In the first year I read through the Sanzijing primer and the '100 Surnames'. When I was ten, I went on to read some of the classics.

rows.translation: 就到保国民学校和中心学校读书，学习成绩名列前茅。
rows.tujia: bao1xiao3 zong1xing1xiao3xiao2 ci1pu1 a2si1 tu1, ci1tu1 ca2 xie1 luo4-nie3 zi1ge1.
rows.english: I went to the Baoguomin and Central schools to study, and came top of my class.

rows.translation: 我发奋读书到12岁时，不幸父亲去世而失学。
rows.tujia: nga2 zang4jing3 ci1tu1 mo3 la2 si3 nie1 se1tong1-zu2, ming2xing1lang1, a3ba1 se2-liao3, ci1tu1-dao2.
rows.english: I studied really hard until I was twelve, when unfortunately my father died and I had to abandon school.

rows.translation: 就学耕土犁田，挑起了务农的重担。农忙时务农，农闲时卖水卖柴过日子。
rows.tujia: se3ke1 pe2ti1 qie3-xi2 a2hhi1, jie2ri1-nie3 du4zi3zi2 ke4-diu2. jie2ri1-zu2, jie2ri1; jie2ri1-da2-zu2, ce3 lu3 ka3 lu3 mo3 nie4ka1.
rows.english: Instead, I learned to till the land, carrying the heavy burden of the farmer. In the busy season I worked on the land; in the slack season I sold firewood and water to make ends meet.

rows.translation: 童年时期过的日子，至今记忆犹新，一点都没忘记。
rows.tujia: bo1li3-die1-zu2 nie4ka1-xi2 mu2la1 die2-za3lie3 lei4 da4ze3, la2bie1 duo3 si1ma3-da2.
rows.english: Even now, I have vivid and unforgettable memories of my childhood.

sections.title: 1.1.2: 我的童年
sections.meta_en:
Tian Jinggui, Dianfang Township, Longshan County
recorded on 30 May 2002
sections.description_en: In this text the speaker describes the rigours of his childhood, when he was growing up in Zhongxin village of Dianfang Township in Longshan County. This is a prepared text, written down using Chinese characters as phonetic aide-memoires to indicate Tujia words.

title: 向老官人的故事
documentTitle: 土家族传统故事: 向老官人的故事

sections.description: 向老官人的故事是土家族的传统故事，他是湘西土家族所敬重的三位传说中的英雄之一，在第10世纪与田好汉和彭公爵主一起统治湘西。故事中，向老官人的正直气概与皇帝的奸险狡猾成了鲜明的对比，最终还是向老官人获胜。这是田先生预先准备好的文本，在手稿中他使用了汉字来代表土家语词汇的发音。
sections.meta:
龙山县靛房镇田荆贵先生
记录日期 30 五月 2002

rows.translation: 下面讲向老官人的故事。
rows.tujia: ba3ti3 xian2lao1guan1reng3-nie3 gu1 lao4 li3.
rows.english: Let me tell you the story of General Xiang.

rows.translation: 湘西土家族中，有三位众所皆知的历史人物：一位是彭公爵主，一位是向老官人，第三位是田好汉。今天就讲讲向老官人的故事。
rows.tujia: xian1xi1 bi2zi1ka3 wo2tu1 hu2ni1 ha4ri3-nie3 di1ga3-nie3 luo4 suo1 hu3 xie2, la2 hu3 peng3gong1 jiao2zu1, la2 hu3 xian2lao1guan1reng3, sang1 hu3 tian3hao1hang2. lei4 mo3 xian2lao1guan1reng3-nie3 gu1 lao4 li3.
rows.english: Every Tujia person in Xiangxi has heard of these three great historical figures: Duke Peng, General Xiang, and Hero Tian. Today I'm going to tell you the story of General Xiang.

rows.translation: 向老官人，名叫业壳赖，能说会道，武艺高强。有一年，在龙马嘴得到了一匹白龙马后出了名。
rows.tujia: xian2lao1guan1reng3 nie2kuo3lai2 jie3-la1, sa3li3-hhe1, wu1ni3zi3 xie2. ai1 la2 long1, long3ma3zui1 pu2meng3 a3si3 lao4 ci1ba1 ti3-lie3 luo4 zu2-diu2.
rows.english: General Xiang's real name was Ye Kelai. He was an eloquent speaker, and also excelled in martial arts. He became famous one year after obtaining a white dragon-horse at Longmazui.

rows.translation: 土王给他封了一个官，人们就叫他向老官人。
rows.tujia: tu1wan3 guo2 bo3 sa3 si4-lie3 ga2me1 lao4 po1-lie3, luo4die1 guo2 jiu1 xian2lao1guan1reng3 jie3-la1.
rows.english: The local Tujia chieftain made him an official, and so people called him General Xiang.

rows.translation: 皇帝知道以后想见他，土王就要他进京进贡。他带着虎皮、蜂蜜等土产，骑着白龙马到了京城。
rows.tujia: huan3di2 ha4ri3-lie3 guo2 yi3-ya1ca1, tu1wan3 jiu1 guo2 duo3 jing2gong1-xie2, guo2 li2 ta2pa4 ce2ce1-die1 huo3-bo3, ma4 a3si3 jia1-lie3 jing1ceng3 ye4.
rows.english: When the emperor heard about him he wanted to meet him, so the chieftain sent him to the capital to pay tribute. He arrived in the capital, riding on his white horse, and bearing tiger skins, honey, and other local products.

rows.translation: 皇帝设宴招待他，喝酒时就问他：“听说你们那里很穷，没有金银财宝，就拿这些土产进贡，是吗？”
rows.tujia: huan3di2 guo2 ka4, re2 hu3-zu2 guo2 si1lie3: "luo4 li3-xi2 xi4, se2 eng1ge1 ye3 tai2, kuo1 tai2, ngo4 tai2, kang3ku1-nie3 ye3 huo3-bo3 wo1 si2, sou3ma1?"
rows.english: The emperor held a banquet for him, and when they were drinking wine together, he said to Xiang: "I hear your area is very poor, and has no gold, silver, or any other valuable goods, so you had to bring me these local products as tribute - isn't that so?"

rows.translation: 向老官人笑着说：“这些东西比金银财宝还好，有金有银都买不到。 我们那里三州六峒，州州满金，峒峒满银！还有龙和凤，富足得很呀！”
rows.tujia: xian2lao1guan1reng3 nie4-bo3 li3: "eng1di1 ye3-die1 kuo1-nie3 ngo4-nie3 ai1 ya ca2-nie1, kuo1 xie2 ngo4 xie2, pii1-duo3-ta1ti1; ang2 ge3 sang1 zou1 lu2 dong2 a, kuo1 ri3 ngo4 ri3, ai1ya1 pu2 pu3 xie2, xie2-xi3tai2 a!"
rows.english: General Xiang smiled and said: "These gifts are better than silver and gold, they cannot be bought with gold or silver. In our three prefectures and six districts there is gold and silver everywhere, as well as dragons and phoenixes, truly we are very rich!"

rows.translation: 皇帝又问他：“你们家里怎么样？”
rows.tujia: huan3di2 guo2 si1lie3: "se2 cu1 qi2ma1 la?"
rows.english: Then the emperor asked: "What is your home like?"

rows.translation: 向老官人说：“我们家里不像富人家，只有千根柱头落地，万个门户出入，
rows.tujia: xian2lao1guan1reng3 li3: "ang2 cu1 xie2ma1ka3 ze3-da2, hi2 hi2 hi2 ka3tong3 li4ti3 ti1, hi2 hi2 hi2 hi2 la1meng3 zu2 qi4lie3;
rows.english: General Xiang replied: "My house is not like a rich man's house, as it is only built on a thousand pillars and there are but ten thousand doors.

rows.translation: 风扫地月点灯的房屋。八十人背柴，七十人挑水，三只盐船下水运盐。有一天，在末鹰滩打翻了一只船，缺了三天盐吃呀！”
rows.tujia: re2su4 ruo4 hhi3, su3su3 tie4tie3 ti2-nie3 cuo4; [ye3] hi2-nie3 luo4 ka3 wo4, [nie3] hi2-nie3 luo4 ce3 ke4; bu4 suo1 ca1 ce3 da3 mo3 la2bu1 ye4. ai1 la2 nie1 bang2 tang1 ruo4 lao4 ha3-lie3 suo1 nie1 la2bu1 ga2-ci3 tai2 a!"
rows.english: The wind sweeps the floor and the moon lights the lanterns in the house. Eighty carry firewood and seventy draw water; three salt-barges ferry salt. Once, when one of them overturned on the Last Eagle shoals, we had to do without salt for three days!"

rows.translation: 皇帝暗暗吃惊，又问：“你们家有那么多人，有饭吃吗？”
rows.tujia: huan3di2 me3 wo2tu1 ge4 mo3 si1lie3: "se2 cu1 luo4 he2la3 xie2, ye3 ga2-ci3 xie2 ma?"
rows.english: The emperor was secretly amazed, so he asked: "There are so many people in your house, do they all have enough to eat?"

rows.translation: 向老官人说：“我们家一边有葛仓，另外一边有蕨仓，仓仓积粮如山，
rows.tujia: xian2lao1guan1reng3 li3: "ang2 cu1, qiao2 ge3la1bi1 a3bu3 cuo4, qiao2 gu3la1bi1 tuo2ga1 xie2, la2 cuo4 he1he1 ye3 cu4 mo3 ku1za4 da4ze3.
rows.english: General Xiang replied: "On one side of my house is a barn for kudzu vine, and on the other a barn for bracken; the food in them is heaped up like mountains.

rows.translation: 要用三斤多的钥匙开仓。要粮只管借，不要还。”
rows.tujia: suo1 qi1 ta2ci1-nie3 yan1si1 huo3lie3 cuo4 la1meng3 tong2, ye3 di4 ye3 ong1-xie2, ong1-lie3 tuo1-ta1-duo3."
rows.english: The key to the barns weighs three and a half pounds, and if anyone wants food, they can just take as much they want, without having to pay anything back."

rows.translation: 其实，向老官人没有木房子，很穷，只有一栋天通地漏的竹篱破茅屋。
rows.tujia: hang2la3, xian2lao1guan1reng3 ka3 cu1 ye3 tai2, mu4nie3 huo3lie3 wo3-bo3-xi2, dong3qi2dong3ga2-nie3 ka1ba1 cuo4 la2 cuo1 xie2.
rows.english: In actual fact, General Xiang's family was very poor. They lived in a decrepit thatched hut where there were huge gaps in the bamboo walls.

rows.translation: 八十岁的父亲背柴，七十岁的母亲挑水，他呀，扛着三斤多的锄头，挖葛挖蕨过日子。
rows.tujia: ye3 hi2 se1tong1-nie3 a3ba1 ka3 wo4, nie3 hi2 se1tong1-nie3 a1nie3 ce3 ke4; guo2 a, suo1 qi1 ta2ci1-nie3 pii1ki1 be4-lie3 a3bu3 tuo2ga1 di3-bo3 nie4ka1.
rows.english: His eighty year old father carried firewood and his seventy year old mother fetched water, whilst he shouldered his three and a half pound hoe to go and dig for kudzu vine and bracken to enable them to survive.

rows.translation: 养有三只鸭子，用鸭蛋换盐吃，一天被老鹰叼去一只鸭，没有蛋缺了三天盐。
rows.tujia: sa4 suo1 long3 long4-bo3-la1, sa4lie1 huo3lie3 la2bu1 a2li1 mo3 ga2. ai1 la2 nie1, bang2 guo2 lao4 di1die4-lu3, sa4lie1 tao2, suo1 nie1 la2bu1 ga2-ci3 tao2.
rows.english: He kept three ducks, to get a bit of salt by bartering their eggs, but one day an eagle carried off one of the ducks, so for three days there were no eggs or salt.

rows.translation: 皇帝说：“你们哪来的东西呀！都是土蛮子，没有能人做不成大事。”
rows.tujia: huan3di2 li3: "se2 ge3 ye3 gei4di3 a, yi2si1 tu1mang3zi3, qiao2se1-nie3 luo4 tai2, sa3 tie2ba1 ri1-ta1ti1."
rows.english: The emperor went on to say: "You lot, you are all barbarians, there are no capable men who can do great deeds."

rows.translation: 向老官人神气十足地说，“我们三州六峒州州有能人，能文又能武，下河搏蛟龙，上山捉老虎，呼风又唤雨，神仙都服输。”
rows.tujia: xian2lao1guan1reng3 me3-lie1 he2ba3 mo3 li3: "ang2ni1 a, sang1 zou1 wo3 dong2 a, qiao2se1 ca2-nie3 luo4 xie2, li3-hhe1, ri1-hhe1; ce3 da3 mo3 pu2 xi4, ku1ca4 gu3-bo3 li2 ji1, re2su4 me2ze3 jie3, seng3xian3 guo2 duo3 ge4."
rows.english: General Xiang replied haughtily: "Our three prefectures and six districts are full of able men, both with pen and sword; they wrestle with the flood dragon in the rivers, and catch tigers in the mountains; the wind and rain are at their beck and call, and even the immortals submit to them."

rows.translation: 正说话时，说得起劲时，后宫失火了，皇帝惊慌失措，不知怎么办。
rows.tujia: zeng1 li3-nie3-zu2, li3-nie3 jing2 ca2-zu2, hou2gong1 mi4 gi3-liao3, huan3di2 ge4 mo3 qi2ma1 ri1-duo3 ha1tai2,
rows.english: Just as he was warming to his subject, the concubines' palace quarters caught fire, and the emperor panicked, at a complete loss as to what he should do.

rows.translation: 向老官人说：“这是小事啦，皇上，你不要怕。”说着呢，喝了三口茶水向着后宫里一口喷去，火就熄了。
rows.tujia: xian2lao1guan1reng3 li3: "eng1di1 sa3 bi2kui1 la, huan3sang2 ni2 ge4-ta1-duo3." li3-zu2 le, a2ce1 suo1 ze2 hu3-lie3 hou2gong1 wo2tu1-bo3 la2 dong2 peng2, mi4 se2-liao3.
rows.english: General Xiang reassured him: "Your Majesty, don't be afraid, this is just a small matter." So saying, he drank three mouthfuls of tea and spat them out towards the concubines' quarters, putting out the fire.

rows.translation: 后宫传报：“刚才下了一阵大雨把火灭了。”皇帝听了惊得伸出舌头，好一阵缩不进去。
rows.tujia: hou2gong1 tong2-lie3 ze2: "mo1cai3 me2 tie2ba1 ze3-lie3 mi4 tao2." huan3di2 xi4-liao3, ge4 mo3 yi2la1 bie4-bo3 mo3 la2xie1 duo3 ku2ru1-ta1tiu1.
rows.english: From the concubines' quarters came the report that a sudden squall had put out the fire. The emperor was so frightened when he heard this that his tongue hung out of his mouth, and for a long time he was not able to draw it back.

rows.translation: 皇帝觉得向老官人很了不起，想留他保江山。皇帝说：“你现在别回去了，和我一起过好日子吧！”
rows.tujia: huan3di2 me3-lie1 xian2lao1guan1reng3 za2xi1-si3tai2 a, guo2 guo2 a3-bo3 jian1sang1 ka4-i, huan3di2 li3: "ni2 ta4 song1kuo1-gu2, nga2 da4ha3 ge3 nie4 cai2 ka1-gu2!"
rows.english: The emperor realised that General Xiang had amazing abilities, and wanted him to stay in the capital to help protect the nation: "Don't go back, why not stay with me and enjoy prosperity and a high position here?"

rows.translation: 向老官人摇着头说："你这里是金銮宝殿，我们那里是万宝山；你们这里人会享乐，不会做事。
rows.tujia: xian2lao1guan1reng3 kuo1ba1 qi4qi3-bo3 li3: "ni2 ge3 jing1long3bao1dian2 a, ang2 eng1ge1 wan2bao1 ku1ca4-lie1; se2 ge3-nie3 luo4die1 nie4 cai2 ka1-hhe1, sa3 ri1-ci1hhe1;
rows.english: But General Xiang shook his head and replied: "You have a gilded palace here, we live on Wanbao [Ten Thousand Treasures] Mountain. You only know how to enjoy yourselves, but don't know how to do anything.

rows.translation: 我们那里的人勤劳，什么都做得好。挖金挖银，日子过得很好。”
rows.tujia: ang2 eng1ge1-nie3 luo4die1 jie2ri1-xi2 ca2, qie4 ri1 duo3 heng4, kuo1 di3 ngo4 di3 mo3 nie4ka1-bo3 cai2 xie2."
rows.english: We are hard-working folk, excelling at whatever we do. We spend our days happily digging for gold and silver."

rows.translation: 皇帝再三挽留他，他却不同意。皇帝怕他回去后造反夺江山，认为向老官人会讲他的坏话。
rows.tujia: huan3di2 guo2 a3po1li1, guo2 ta4 ce3; huan3di2 guo2 song1kuo1-lie3 jian1sang1 a4yi3-xi2 ge4, me3-lie1 ta4-nie3 sa3 ze2;
rows.english: The emperor tried again and again to persuade him to stay, but he adamantly refused. The emperor was afraid that after he returned he would rebel and usurp the throne, and would say bad things about him.

rows.translation: 向老官人离开时，皇帝送他一罈御酒，想毒死他，对他说：“这罈酒你拿回去，你们那里的人大家一起喝。”
rows.tujia: zu2-bo3 mo3 re2ti1ku1 lao4 lie2, re2 hu3-lie3 guo2duo3 se2. guo2 bo3 li3: "ni2 huo3-lie3 se2 eng1ge1-nie3 luo4die1 [hu3], hu2ni1 da4 la2 ze2 hu3."
rows.english: So as General Xiang was leaving, the emperor gave him a flagon of [poisoned] wine, which would kill him when he drank it. Moreover, he told him: "Take this wine back with you to your people and drink it together in each other's company."

rows.translation: 向老官人是个直心肠，他把酒拿去，并不知道是毒酒，就接过御酒罈骑上白龙马回家来了。
rows.tujia: xian2lao1guan1reng3 luo4zi2, guo2 guo2 re2 huo3-lie3 se2-xi2 ha1tai2, re2ti1ku1 huo3-bo3 [pu2meng3] a3si3 jia1-lie3 song1kuo1-diu2.
rows.english: General Xiang was a straightforward man and took the wine, never thinking for a moment that it would kill him. So clutching the flagon of wine, he rode back home on his white dragon-horse.

rows.translation: 走到沅陵白马渡，感到口渴,他就喝了一口酒，立刻感到天旋地转，肚痛难忍，七窍流血，死在马上，尸体不倒。
rows.tujia: yan3leng3 be2ma1du2 ye4-lie3 ze2ga3-la1-hu3, guo2 jiu1 re2 la2 ze2 hu3, kuo1ba1 ye3luo3-la1-hu3, me3 di2-xi3tai2, eng2qi4 luo2bu1 mie4 zu2-diu2, jiu1 meng3 ga3 ong3-bo3 mo3 se2-liao3.
rows.english: When they reached Baimadu in Yuanling, he began to feel thirsty, so he drank a mouthful of wine. At once his head began to spin, his stomach became unbearably painful, and blood gushed out of from his nose and eyes. He died, still seated on his horse.

rows.translation: 白龙马懂人性，驮着向老官人的尸体，泪滔滔地跑回京城，向皇帝问罪。
rows.tujia: pu2meng3 a3si3 luo4 sa3 hao4ri3, xian2lao1guan1reng3 wo4 mo3 be1ce3cu1cu1 mo3 jing1ceng3-bo3 xi4ca3-lie3 huan3di2 da4ha3 si1lie3.
rows.english: The white dragon-horse understood human nature, so with General Xiang's body on its back and tears streaming down its face, it galloped back to the capital to denounce the emperor.

rows.translation: 皇帝见状，做鬼心虚，吓得要死，
rows.tujia: huan3di2 yi3-lie3, guo2duo3 a1ye3 ri1-bo3-xi2 ge4 mo3 se2.
rows.english: When the emperor saw them, he knew he had done wrong and was frightened to death.

rows.translation: 便对尸体说：“给你做七七四十九天道场，我们大家一起戴孝给你送葬。”
rows.tujia: guo2 luo4se2tu1 bo3 li3: "nga2 ni2 bo3 nie3 nie3 re1 hi2 ge1-nie3 dao2cang3 ri1-i, ang2ni1 hu2ni1 da4 ni2 bo3 jie2zu1 a3si3 die4-bo3 si2-lie3 bong3."
rows.english: He addressed the corpse: "I will give you the full forty-nine days of funerary rites, and I and the entire court will dress in mourning for your burial."

rows.translation: 尸体仍然不倒时，皇帝又说：“我管阳，你管阴，封你为土王神，享受万代香火，与天同寿，与日月同明。”
rows.tujia: luo4se2tu1 ei1ya1 geng1ke4-ta1-zu2, huan3di2 li3: "nga2 ta1nie3ku3 ka4, ni2 lang3qi1-cai3 ka4, nga2 ni2 bo3 tu1wan3 pu3sa3 lao4 po1, hi2 hi2 hi2 hi2 long1-nie3 ci1ke1ta1 xian1 sou2, me2 da4ha3 nie3hhe2 hhe3, lao3ci3 su3su3 da4ha3 ku1su3."
rows.english: But the corpse still did not topple, so the emperor added: "Let me rule this world and you the netherworld, I will deify you as the Tuwang god, so that you may enjoy the incense offerings of countless generations; you will live for ever, as bright as the sun and moon."

rows.translation: 这时，白龙马点点头，驮着向老官人尸体跑回到湘西。
rows.tujia: eng1-zu2, pu2meng3 a3si3 kuo1ba1 ga4 dong2 ku2ku1-lie3 xian2lao1guan1reng3 wo4-bo3 xian1xi1-bo3 eng3zou2.
rows.english: At this, the white horse bowed, and galloped back to Xiangxi bearing General Xiang's corpse.

rows.translation: 后来，土家族人为了纪念他，就修了一个土王宫，和彭公爵主、田好汉，供在一起敬奉。
rows.tujia: ta1nie1, bi2zi1ka3 guo2 die2-bo3 mo3 tu1wan3gong1 lao4 su2-lie3, peng3gong1 jiao2zu1 tian3hao1hang2 da4ha3 gong2-bo3 jing2-la1.
rows.english: Afterwards, in order to commemorate him, the Tujia people built a Tuwang temple, and worshipped him alongside Duke Peng and Hero Tian.

sections.title: 1.2: 向老官人的故事
sections.meta_en:
Tian Jinggui, Dianfang Township, Longshan County
recorded on 30 May 2002
sections.description_en: This text tells the traditional story of General Xiang, one of the three great quasi-historical (c.10th century) heroes of the Tujia in Xiangxi, along with Hero Tian and Duke Peng. The tale contrasts the integrity of General Xiang with the duplicity of the emperor. Even in death General Xiang's integrity wins the day. This is a prepared text, written down using Chinese characters as phonetic aide-memoires to indicate Tujia words.

title: 田好汉与彭公爵主的故事
documentTitle: 土家族传统故事: 田好汉与彭公爵主的故事

sections.description: 田好汉的故事是土家族的传统故事，他是湘西土家族所敬重的三位传说中的英雄之一，在第10世纪与向老官人和彭公爵主一起统治湘西，故事主要描述田好汉超常的力气与武艺。以前的土家族社会，是由经常练武的农民组成的，这些“土兵”往往在战场上得胜，在国内名声远扬。这是田先生预先准备好的文本，在手稿中他使用了汉字来代表土家语词汇的发音。
sections.meta:
龙山县靛房镇田荆贵先生
记录日期 19 六月 2002

rows.translation: 田好汉的故事。
rows.tujia: tian3hao1hang2-nie3 pa3pa1.
rows.english: The Story of Hero Tian

rows.translation: 今天讲个田好汉的故事。田好汉是土家族中力大无穷的一个人。
rows.tujia: lai4, tian3hao1hang2-nie3 pa3pa1 lao4 li3. tian3hao1hang2 bi2zi1ka3-nie3 xie1qi1 ci4-xi3tai2-nie3 luo4 la2 hu3.
rows.english: Today I'm going to tell you the story of Hero Tian. Hero Tian was a mighty man among the Tujia.

rows.translation: 他犁地放工时，牛走得慢，他就把牛扛在肩上回家。
rows.tujia: guo2 li4 qie3 jie2po1-zu2, wu2 hhi2-xi2 die1, guo2 guo2 wu2 pe2ti1ke1 ga3 po1-bo3 cu1 song1kuo1.
rows.english: Whenever he finished ploughing, his cow walked home too slowly, so he would put it on his shoulders and carry it back home.

rows.translation: 有一次，他装了一船黄豆到常德去卖时，碰到一个有本事的人。
rows.tujia: ei1 la2 qie2, guo2 qi2bu1li1 bu4 la2 ca1 cu4-lie3 cang3die3-bo3 lu3-lu3, beng4si3 xie2-nie3 luo4 lao4 yi3,
rows.english: One day, he had loaded a boat with soybeans and was on his way to Changde to sell them, when he came across a capable man.

rows.translation: 那人一上船，用脚把船竹篙踩断了，并说：“对不起。”
rows.tujia: ei1 luo4 lao4 bu4 gu3-lie3, ji3 huo3lie3 mu4nie3 jia2zu1 za2 mo3 kuo3-liao3, guo2 li3: "nga2 xi2lang1."
rows.english: As the man boarded the boat, he stepped on the boat's bamboo steering pole and broke it. "Sorry!" he said.

rows.translation: 田好汉说：“没有什么事啊！”，就用手把踩断的竹篙捏成粉丢到河里。
rows.tujia: tian3hao1hang2 li3: "qie4 sa3 tai2 ou!" jie2 huo3lie3 mu4nie3 kuo2ti1 za4 mo3 pi2pi1 zi2-liao3, hu3pa3-bo3 la2-lu3.
rows.english: Hero Tian replied, "That's OK", and, taking the pole in his hand as though it were a bean, crushed it into powder, which he threw into the river.

rows.translation: 那一个人，他又抓了一把黄豆说：“这黄豆干了没有啊？”就拿着黄豆捏成了粉。
rows.tujia: ei1 luo4 lao4, guo2 qi2bu1li1 la2 pa1 huo3-lie3 li3: "eng1 qi2bu1li1 ga3-bo3-la1 tai2 ya?" qi2bu1li1 za4 mo3 pi2pi1 zi2-liao3.
rows.english: The man grabbed a handful of soybeans and said: "Are these soybeans dry yet?" as he crushed them into powder.

rows.translation: 田好汉也抓了一把黄豆捏在手中出了油，他说：“黄豆没干，怎么会出油呀？”
rows.tujia: tian3hao1hang2, guo2 qi2bu1li1 la2 pa1 a3, jie2 wo2tu1 za4 mo3 se3si2 zu2-diu2, guo2 li3: "qi2bu1li1 ga3-bo3-da2 qing3mo1 se3si2 zu2 ya?"
rows.english: Hero Tian also grabbed a handful of soybeans and squeezed oil out from them, saying, "If the soybeans weren't dry how would I be able to squeeze oil from them?"

rows.translation: 那人害怕了，悄悄地溜走了。
rows.tujia: ei1 luo4 ge4-lie3 ka3kei1la3lei1 mo3 xi4ca3-lu3.
rows.english: This scared the man, who quietly slipped away.

rows.translation: 后来，田好汉到武汉卖木材时，买木的老板讲打不肯给钱时，他把老板打得要死不活。
rows.tujia: ta1nie1, tian3hao1hang2 wu1hang2-bo3 ka3tong3 lu3-zu2, ka3 pu1-nie3 lao1bang1 ha3-xi2 li3, tong3qian3 lie2-ta1-zu2, guo2 guo2 ha3 mo3 se2-ta1 ca2-ta1-liao3.
rows.english: Later, Hero Tian went to Wuhan to sell timber, but the timber merchant threatened him and wouldn't pay up, so he gave the man a sound beating.

rows.translation: 土王修老司城时，他帮助几百名工人。要背一个多月的石头，他一天就背完了。
rows.tujia: tu1wan3 lao1si1ceng3 su2-zu2, guo2 guo2 hi2 hi2-nie3 luo4 jie2ri1ma1 da4xi4, la2 si1 ta2ci1 wo4-nie3 a3ba3, guo2 guo2 la2 nie1-lie3 wo4-ji2-liao3.
rows.english: When the Tujia chieftain was building his citadel, Hero Tian helped hundreds of labourers. In a single day, he shifted stones which would have taken them more than a month to move.

rows.translation: 田好汉出了名以后，得到土王彭公的爱慕，后来，在土司城里面彭公呢，做爵主，向老官人呢，当军师，田好汉呢，当将军，一起掌管湘西土家族的大事。
rows.tujia: tian3hao1hang2 heng4-xi2 zu2-lie3, tu1wan3 peng3gong1 guo2 a2ci1-liao3. ta1nie1, [tu1si1ceng3] wo2tu1 peng3gong1 le, jiao2zu1 ri1; xian2lao1guan1reng3 le, jing1si1 ri1; tian3hao1hang2 le, jian1jing1 ri1; da4ha3 xian1xi1 bi2zi1ka3-nie3 sa3 tie2ba1 za4.
rows.english: After Hero Tian's fame spread, he became a favourite of Duke Peng. Later, he lived in the citadel: Duke Peng ruled, General Xiang served as military adviser, and Hero Tian as general. Together, they led the Tujia people of Xiangxi through the great events of the time.

rows.translation: 田好汉的故事多得很，今天就说这些。
rows.tujia: tian3hao1hang2-nie3 pa3pa1 ri3-xi3tai2, lai4 jiu1 ai1 he2lang3 li3.
rows.english: There are many more stories about Hero Tian, but that's enough for today.

sections.title: 1.3.1: 田好汉的故事
sections.meta_en:
Tian Jinggui, Dianfang Township, Longshan County
recorded on 19 June 2002
sections.description_en: This text tells the traditional story of Hero Tian, one of the three great quasi-historical (c.10th century) heroes of the Tujia in Xiangxi, along with General Xiang and Duke Peng. The tale focuses on the strength and martial prowess of Hero Tian. In the past Tujia society was based on small groups of farmers who regularly trained together as skilled fighting units, and Tujia soldiers were well known throughout China for their success in battles. This is a prepared text, written down using Chinese characters as phonetic aide-memoires to indicate Tujia words.

sections.description: 彭公爵主的故事是土家族传统故事，他是湘西土家族所敬重的三位传说中的英雄之一，在第10世纪与向老官人和田好汉一起统治湘西。故事描述彭公爵主把压迫土家族人的吴著冲驱逐出境的经过，从此，彭公就当了土家人的领导。据历史记载，彭氏于公元910年打败了湘西北部的头人，然后与他的后人统治了这个地区一共818年之多。彭氏家族的统治， 这是田先生预先准备好的文本，在手稿中他使用了汉字来代表土家语词汇的发音。
sections.meta:
龙山县靛房镇田荆贵先生
记录日期 04 七月 2002

rows.translation: 彭公爵主的故事。
rows.tujia: peng3gong1 jiao2zu1-nie3 pa3pa1.
rows.english: The Story of Duke Peng

rows.translation: 今天，讲个彭公爵主的故事。
rows.tujia: lai4, peng3gong1 jiao2zu1-nie3 pa3pa1 lao4 li3.
rows.english: Today I am going to tell you the story of Duke Peng.

rows.translation: 很早以前，我们土家族住的地方的头人叫吴著冲。他不识字，什么都不懂，只晓得压迫人。
rows.tujia: ei1 zi1gi1-zu2, ang2 bi2zi1ka3 ong3-bo3-nie3 lang3cang3-nie3 luo4ci1ba1 wu3zuo3cong1 jie3-la1, guo2 ci1ci1 ha1tai2, qie4 duo3 ha1tai2, luo4 qia1-nie3-xi2 hao4ri3.
rows.english: A long time ago, in our Tujia areas, there lived a powerful man named Wuzuocong. He was illiterate and unskilled, and only knew how to oppress people.

rows.translation: 人们恨他的事多得很。实行初夜权，人们吃得他的肉，人们接婚时，他要先睡三夜。
rows.tujia: luo4 guo2 (null)-ta1-ce1-nie3 sa3 ri3-xi3tai2, zi1ge1 la2 pe1 nie2-nie3-xi2, luo4 guo2 si3 ga2-de1xi3, luo4die1 zuo4 a3-zu2, guo2 zi1ge1 suo1 pe1 nie2-pie3-duo3.
rows.english: People had all manner of things against him, and hated him so much they could eat his flesh for exercising bride-chamber rights. When people got married, he insisted on first having three nights with the bride.

rows.translation: 有一年，土家族中从外面读书回来了一个有文化的人，名叫彭公。
rows.tujia: ai1 la2 long1, bi2zi1ka3 wo4ta3 ci1tu1-nie3 luo4 ci1ci1 ha4ri3-nie3 luo4 lao4 wo4ta3 song1kuo1-diu2, peng3gong1 jie3-la1,
rows.english: One year, an educated Tujia man, named Peng, who had been away to study, returned home.

rows.translation: 他喊了很多人，去打吴著冲，他把吴著冲从他的老窠猛洞坪[今永顺县城地]赶出去了。
rows.tujia: guo2 luo4 qian2la2bu1 jie3-lie3 wu3zuo3cong1 ha3-xie2, guo2 guo2 meng4dong2ping3-lie1 wu3zuo3cong1 ong3-bo3-nie3 tong4 wo2tu1-lie1 jie4 mo3 la2-lu3.
rows.english: He called together a few men and went off to fight Wuzuocong, driving him out of his lair in Mengdongping.

rows.translation: 吴著冲躲到洛塔界[龙山地]去了，在山上守着，与彭公打了一年多。
rows.tujia: wu3zuo3cong1 luo3ta3gai2-bo3 ye4-lu3, ku1za4 ga3-lie1 ka4-bo3 peng3gong1 da4 la2 long1 ta2ci1 ha3.
rows.english: Wuzuocong fled to Luota [in Longshan], to the safety of the mountains, where Peng fought with him for over a year.

rows.translation: 后来，彭公烧了吴著厅，吴著冲从山上飞着逃跑，
rows.tujia: ta1nie1, peng3gong1 guo2 mi1ra1 huo3lie3 wu3zuo3ting1 wu2-liao3, wu3zuo3cong1 ku1za4 ga3-lie1 ra2 mo3 xi4ca3-lu3.
rows.english: Later, Peng burnt down Wu's base there. Wuzuocong fled from the mountains,

rows.translation: 彭公用箭把吴著冲的手臂射穿，跑得不快了。吴著冲飞到死吴坪，流血不止，在那里死了。
rows.tujia: peng3gong1 ra4 huo3lie3 wu3zuo3cong1-nie3 si3 jie2tang1ke1 ra4 mo3 dong3-liao3, ra2-ta1tiu1. wu3zuo3cong1 ra2-lie3 se4wu3ping3 [ye4], mie4 zu2-xi2 po1-ta1, ao1 se2-liao3.
rows.english: but Peng shot him through with arrows, injuring his arm and preventing his escape. Wuzuocong fled to Sewuping, but he could not staunch the bleeding, and died there.

rows.translation: 吴著冲死后，彭公把吴著冲的结拜兄弟惹巴冲、春巴冲驻守地收复了。
rows.tujia: wu3zuo3cong1 se2-lie3, peng3gong1 guo2 wu3zuo3cong1-nie3 ang1ngai4 ha3-bo3-xi2, re1ba1cong1, cun1ba1cong1-nie3 lang3cang3 ti3-liao3.
rows.english: After Wuzuocong's death, Peng won back the land controlled by Wu's pact brothers, Sebacong and Cunbacong.

rows.translation: 没有了吴著冲，土家族人民就拥护彭公当了爵主。彭公叫向老官人当军师，田好汉当将军，一起管理湘西土家族地区的大事。
rows.tujia: wu3zuo3cong1 tao2 a-lie1, bi2zi1ka3-nie3 luo4die1 peng3gong1 a2hu1 mo3 jiao2zu1 ri1-liao3. peng3gong1, guo2 xian2lao1guan1reng3 duo3 jing1si1 ri1, tian3hao1hang2 duo3 jian1jing1 ri1, da4ha3 xian1xi1 bi2zi1ka3-nie3 lang3cang3 sa3 tie2ba1 za4.
rows.english: Now that Wuzuocong was gone, the Tujia people chose Peng as their leader. Peng asked General Xiang to serve as military adviser and Hero Tian as general, and together they managed the important affairs of the Tujia people in Xiangxi.

rows.translation: 彭公爵主做事做得好，人民群众拥护，坐了八百零二年天下。
rows.tujia: peng3gong1 jiao2zu1 sa3 ri1-xi2 ca2, luo4 xie2-xi2 guo2 a2hu1, ye3 hi2 hi2 nie1 long1 ong3-lie3.
rows.english: Duke Peng ruled well and was popular with everyone, [his lineage] holding power for 802 years.

rows.translation: 现在，土家族过舍巴节的时候，把彭公爵主、向老官人、田好汉三个人，当作祖先来祭祀。
rows.tujia: mu2la1, bi2zi1ka3 se1ba1 ri1-zu2 peng3gong1 jiao2zu1, xian2lao1guan1reng3, tian3hao1hang2 suo1 la1hu3 nie3ti3ge1ti1 ri1 mo3 jing2-la1.
rows.english: Now, when the Tujia hold the 'baishouwu' dance, they sacrifice to their ancestors, Duke Peng, General Xiang, and Hero Tian.

sections.title: 1.3.2: 彭公爵主的故事
sections.meta_en:
Tian Jinggui, Dianfang Township, Longshan County
recorded on 04 July 2002
sections.description_en: This text tells the traditional story of Duke Peng, one of the three great quasi-historical heroes of the Tujia in Xiangxi, along with General Xiang and Hero Tian. The tale tells how Duke Peng ousted Wuzuocong, freeing the Tujia people in the area from oppression and becoming their leader. In real life, Peng Jian, who defeated the existing ruler of the northern Xiangxi area in 910, primarily differed from his predecessor in initiating a dynasty that would rule the area continuously for a staggering 818 years. The dynasty only came to an end when the Qing court replaced such feudal rulers with directly appointed officials in the gaituguiliu reforms of the early 18th century (see Introduction). This is a prepared text, written down using Chinese characters as phonetic aide-memoires to indicate Tujia words.

title_en: The Stories of Hero Tian and Duke Peng

title: 八部大王的故事
documentTitle: 土家族传统故事: 八部大王的故事

sections.description: 这是八部大王的故事，据土家族的传说，这八位兄弟是湘西北部土家族的祖先。除了描述土家族的族源之外，本故事也解释了龙和凤对于土家族人的重要性； 要在桅杆柱子顶上挂两面龙凤旗。这是田先生预先准备好的文本，在手稿中他使用了汉字来代表土家语词汇的发音。
sections.meta:
龙山县靛房镇田荆贵先生手稿，由龙山县他砂乡鲁美艳小姐叙述
记录日期 28 三月 2003

rows.translation: 八部大王的传说。
rows.tujia: ye3ti3ci1ba1-nie3 ze2 li3.
rows.english: The Story of the Eight Kings

rows.translation: 八部大王是土家族传说中的大人物，是土家族的祖先。
rows.tujia: ye3ti3ci1ba1 bi2zi1ka3 ze2 li3-zu2-nie3 luo4ci1ba1, bi2zi1ka3-nie3 nie3ti3ge1ti1.
rows.english: The Eight Kings are major characters in Tujia legends and are the ancestors of the Tujia people.

rows.translation: 很久年前，两位公婆，四十多岁了还没有小孩。
rows.tujia: qie2long1-nie3 zi1ge1, pa2ni1 po3pa1 nie1 hu3, re1 hi2 long1 nie4 se1tong1 ta2ci1-zu2, bo1li3 tai2.
rows.english: Once upon a time, there was an old couple who after more than forty years still remained childless.

rows.translation: 以后做不起工夫时怕没人瞻养，就天天哭泣。有一天，一位白胡子老头对老婆婆说：“你把这八颗茶叶籽籽熬水吃了，就会有喜。”
rows.tujia: ta1nie1 jie2ri1-hi1ce1, long4-ma1 tai2-xi2 ge4, la2 nie1 hi4lie3 zi2. ei1 la2 nie1, ma1pa3 a3si3-nie3 po3pa1cei1 lao4 pa2ni1 bo3 li3: "ni2 guo2 eng1di1 ra2gu1-bu2li1 ye3 bu2 luo2 mo3 ce3 hu3-lie3 qing2die1 xie2."
rows.english: Every day they wept, afraid that when they were too old to work there would be no one to look after them. One day a white-bearded old man said to the old woman: "Take these eight tea-leaves, drink the tea brewed from them, and then you will have children."

rows.translation: 老婆从他手中把八颗茶叶籽籽拿回家熬水吃了。过了三年六个月，就在那天晚上生了孩子。
rows.tujia: pa2ni1 guo2-jiao3-lie1 ra2gu1-bu2li1 ye3 bu2 huo3-lie3 cu1 luo2 mo3 ce3 hu3-lie3, suo1 long1 wo3 si1 ye4-nie3 lang3cei1 bo1li3 long4-liao3.
rows.english: The old lady took the eight tea-leaves home with her, made tea from them and drank it. One evening, after three and a half years, she gave birth.

rows.translation: 老头子立刻点着丛膏油灯去看。天啊！孩子，这么多的孩子！一个个数起来有八个男孩啊！
rows.tujia: po3pa1cei1 xie1hu1 cong3gao3 tie4tie3 ti2-bo3 ba4-xie2: "me2! bo1li3 he2la3! bo1li3 qian2la2bu1!" lao4 lao4 mo3 hi4-lie3, ye3 hu3-nie3 luo4bi3!
rows.english: Her husband immediately lit an oil-lamp to have a look. Good heavens! Such children, so many of them! Counting them one by one, altogether there were eight boys!

rows.translation: 老头子怕得很，认为是一窝怪物。他用一个大背笼背到山上丢弃了。
rows.tujia: po3pa1cei1 ge4-xi3tai2, qie4 die2ka1la1 la2 tong4 die2-lie3, guo2 guo2 rong1ti1 la2 rong1 huo3lie3 wo4-lie3 kang3ku1 ku1za4 ga3-bo3 tu2-lu3.
rows.english: The old man was very frightened, wondering what kind of evil brood they might be. He carried them away in a large back-basket and abandoned them in the mountains.

rows.translation: 八个男孩哇哇地哭时，一只白虎来了。张开嘴巴要吃小孩的时候，一只大凤凰飞来，用翅膀护着小孩们，白虎怕得跑了。
rows.tujia: luo4bi3 ye3 la1hu3 gua2gua2 mo3 zi2-zu2, li2 a3si3 lao4 eng3zou2, za2qi1 ga2ga1 mo3 bo1li3 ga2-zu2, pu3 tie2ba1 lao4 ra2-diu2, jie2tang1ke1 huo3lie3 bo1li3-die1 a2hu1-bo3, li2 a3si3 ge4 mo3 xi4ca3-lu3.
rows.english: Whilst the eight babies were crying, a white tiger appeared. Just as it was opening its mouth wide to eat them, a big phoenix came flying down and used its wings to protect the children. The tiger ran away in fright.

rows.translation: 后来，又来了一条大龙。龙给孩子们喂奶，凤凰给孩子们暖身体。
rows.tujia: ta1nie1, pu2 tie2ba1 lao4 eng3zou2, pu2, guo2 bo1li3-die1 bo3 mang3 a4; huan3, guo2 bo1li3-die1 bo3 suo4ti3 luo4.
rows.english: Later, a large dragon also came. The dragon suckled the children and the phoenix warmed them with its body.

rows.translation: 这样，八个孩子哺龙乳暖凤温长大成人了。
rows.tujia: hang2la3, bo1li3 ye3 la1hu3 pu2-nie3 mang3 ku3, pu3-nie3 luo4-bo3 ong2-lie3 luo4ci1ba1 zi2-liao3.
rows.english: So, drinking the dragon's milk and warmed by the phoenix, the eight children grew to adulthood.

rows.translation: 有一天，八个青年正在摔跤玩耍，龙和凤对他们说：“你们别再玩耍了，快看你们父母去。你们父母想你们哭得眼皮都肿了。”
rows.tujia: ei1 la2 nie1, ye3 la1hu3 luo4bi3-die1 da1bu3 mo3 ge3ci2-la1, pu2 nie1 pu3 ge4ze1 bo3 li3: "se2 ta4 ge3ci2-gu2, xie1hu1 nie3ba3 ba4-i-duo3-hu3, nie3ba3 se2 die2 mo3 zi2 mo3 luo2bu1ta2pa4 duo3 hu3-liao3."
rows.english: One day, when the eight young men were enjoying themselves wrestling with one another, the dragon and the phoenix said to them: "Don't play any more, go quickly and visit your parents, their eyes are swollen with crying from missing you."

rows.translation: 八个男儿下山跑到家见了父母，跪着喊父亲母亲。
rows.tujia: luo4bi3 ye3 la1hu3 ku1za4 da3-lie3 xi4ca3 mo3 cu1-nie3 nie3ba3 yi3-liao3, ki4-bo3 mo3 a1nie3 a3ba1 jie3.
rows.english: The eight boys ran down the mountain to their parents' home. When they saw them, they knelt down and cried, "Father! Mother!"

rows.translation: 父母见儿子们回来了，笑得流出了热泪。
rows.tujia: nie3ba3, guo2 luo4bi3-die1 song1kuo1-xi2 yi3-lie3, nie4 mo3 luo2bu1ce3 sa2gi1 duo3-diu2.
rows.english: When their parents saw they had returned, they cried for joy.

rows.translation: 父母就给他们从大到小起了名字：熬泽河舍、西梯佬、西阿佬、里都、苏都、那乌米、拢此也所也冲、接也会也那飞列也。
rows.tujia: a1nie3 a3ba1 ge4ze1 luo4 tie2ba1 bi2kui1 lao4 wa jie3-xi2 lao4 jie3: ngao3ce3huo3se4, xi1ti1lao4, xi1a1lao4, li1du1, su1du1, la1wu1mi1, long1ci1ye1suo1ye1cong1, jie2ye1hui1ye1la1hui1lie1ye1.
rows.english: They then gave each of them names, from the eldest to the youngest: Ngaocehuose, Xitilao, Xi'alao, Lidu, Sudu, Lawumi, Longciyesuoyecong, and Jieyehuiyelahuilieye.

rows.translation: 他们得了名字以后，人们称他们为八兄弟。
rows.tujia: ge4ze1 jie3-nie3-xi2 ti3-alie3, luo4 guo2 ye3 hu3 qian1ngai4-die1 jie3.
rows.english: After they had been given their names, people called them the Eight Brothers.

rows.translation: 八兄弟在家务农，挖蕨打葛，上山打猎，下河捉鱼，样样工夫都做得好。
rows.tujia: ye3 hu3 qian1ngai4-die1 cu1 jie2ri1, tuo2ga1 a3bu3 di3, kang3ku1 si3jie4, hu3pa3 song2 zuo2, la2 ye3 hi1hi1 ri1-xi2 ca2;
rows.english: The eight brothers worked around the home, digging bracken and kudzu, hunting in the hills, catching fish in the rivers; whatever they did, they did well.

rows.translation: 他们力大无穷，智勇双全，上山背柴，可以把大树一棵一棵地搬起来，上山打猎，用手把大老虎掰开两半。
rows.tujia: ge4ze1 xie1qi1 ca2-xi3tai2, me3guo3 wo2tu1 ze3, wu1ni3zi3 ca2, kang3ku1 ka3 wo4, ka3mong3 ci1ba1 la2 mong1 la2 mong1 mo3 be4-adi2-di1xi3, kang3ku1 si3jie4, li2 tie2ba1 jie2 huo3lie3 bi1ci4 mo3 nie1 za1 zi2.
rows.english: They were full of might, both brave and resourceful. When they went into the mountains to fetch firewood, they could bring back a whole tree at a time; when they went hunting, they could tear a big tiger in two with their bare hands.

rows.translation: 他们八兄弟全家日子过得好了，又帮助大家过上好日子。
rows.tujia: ge4ze1 ye3 hu3 qian1ngai4-die1 la2 ma1 nie4ka1-xi2 ca2-liao3, luo4 da4xi4 mo3, hu2ni1 nie4ka1 ca2-liao3.
rows.english: The eight brothers and their parents lived happily together, and helped others to live happily too.

rows.translation: 有一年，外面的人来攻打我们国家。皇帝打不退敌人，就下圣旨叫八兄弟一起去打。
rows.tujia: ei1 la2 long1, wo4ta3-nie3 luo4die1 ang2 guo3jia1 ha3-diu2, huan3di2 guo2 ha3 mo3 hhi2-ya1ti1, seng2zi1 da3-lie3 ye3 hu3 qian1ngai4-die1 duo3 [ha3-xie2].
rows.english: One year, foreigners came to attack our country. The emperor was unable to repulse them, so he issued an edict ordering the eight brothers to go and fight.

rows.translation: 八兄弟到了打仗的前线，用两只手抓住敌人，有些人被摘掉了头，有些人的两只脚被扯成两半，好像大人捉蝗虫一样，打死了许多敌人。
rows.tujia: ye3 hu3 qian1ngai4-die1 da4ha3-nie3 zi1gi1 ye4-lie3, jie2 nie1 ci3 huo3lie3 luo4 zuo2-bo3, la1sa1die1 kuo1ba1-bu2li1 tie2-lu3, la1sa1die1 ji3 nie1 ci3 ci1ca4-lie3 nie1 za1 zi2, luo4ci1ba1 guo2 ca3ca1ku1li1 zuo2-xi2 da4ze3, luo4 die2ka1la1 qian2la2bu1 ha3-si3.
rows.english: When the eight brothers reached the battlefield, they used their hands to seize the enemy: they plucked off the heads of some and tore the legs off others, just like a man grasping a grasshopper. They put to death many of the enemy.

rows.translation: 没死的敌人抱着头逃跑了。
rows.tujia: se2-da2-nie3 luo4die1 kuo1ba1 a2hu1 mo3 xi4ca3-ji2-lu3.
rows.english: Those who survived fled, clutching their heads.

rows.translation: 八兄弟保国立了功，皇帝给每人封了个王，叫八部大王，每人管一峒，一峒为一部落。
rows.tujia: ye3 hu3 qian1ngai4-die1 guo3jia1 a2hu1 mo3 gong1 ti3-lie3, huan3di2, guo2 lao4 bo3 wan3 lao4 po1, ye3ti3ci1ba1 jie3, la2 hu3 la2 dong2 ka4, la2 dong2 la2 bu2luo4.
rows.english: The eight brothers made a great contribution to saving the nation, so the emperor conferred a kingship on each of them, and called them the Eight Kings. He gave each of them a tract of land to rule, one per tribe.

rows.translation: 传说，老大坐农车（龙山），老幺坐首八峒（保靖）。
rows.tujia: ze2 li3, tie2ba1 long3ce1 ong3, bi2kui1 sou1ba1dong1 ong3.
rows.english: According to legend, the eldest ruled in Nongche [in Longshan] and the youngest in Shoubadong [in Baojing].

rows.translation: 后来的子孙们纪念他们时，跳着摆手舞敬他们。
rows.tujia: ta1nie1-nie3 re4bi2-die1 guo2 die2-zu2, se1ba1 ri1-zu2 ge4ze1 jing2-la1.
rows.english: Afterwards, their descendants wanted to commemorate them, venerating them during the 'baishouwu' dance.

rows.translation: 现在，保靖水坝峒八部大王庙的遗址还在，龙山农车的大摆手大家都会。
rows.tujia: mu2la1, bao1jing3 sui1ba1dong1 ye3ti3ci1ba1-nie3 miao2 ti2mi1 ai4duo3 xie2-nie2, long3sang1 long3ce1-nie3 se1ba1 ci1ba1 ri1-nie3-xi2 luo4 hu2ni1 ri1-de1xi3.
rows.english: Today, the remains of the Eight Kings Temple still exist at Shuibadong in Baojing; and in Nongche in Longshan, people still know how to perform the large-scale 'baishouwu' dance.

rows.translation: 传说时，那里在石头孔上面有一个八部大王的脚印。
rows.tujia: ze2 li3-zu2, ei1 la2 a3tong1 ga3 ye3ti3ci1ba1-nie3 ji3mi2 lao4 xie2.
rows.english: According to legend, one of the king's footprints can be seen on a depression in the rock there.

rows.translation: 土家族跳大摆手舞时，要在桅杆柱子顶上挂两面龙凤旗，为了纪念龙凤扶养土家族远祖祖先的恩德。
rows.tujia: bi2zi1ka3 se1ba1 ci1ba1 ri1-zu2, wei3zi3 ka3tong3 ga3ha2 pu2 nie1 pu3 qi3 nie1 hhi1 zuo1-bo3-duo3, pu2 pu3, guo2 bi2zi1ka3-nie3 nie3ti3ge1ti1 long4-nie3 qing3 die2-xi2.
rows.english: When the Tujia perform the large-scale 'baishouwu' dance, they must hang flags depicting a dragon and a phoenix on two poles, to commemorate the kindness shown by the dragon and phoenix in raising the ancestors of the Tujia.

sections.title_en: 1.4: The Story of the Eight Kings
sections.meta_en:
prepared by Tian Jinggui, Dianfang Township, Longshan; narrated by Lu Meiyan, Tasha, Longshan County
recorded on 28 March 2003
sections.description_en: This text relates the legend of the Eight Great Kings, brothers reputed to be the ancestors of the Tujia in northern Xiangxi. As well as describing the origins of the Tujia, the tale explains the significance of the dragon and phoenix totems in their traditional baishouwu dance. This is a prepared text, written down using Chinese characters as phonetic aide-memoires to indicate Tujia words. The photo archive includes a photograph of the footprint reputed to have been left on a large boulder by one of the eight brothers.

title: 庆祝舍巴节（第一部分）
documentTitle: 即席性的故事: 庆祝舍巴节（第一部分）

sections.description: 这是彭武根先生对于土家族经济文化生活的长达75分钟的叙述的头十分之一的录音。他描述了每年春天在土家族地区庆祝的舍巴节，这个节日包括传统的摆手舞，叙述在下一段继续。虽然彭先生能说流利的土家语，但是他还是使用了许多的汉语借词。
sections.meta:
龙山县靛房镇彭武根先生
记录日期 20 七月 2002

rows.translation: A：今天玩啦，快开始玩啦！有没有人玩啊？有人就快来，我们开始搞了！B：你们搞什么？A：我们要过舍巴节！B：哪里啊？
rows.tujia: A: lei4 ge3ci2 ou, ge3ci2-i-hu3 la, ge3ci2-ma1 xie2 tai2 ou? xie2-ma1 kuai2 eng3zi3-duo3-hu3, ang2 si1 gao1-hu3 la! B: se2 qie4 gao1-i? A: ang2ni1 se1pa1se1-i! B: kei3 a?
rows.english: A: Today let's have fun, let's have fun! Anyone coming to join in? Those who want to come, come quickly, we are about to start! B: What are you doing? A: We are going to celebrate the 'Sheba' festival! B: Where?

rows.translation: A：过舍巴节的那个老地点嘛，就是那个山坳，那大田里面去搞。B：每年都在那里搞啊！你们老人家们，我们也去，今天晚上全部都去那里搞。
rows.tujia: A: ei1 lao4 di2dian1 la1 se1-i ma, jiu1 ai1 se1pa1 ke1hao1, ai1 da2tian1 wo2tu1 gao1-i. B: la2 long1 hi4lie3 ai1 wo2tu1 gao1 wa! ni2 lao4reng3ga3-die1, ang2ni1 be2 hhi2, lei4 la3tie2 yi2si1 ai1 wo2tu1 gao1-i.
rows.english: A: We will go to the usual place, on the col over there, in that big field. B: Every year we hold it there! You old folk, we are going too, tonight we are all going.

rows.translation: A：好！那么，你把锣鼓也要拿来呀！B：我会拿锣鼓来。A：搬大鼓来！B：我会搬大鼓来。
rows.tujia: A: ca2! ai1me1, ni2 he3luo2 be2 huo3-di2-duo3 le! B: he3luo2 huo3-i-di2. A: da2gu1 be4-xie2! B: da2gu1 nga2 be4-i-di2.
rows.english: A: Good! So, you'll need to bring gongs and drums! B: I'll bring them. A: Bring the big drum! B: I'll bring it.

rows.translation: A：那一天，白天杀的那头猪，把毛拔光就挑来，你们四个男人去吧。四个人一起挑来，能不能挑来啊？B：可以挑。A：可以挑啊！B：会挑来！
rows.tujia: A: ei1 la2 nie1, ai1di1 ta1nie3ku3 zi4 bu2-bo3-xi2 la! ai1di1 leng3tong3tong1 ni2 guo2 ke4-i-di2-duo3, se2 luo4ba1 re1 la1hu3 luo! re1 long3 da4 ke4-xie2, ke4-di2-ta1ti1? B: ke4-de1xi3. A: ke4-de1xi3 hang. B: ke4-i-di2!
rows.english: A: That pig we killed during the day, you need to scald off the bristles. The four of you, bring it here. The four of you can fetch it; do you think you will be able to manage? B: No problem. A: You can! B: We will bring it!

rows.translation: A：棍子呢，我白天砍了，有四根，用那四根来挑上山。明宗宗要的，你别搞坏！B：不会搞坏的，会很好很好地拿来。
rows.tujia: A: gang1pe1 me nga2 ta1nie3ku3-lie1 ga4-bo3 re1 zi2 xie2, ai1 re1 zi2 huo3lie3 ke4-xie2, ba3 gu3-bo3. ming3zong3zong1 di4 la, ni2 nga2 ta4 gao1-si3 la! B: gao1-si3-ta1, re4kuo3kui1 re4kuo3kui1 huo3-di2.
rows.english: A: Those sticks, I cut them during the day, there are four of them, use them to carry it up the mountain. Ming Zongzong wants them, you mustn't spoil them! B: I won't spoil them, I'll bring them ever so carefully.

rows.translation: A：别沾泥土啊！B：好！A：我在前面开始准备，你们从后面来。B：好！（走路声）来了！A：要打着锣鼓来！要热闹啊！
rows.tujia: A: ba3zi2 ta4 pa3 o! B: ca2! A: nga2 zi1ge1 zun1bei3-hu3, se2 ta1nie1-lie1 eng3qie2. B: ca2! si3ya3si3ya3 eng3zi3 a! A: he3luo2 ha3-bo3 eng3zi3-duo3 la! lao2re1-duo3 hang! a, qing3gu1lian1 tai2 ba! B: sou2 la!
rows.english: A: Don't get them muddy! B: OK! A: I'll go first to prepare, you follow along afterwards. B: OK! (sound of walking) We're here! A: You need to beat the drums and gongs when you come, liven it up!

rows.translation: 啊，没有新娘吧！B：是呀！A：哎！一起做吧！B：开始做！开始做！A：我在这里全部摆好了！哎哟！我们的这个土王菩萨也摆好了。
rows.tujia: A: ai da4 ri1-i yo! B: ri1-hu3! ri1-hu3! A: nga2 ge3 yi2si1 bai4-hao1-liao3! a3nie3! ang2-nie3 tu1wan3-nie3 eng1di1 pu3sa3 be2 ang2ni1 bo3 bai4-bo3-la1-hu3.
rows.english: But where's the bride? [joke] B: True! A: Let's start work! B: Let's begin, let's begin! A: I've put everything out! Ah! I've also put out our Tuwang [ancestor] god.

rows.translation: 土王菩萨摆好了，然后你摆一张大桌子，摆吧！B：摆了。A：木盘子呢？B：摆了。A：别忘记在木盘子里面的那些糖食果品啊！B：不会忘记的。
rows.tujia: tu1wan3 pu3sa3 bai4-liao3 ang, ai1lie1, ni2 ai1lie1 da2 zuo2zi1 yi2 zang1 bai4-bo3 ang, bai4-bo3! B: bai4-liao3. A: ca3pang3 le? B: bai4-liao3. A: ca3pang3 wo2tu1-lie1, ni2 ai1 tang3si3 guo1ping1 ta4 si1ma3 la! B: si1ma3-ta1.
rows.english: Tuwang is set up, now, you put up a big table, set it up! B: Done. A: And the wooden tray? B: Done. A: Don't forget to put some sweets and fruit on the tray! B: I won't forget.

rows.translation: A：你搞两个香罐，摆好插香的那两个罐子。B：摆了。A：香呢？B：六根啊，一共六根，一个罐子里面插三根，两个罐子就是六根。
rows.tujia: A: ni2 xian1 guan2 nie1 long3 gao1-bo3, xian1 guan2guan1, ai1di1, ai1di1 ti1ku1 nie1 long3 bai4-bo3! B: bai4-liao3. A: xian1 le? B: wo3 zi2 luo, yi2ha1lie1 wo3 zi2 luo, guan2guan1 lao4 wo2tu1 suo1 zi2 luo, nie1 zi2 le jiu1 wo3 zi2.
rows.english: A: You fix a couple of incense jars, those incense jars, put out those two jars. B: Done. A: What about the incense? B: Six sticks, six sticks altogether, three in each jar, two jars, that makes six.

rows.translation: A：拿几张纸去！哼！拿几颗爆竹去。B：好！好！好！我快要开始了。
rows.tujia: A: ci1ki1ta1 ga4 hhi1 huo3-xie2! eng ao, pao2zu1 ya ga4 bu2 huo3-xie2! B: ca2! ca2! ca2! nga2 kai1si4-hu3.
rows.english: A: Get a few sheets of paper! Hmm, and bring a few firecrackers. B: OK, OK, OK! I'm ready to start.

rows.translation: A：好！你摆着酒，有没有摆好啊？B：摆好了。A：男人呢？B：男人站好了。A：女人呢？B：女人们到了。A：你那些儿童呢？B：儿童全部在后面啊！
rows.tujia: A: ca2! ni2 re2 zu1zu4-bo3, zu1-hao1 tai2 yo? B: zu1-hao1-liao3. A: luo4ba1-die1 le? B: luo4ba1-die1 zu1-hao1-liao3. A: ma3ma1-die1 le? B: ma3ma1-die1 ye4-ji2-liao3. A: ni2 ai1 bo1li3-die1 le? B: bo1li3-die1 yi2si1 ta1nie1 a!
rows.english: A: Good! You put the wine out, have you done it yet? B: Done. A: And the men? B: They're standing there ready. A: And the women? B: The women have arrived. A: How about the children? B: The children are following behind!

rows.translation: A：啊！真好啊！哎！今天晚上整个寨子都来了！每一户留一个人看家，然后剩余的全部回来看热闹来了！哎！准备好了！我们四个在前面拿着棍子。你怎么这样啊？
rows.tujia: A: a! za2si1 ma! ai! la3tie2 me yi2 zai2zi1 ming! la2 cuo4 la2 hu3 ka4-lie3 me, yi2si1 song1kuo1-ji2-diu2, yi2si1 lao2re1 ba4-diu2 wa ming! ai! zun1bei3-le! ang2ni1 zi1ge1 re1 la1hu3 o gang1pe1 za4-bo3. ni2 die3 qie4?
rows.english: A: Excellent! Tonight the whole village is here! Leave someone from every household to keep watch, the rest can all come to join in the fun. Everything's ready! The four of us, we'll be in front holding the sticks. What on earth are you doing?

rows.translation: 加油！早晨先生下山了。加油！加油！算命子先生下山了！财神的菩萨下山了！做工的菩萨下山了！哦！
rows.tujia: ang2cuo1hao3hai3! zao4gu1li1 xian1seng1 la xia2sang1-liao3 lu. ai1cuo1hao3cuo1hai3! suan2ming1zi1 xian1seng1 xia2sang1-liao3 ao! cai3seng3-di pu3sa3 xia2sang1-liao3 lia! zou2gong1-di pu3sa3 ba3 da3-liao3 lia! hou...
rows.english: Come on! In the morning, the men have come down from the mountains. Come on! Come on! The fortune-teller has come down from the mountains! The god of wealth has come down from the mountains! The god of labour has come down from the mountains!

rows.translation: 菩萨下来了！B：哪里呀？A：那菩萨开始下来、下来、下来了。算命子神仙下山了！
rows.tujia: pu3sa3 da3-diu2 la! B: kei3 ya? A: ai1 da3-diu2, da3-diu2, da3-diu2, pu3sa3 da3-diu2 wa, suan2ming1 seng3xian3 ba3 da3-liao3!
rows.english: The gods have come down! B: Where? A: They're coming down, coming down, the gods are coming down. The immortal fortune-teller has come down from the mountains!

rows.translation: 加油！加油！伙伴们啊！那财神菩萨又到了，又到了！伙伴们啊！加油！加油！加油！哦！
rows.tujia: hai1cuo1! hai1cuo1! a2guo1-die1 ai! ai1di1 cai3seng3 pu3sa3 you2 ye4-liao3, you2 ye4-liao3! a2guo1-die1! ai1cuo1! ai1cuo1! ai1ai1cuo1! hou
rows.english: Come on! Come on! Friends! The god of wealth has also come, he's arrived! Friends! Come on, come on, come on!

rows.translation: 到了！到了！好！好！那么，一起开始敬菩萨。把猪挑来，把猪挑来，把猪挑来。看，他们挑来了。
rows.tujia: ye4-liao3 wa! ye4-liao3! ca2! ca2! ai1 da4ha3 pu3sa3 jing2-hu3. zi4-ba1 ke4-i-xie2, zi4-ba1 ke4-i-xie2, zi4-ba1 leng3tong3 ke4-i-xie2, ke4-diu2 o.
rows.english: They've arrived, arrived! Great! Great! Now let's worship the gods together. Bring the pig, bring the pig, bring the prepared pig. Look, they're bringing it.

rows.translation: 好好地挑！B：好！我挑得起，我挑得。A：你挑得，别丢啊！不能丢啊！菩萨也来了，要好好地挑，哼！哼！快点把它放在大桌子前面，放置着，放置着，放置着，放置着。
rows.tujia: eng eng eng... cai3mo1 ke4! B: qie4 ca2! nga2 ke4-ce1, nga2 ke4-ce1. A: ni2 ke4-ce1 huo, ta4 la2 la, la2-ti2! pu3sa3 ye1 eng3zou2, cai3mo1 ke4! eng eng, kuai2dian1 da2 zuo2zi1 zi1ge1 ti1-bo3, ti1-bo3, la2-bo3, la2-bo3.
rows.english: ... Bring it carefully! B: That's OK, I can carry it, I can carry it. A: You can do it, don't drop it, don't drop it! The gods are here, carry it carefully! Bring it quickly and put it in front of the big table, put it down, put it down.

rows.translation: 哼！“今后土王菩萨，今后我们这个土家族的老百姓们，老人家们，我们全部都敬你了！
rows.tujia: ang "ai1 tu1wan3 pu3sa3, ang2ni1 ai1lie1, ang2ni1 eng1di1, ang2ni1 meng eng1di1 tu1jia1zu3-nie3 lao1be3xing1-die1, lao4reng3ga3-die1, yi2si1 ni2 bo3 pu3sa3 jing2-liao3 wa!
rows.english: "O Tuwang, here we are, ordinary Tujia folk,

rows.translation: 你保护着我们啊！我们呢，然后每年全部都去那里团聚，然后在哪里都不会有事，去下面了，
rows.tujia: ni2 meng ang2ni1 bao1hu3-bo3 o! ang2ni1 meng ai1lie1 la2 long1 la2 long1 yi2si1 ao1-bo3 yi3, kei2-bo3 hhi2 duo3 hong3huan4 ao, ba3ti3 da3-lie3,
rows.english: our ancestors, we all bow to you! May you protect us! We come to meet you here every year, so that wherever we go, things will go smoothly, when we go back down,

rows.translation: 我们没有病，有吃的、有喝的、又有穿的。你保护着我们哦！你保护着我们哦！我们有心来敬菩萨啊！
rows.tujia: ang2ni1 bing2 tai2 la, ga2-ci3 xie2, hu3-ci3 xie2, da2-ci3 xie2-duo3 o! ang2ni1 bao4-bo3 o! ni2 ang2ni1 bo3 bao4 o! ang2ni1 you1xing1 ang2 ni2 bo3 pu3sa3 jing2-di2-xi2 o!
rows.english: we won't be sick, we'll have enough to eat and drink, and enough clothes to wear! Protect us! Protect us! We are sincere, we have set out to worship you!

rows.translation: 今天晚上，今天是好日子，照顾的师傅，照顾的神，你保着我们，今天晚上请你，你已经到龙家了！”
rows.tujia: lei4 la3tie2pe2lu1, lei4 nie4 nie1lu1, zao2gu1-nie3 si1hu1, zao2gu1-nie3 pu3sa3, ni2 ang2ni1 bao4-bo3, ni2 lei4 la3tie2, ang2 ni2 qing4-alie3, ni2 long3jia1 ye4-liao3 o!"
rows.english: This evening, today is Nielu, our protectors, beloved gods, protect us, this evening we have come to invite you, you who have already gone to the netherworld!"

rows.translation: 哎！哎！加油！加油！算命子神仙下山了。早晨，神仙下山了。B：哎！真的，下山了，真的，到了！
rows.tujia: hai! hai! ai1cuo1! ai1cuo1! suan2ming1 seng3xian3 ba3 da3-liao3. zao4gu1li1 seng3xian3 ba3 da3-liao3. B: hai! zeng1di1hua1, ba3 da3-liao3, zeng1di1hua1 ye4-liao3 wa!
rows.english: Come on! Come on! The immortal fortune-teller has come down from the mountains. This morning, the immortals have come down from the mountains. B: Hey, it's true, they've come down, it's true, they're here!

rows.translation: A：加油！加油！开始吃饭！B：在哪里吃饭呢？A：在土地坛吃。
rows.tujia: A: ang2cuo1! ang2cuo1! ye3 ga2-i-hu3! B: ye3 kei2 ga2-i? A: tu1di2tang3 ga2-i.
rows.english: A: Come on! Come on! Let's start eating! B: Where shall we eat? A: We will eat at the Earth God's shrine.

rows.translation: 挑猪来，放好大锅子，放置着三颗石头，放置着三颗石头，放柴木在炕上。快点！快点！烧火，烧火，负责放置的人，放好吧！
rows.tujia: zi4-ba1 ke4 o! da2guo1zi1 duo1-bo3, a3ba3 suo1 bu2 duo1-bo3, a3ba3 suo1 bu2 duo1, ka3 kuo1lie1 ga3 duo1-bo3. kuai2dian1! kuai2dian1! mi4 luo2, mi4 luo2, duo1-ma1 duo1!
rows.english: Bring the pig! Put the big pot down, put it on top of three stones, put the stones down, and put some firewood on the stove! Quickly, quickly, light the fire, light the fire, those responsible for this, get on with it!

rows.translation: 我们大家，一户一碗，一户一碗，一个寨子有五十九个人，五十九个就五十九家。一户人家派一个人来吃饭，自己把自己的餐具拿来！
rows.tujia: hu2ni1 da4, la2 cuo4 la2 su1, la2 cuo4 la2 hu3, ang2ni1 yi2 guo2 zai2zi1 si1 wu1 si3 jiu1 guo2, wu1 si3 jiu1 guo2, jiu1 wu1 si3 jiu1 jia1. ang2ni1 la2 ma1 la2 hu3 ga2, qie3bi2pang1lang1 yi2si1 guo2duo3 guo2duo3 huo3-xie2!
rows.english: All of us together, a bowl per family, a bowl per family, altogether there are fifty-nine of us in the village, fifty-nine, that is, fifty-nine families. Every household send one person to eat, you need to bring your own bowls and chopsticks!

rows.translation: 全部到那里去吃，去土地坛搞，就到我们的土地坛，去那里煮。B：煮好了！煮好了！可以吃了，开始去搞呀！开始吃吧。
rows.tujia: yi2si1 eng1ge1 ga2-xie2, tu1di2tang3 gao1-i, jiu1 ang2-nie3 eng1ge1 tu1di2tang3 gao1-i, ao1jie3 bang2. B: bang2-hao1-liao3! bang2-hao1-liao3! ga2-duo3-hu3 ming! hhi2-la1-hu3 gao1 ya ming! ga2-hu3 ming!
rows.english: Everyone go there to eat, we'll do it at the Earth God shrine, at the Earth God shrine, we'll cook there. B: The cooking is done, it's done, let's start eating, off we go and eat, let's eat!

rows.translation: A：哎！开始吃饭！B：好！开始吃！A：来吃！来吃！吃！吃！B：你也吃啊！你怎么一口酒都不能喝呢？A：我可以喝，你也喝一口酒吧！
rows.tujia: A: hai! ye3 ga2-hu3 le! B: ca2! ga2-hu3! A: ga2-xie2! ga2-xie2! ga2! ga2 mang! B: ni2 be2 ga2 mang! ni2 qing3mo1 re2 la2 ze2 hu3-ti2 huo! A: nga2 hu3-di1xi3! ni2 le, ni2 be2 re2 la2 ze2 hu3-duo3!
rows.english: A: Right, let's start eating! B: OK! Let's eat! A: Come and eat, come and eat, eat, eat! B: You eat too! Why aren't you drinking any wine! A: I can drink some, and you, you must drink some too!

rows.translation: 好！今天很多东西，因为是敬神过舍巴节嘛！杀那么大的猪，如果不吃，干什么呢？是专门要吃才搞那么大的一头猪。
rows.tujia: ca2! lei4 ce3hu3ta3, pu3sa3 jing2 a ming! se1pa1se1 ming! ai1 zi4 he2ba3, zi4-ba1 he2ba3 bu2-bo3 mo3 ga2-ta1 qie4 ri1? zuan1meng3 ga2-i mo3 he2ba3 lao4 gao1-bo3-xi2 ming.
rows.english: OK! Today is very busy, what with worshipping the gods and celebrating the 'Sheba' festival. That pig, that pig that you killed, it's so big, if we don't eat it, why bother to kill it? We killed such a big pig because we specially wanted to eat it.

rows.translation: B：好！好！好！吃！吃！吃了！吃饱了！A：饱了！饱了就好！
rows.tujia: B: ca2! ca2! ca2! ga2! ga2! ga2! ga2-liao3 o! ga2 mo3 me3jie2-liao3 o! A: me3jie2-liao3 o! me3jie2-liao3 jiu1 ca2!
rows.english: B: OK, OK, OK! Eat, eat, eat! Eat your fill! A: Eat your fill, eat your fill! Good!

rows.translation: 那么，然后一起过舍巴节，正式开始过舍巴节，然后去过舍巴节的地点去过啊！
rows.tujia: ai1 da4ha3, ai1lie1 meng da4ha3 se1pa1se1-i-hu3 ming, zeng2si3 se1pa1se1-i ya, ai1lie1 se1pa1se1-nie3 di2dian1-bo3 hhi2, se1-i ya!
rows.english: After that, we will begin celebrating 'Sheba' together, we will start celebrating 'Sheba' properly, we'll go to the 'Sheba' place to celebrate.

rows.translation: 那就一起开始过！开始！B：好！A：准备！（一起工作的声音）
rows.tujia: ai1 jiu1 da4 se1-hu3 o! kai1si4 o! B: ca2! A: zun1bei3-bo3 o! tong3 tong3 tong3 kuan3 tong3...
rows.english: Let's start then! Let's start! B: Right! A: Get ready! (sound of working)

rows.translation: 开始种烟。B：好！（工作的声音）A：锄地，（工作的声音）砍荒山。
rows.tujia: yan1 se1-hu3! B: ca2! kuan3 tong3 kuan3 tong3 kuan3 kuan3... A: li4 pu2, tong3 tong3 tong3 kuan3 tong3... huo1sa1 ga4-i.
rows.english: Let's plant tobacco! B: OK! (sound of working) A: Hoe the ground, (sound of working) open up the wasteland.

rows.translation: 要移这几棵，到我们这个地方！这个一起。住在深山老林里，不靠这些荒地，你吃什么呢？
rows.tujia: gai2 ga4 pong2 yi3-duo3, ang2ni1 eng1di1 lang3cang3 a! eng1di1 da4ha3. ai1di1 kang3ku1 ong3-bo3 mo3 si2 sang1 wan2long3sang1 ong3-bo3 mo3 huo1sa1 da3bi2 ga4-ta1 ni2 qie4 ga2-i yo?
rows.english: You need to move these plants over here where we are, all together. Here we are, living surrounded by mountains, if we don't work the land, what will you have to eat?

rows.translation: 给我一把刀子，拿一把刀子来，开始砍！B：好！（工作的声音）A：开始砍！B：好！
rows.tujia: tuo1luo1su1ku1 nga2 bo3, zao2ri3su1ku1 la2 pa1 huo3-xie2, za2-i-hu3! B: ca2! pa3sa3... tong3 tong3 tong3 kuan3 tong3 A: za2-hu3! B: ca2!
rows.english: Give me a knife, and bring one of those knives, let's clear the ground! B: OK! (sound of working) A: Let's cut [the undergrowth]! B: OK!

rows.translation: A：那你烧一把火，你有没有火柴？B：我拿火柴，我拿着。A：扔给我，你去那边，燃了！（火燃的声音）
rows.tujia: A: ai1 ni2 mi4 la2 pa1 wu2 ma, ni2 yan3huo1 tai2 huo? B: nga2 yan3huo1 huo3-la1, huo3-la1. A: nga2 bo3 la2-xie2! ni2 eng1ge1la1bi3 hhi2, ra4-liao3! huo huo...
rows.english: A: You light a fire there, do you have any matches? B: I brought some matches, I brought them. A: Throw them to me, you go over there and light a fire! (sound of burning)

rows.translation: 热呀热！烧好了！烧得好！这一次烧着了，好！很好！
rows.tujia: ...gi3 ya gi3... eng gi3-hao1-liao3! gi3-bo3-xi2 ca2! eng1 la2 qie2 gi3-bo3-xi2, ca2! sang2jing1 a!
rows.english: It's burning, burning, all burned up! That was successful, we burnt that well! Excellent!

rows.translation: 哎！下雨也很好！B：会下雨的。下雨了！云头起了！下雨了！下雨了！下雨了！
rows.tujia: ei! me2 ga4 bu2 ze3 be2 sang2jing1 hang! B: ze3-di2. ze3-diu2 wa! ying3tu3 qi1-liao3 wa! me2 ze3-liao3 wa! ze3-liao3! ze3-liao3!
rows.english: Ah, if it would rain a bit, that would be excellent! B: It's going to rain. It's raining! The clouds are gathering, it's raining! It's raining, it's raining!

rows.translation: A：快些，快些！拿两颗小米来撒，撒两颗小米，撒两颗小米，两颗小米。（撒小米声）撒了吧？B：撒了！
rows.tujia: A: kuai2xie1, kuai2xie1, wu3 nie1 long3 huo3-xie2, sa4, wu3 nie1 long3 sa4, hhi3 nie1 long3 sa4, hhi3 nie1 long3. pian3 tong3 pian3 tong3... sa4-liao3 hang? B: sa4-liao3!
rows.english: A: Quickly, quickly, bring a load of millet seed to sow, sow a load of millet, sow a load of millet, a load of millet. (sound of sowing) Have you sown them? B: I've sown them!

rows.translation: A：撒完了没有？B：撒完了！ 一片山都要撒完了！A：好！然后一起，那么这时节要背玉米，背玉米，背玉米。
rows.tujia: A: sa4-ji2-liao3 tai2? B: sa4-ji2-liao3! yi2 pian1 sang1 duo3 sa4-ji2-liao3! A: ca2! ai1lie1 da4ha3, ai1me1 eng1 si3jie3 me bao1bu1 wo4-duo3, bao1bu1 wo4, bao1bu1 wo4.
rows.english: A: Have you finished sowing? B: All done! This whole area of hillside has been sown! A: Good! Now we have to carry up some maize, carry some maize.

rows.translation: 哎！按照人每人要背一个大背笼，小孩们每人背一个背笼。用背笼，下玉米的人下玉米，背的人就背。
rows.tujia: ai! zao2 reng3 rong1ti1 la2 da2 wo4-duo3, bo1li3-die1 le, wo3 la2 da2 wo4. wo3 huo3lie3 qie3-ma1 qie3, wo4-ma1 jiu1 wo4.
rows.english: Everyone must bring a large back-basket, the children must each bring a smaller one. Use your back-baskets, if you're supposed to be picking the cobs, pick them. If you're supposed to be carrying them, do so.

rows.translation: 我呢，来背玉米，你呢，就下玉米，我们几个背一回。B：好！（掉下声、草声）
rows.tujia: nga2 le guo2 wo4, ni2 le jiu1 guo2 qie3, ang2ni1 ga4 la1hu3 le yi2 hui3 wo4. B: ca2! kuan3 pong3tong3 pi3si3pa3sa3 pia3 pong3tong3...
rows.english: I'll carry the back-basket of maize, you pick the cobs, we'll go and take a load back. B: Fine! (sound of planting)

rows.translation: A：不能走路了！他的大背笼里面（草声）一下，还不能走路，还不能走路，我先走吧。（掉下声）蹦！倒掉了（把玉米倒下来）。
rows.tujia: A: ei! la4 hhi2-ti2! guo2 rong1ti1 wo2tu1 pa3sao3 la1di3, la4 hhi2-ti2-nie2, la4 hhi2-ti2-nie2, nga2 hhi2-pie3 la! pian3 pang3tang3 pian3 pang3tang3 beng4 die3 tu2-lu3.
rows.english: A: It's too heavy to carry! Take some maize from his large back-basket, he still can't carry it, still can't carry it. Let me go first! (sound of pouring maize) Pour it out!

rows.translation: B：好！有一背背笼了（满了玉米），你背去，快走！A：要背完，争取要背完这些玉米。
rows.tujia: B: ca2! la2 wo3 xiao2, ni2 wo4-lie3 hhi2, kuai2 hhi2! A: wo4-ji2-lie3-duo3, zeng1qi1 eng1di1 bao1bu1 wo4-ji2-lie3-duo3.
rows.english: B: OK! There's a back-basket [full of maize] now, you carry it, off you go, quickly! A: We must finish carrying it, we must work hard to finish carrying this maize.

sections.title: 2.1: 庆祝舍巴节（第一部分）
sections.meta_en:
Peng Wugen, Dianfang Township, Longshan County
recorded on 20 July 2002
sections.description_en: This text represents the first 10% of a mammoth 75-minute account of the economic and cultural life of the Tujia. Mr Peng describes the annual Spring shebajie festival, which is centred round the baishouwu (literally 'hand-waving') dance. The story is continued in the next text. Note the relatively high frequency of Chinese loan words used in this text, even by such a fluent Tujia speaker.

title: 庆祝舍巴节（第二部分）
documentTitle: 即席性的故事: 庆祝舍巴节（第二部分）

sections.description: 这是描述土家族经济与文化生活的叙述的第二部分，这部分也是全文本的十分之一，第一部分可以在上一段参阅。
sections.meta:
龙山县靛房镇彭武根先生
记录日期 20 七月 2002

rows.translation: 这个玉米有五十背，五十很少（意思是很多)。B：背完了。A：背完了吧，然后明天呢，一起去拣棉花，棉花一株一株地去拣！
rows.tujia: eng1di1 bao1bu1 wu1 si3 za1 xie2 la, dian1mei1dian1, wu1 si3. B: wo4-ji2-liao3. A: wo4-ji2-liao3 hang, ai1lie1 da4ha3 lao2zi1 le, da4 mian3hua3 [cou1] tu1, mian3hua3 la2 pong2 la2 pong2 mo3 tu1-xie2!
rows.english: We've got fifty loads of maize here, a 'mere' fifty. B: We've brought them all. A: All here, and tomorrow we will pick cotton together, bush by bush!

rows.translation: 拣得要好，别丢失，（拣棉花声）。B：拣完了。
rows.tujia: tu1-bo3-xi2 ca2-duo3, ta4 bie1li3, tong3... tong3qian3... B: tu1-ji2-liao3 o!
rows.english: You must pick carefully, don't drop any. (sound of picking cotton) B: All picked!

rows.translation: A：用袋子装着，袋子满了没有？B：满了。A：你的袋子满了没有？C：满了。A：他的满了吗？D：满了。A：拣完了吧，拣完了，一起走吧。（叫声）
rows.tujia: A: luo2tie1 huo3lie3 cu4-bo3 mang, luo2tie1 mang4-liao3 tai2? B: mang4-liao3. A: ni2-nie3 luo2tie1 mang4-liao3 tai2? C: mang4-liao3. A: guo2-nie3 mang4-liao3? D: mang4-liao3. A: tu1-ji2-liao3 hang, tu1-ji2-liao3, da4 hhi2 ya! eng3heng1 ao1hao3 ao1hao3....
rows.english: A: Put it in the bag. Is the bag full yet? B: Yes. A: Is your bag full yet? C: Yes. A: Is his one full? D: Yes. A: We've finished, finished picking, let's go. (sound of people calling)

rows.translation: 哎哟！这几天好热！这么热！怎么这么热！（叫风声）哎哟！那一起先喝一口凉水，先喝一口凉水。B：喝完了。
rows.tujia: ei1ya1! eng1 ga4 nie1 gi3 le, hang2 gi3! qing3mo1 hang2 gi3! si... ei1ya1! ai1 da4 lian3sui3 la2 ze2 hu3-pie3, lian3sui3 la2 ze2 hu3-pie3. B: hu3-ji2-liao3.
rows.english: Hey! These last few days have been hot, so hot! Why is it so hot? (sound of someone whistling for wind) Hey, let's go and drink some cold water first, drink some cold water first. B: That's enough.

rows.translation: A：我们一起走吧，有伴，伙伴们，伙伴们，走吧！别再坐着啦，我们一起有伴，回去吧！
rows.tujia: A: ang2 da4 hhi2-hu3, a2guo1 ca2, huo4jiao3-die1, huo4jiao3-die1 hhi2-hu3 la! ta4 ong3-bo3-gu2, da4 a2guo1 ca2, song1kuo1-hu3!
rows.english: A: Let's go, good friends, friends, friends, let's go! Don't just keep sitting there, we are friends, let's go back together!

rows.translation: 哼！呀！哎哟！加油！加油！然后一起到家了！
rows.tujia: heng! ya! ei1ya1! ai1cuo1... hei1huo1... ai1lie1 da4 cu1 ye4-liao3 ba!
rows.english: Hey! Ho! Come on! Come on! Let's get back home!

rows.translation: 翻过凹了吧！坡总是上完了，然后总是快活了，然后快当了。离家仅仅只有几步，然后把棉花放到家里，用簟子晒着。
rows.tujia: ngao2 ngao2 huan4-liao3 ba! ba3 huan2 gu3-ji2-liao3, ai1lie1 huan2 kuai2huo1-liao3, ai1lie1 kuai2dang1-liao3. cu1 lao3gu1lie1 ga4 ji3-lang2hu3, ai1lie1 cu1 la2-bo3, bu1se1 huo3lie3 lang3lang2-bo3.
rows.english: Over the saddle of the hill! We've finally finished climbing up the slope, we're happy now, it's going to be quick now. Home is only a little way away, we'll unload the cotton at home, and put it on bamboo mats to dry in the sun.

rows.translation: 晒着，天气好，晒着，棉花总是晒得好，晒完要拉。好了，拉了，又要一起纺棉花，要弹（变成棉絮）。
rows.tujia: lang3lang2-bo3, tian1qi1 ca2, lang3lang2-bo3, mian3hua3 huan2 lang3lang2-xi2 ca2, lang3lang2-lie3 ci3-duo3 ming. ca2-liao3 meng, ci3-liao3 meng, you2 da4 mian3hua3 za2-duo3, tang3-duo3 meng.
rows.english: Let it dry in the sun, the weather is good, let it dry, it always drys well in the sun, when it is dry we need to card it. Good, all the seeds are out, next we have to spin it and then fluff it.

rows.translation: 然后我来弹，用电，你用电来弹。来弹吧，来弹吧，你纺棉花吧，老人家！B：那么，我来纺棉花。哎！（纺棉花声）（纺棉花声）
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 nga2 tang3-adiu2, dian2 huo3lie3, ni2 dian2 huo3lie3 tang3-adiu2 le, tang3-adiu2, tang3-adiu2. ni2 mian3hua3 za2 mang, lao4reng3ga3-die1 mang! B: ai1me1 nga2 mian3hua3 za2. ai! rang2... pian3tong3...
rows.english: I will come and fluff it, we'll use the electric [machine], use electricity to fluff it, come and fluff it. You spin the cotton, old folk! B: Right, I'll spin some. (sound of spinning)

rows.translation: 纺完了！棉花这几天用几夜就把它纺了，用三夜纺完了，纺完了！A：好！
rows.tujia: za2-ji2-liao3 o! mian3hua3 eng1 ga4 nie1, ga4 pe1 lie3 guo2 za2, suo1 pe1 lie3 za2-ji2-liao3, za2-ji2-liao3, A: ca2!
rows.english: All spun! It's taken us several nights to get it spun, three nights and it's finished, all spun! A: Good!

rows.translation: 那就放在那里，收藏好。然后快要过年了！伙伴们，然后快要过年了！一起怎么过呢？
rows.tujia: ai1 jiu1 ao1 la2-bo3, jian1si3-bo3. ai1lie1 meng ci1ka1-hu3 mang, huo4jiao3-die1, ai1lie1 ci1ka1-hu3 meng! da4 qing3mo1 gao1-i le?
rows.english: Put it down here, to store. It's almost time to celebrate New Year. Friends, let's celebrate New Year! What should we do together?

rows.translation: 舂碓，有几颗小米，用碓去舂。用碓，要舂糍粑，快过年了，过年嘛！
rows.tujia: song2ga1 bu2, wu1suo1 ga4 bu2 xie2, song2ga1 huo3lie3 bu2-xie2 mang! song2ga1 huo3lie3 ba1ba1 bu2-duo3, ci1ka1-hu3 mang, ce3ka3 ci1ka1 ming!
rows.english: Pound it, here's some millet, pound it! Use the pounding apparatus to pound some 'baba' [glutinous rice cakes], it's almost New Year, New Year!

rows.translation: 过年么就一起要舂一碓糍粑。没有一碓糍粑舂，那你就不算过年了。你过什么年呢？
rows.tujia: ce3ka3 ci1ka1 me jiu1 da4 ba1ba1 la2 suo2 bu2-duo3 ming! ba1ba1 la2 suo2 bu2-ci3 tai2 me, ni2 bu2 suan2 ce3ka3 ci1ka1, ni2 qie4 ce3ka3 ci1ka1?
rows.english: Let's celebrate New Year, we must pound some 'baba' cakes together! If you don't have a pounder to prepare 'baba' with, how can you celebrate New Year, how can you celebrate New Year?

rows.translation: 你舂了糍粑，就一家人一起，大家一起坐着，一起。哎！你快快活活地过年吧！
rows.tujia: ni2 ba1ba1 bu2-alie3 jiu1 da4ha3, la1cuo1la1lai1 da4, hu2ni1 da4 ong3-bo3 mo3, da4ha3, ai! ni2 kuai2kuai1huo3huo3 mo3 ci1 la2 long1 ka1 ya ming!
rows.english: When you've pounded the 'baba', then each family together, each family sits down together. Have a happy time celebrating New Year!

rows.translation: 好！你们两个一起舂。B：好！（舂碓声）踩着，经常别这么搞。C：是啊，踩好了，你要取嘛。
rows.tujia: ca2! se2 nie1 hhi3 da4 bu2. B: ca2! jing2a1 kuan3tang3... kuan3tang3 za2-bo3 luo, jing1 duo3 hang2 ta4 gao1. C: sou2 la, za2-bo3-la1-hu3, ni2 a3-duo3 hang.
rows.english: Good, you two pound together. B: OK! (sound of pounding) Tread properly, don't tread it anyhow. C: Right! I'm treading it now, you take the pounded rice out.

rows.translation: B：大的漏到下面去了，我去取。你踩着，好好地踩着。你停了，我是不会帮忙的！手松开了的话，那就麻烦了，东西都做不成。C：是！
rows.tujia: B: lao3ga3 ai1 ba3ti3 he3-lu3, nga2 a3-i hang, ni2 za2-bo3, cai3mo1 za2-bo3 la! ni2 po1-liao3 si1 nga2 jie2 ong1-da2 la! jie2 bu1luo3-liao3 si1 da4 bu2die1 xia1xi1, ye3 duo3 ri1-bu1ceng3 la! C: sou2!
rows.english: B: A big piece has slipped down [to the bottom of the hole], I'll go and get it. You tread it, tread it well! If you stop, I won't lend a hand! If you take your hand off [the apparatus], I will get hurt and I won't be able to do anything. C: Right.

rows.translation: 好！A：你舂完了没有？B：舂完了。A：然后一起，然后就舂完了。舂完了，那么，你舂糯米。
rows.tujia: ca2! A: ni2 bu2-ji2-liao3 tai2? B: bu2-ji2-liao3. A: ai1lie1 da4, ai1lie1 jiu1 bu2-ji2-liao3 hang, bu2-ji2-liao3 me ai1me1 ni2 qie1hhe1 bu2!
rows.english: OK! A: Have you finished pounding? B: Done. A: Now, we've all finished pounding, all finished, now we need to pound glutinous rice!

rows.translation: 糯米也还是要舂几升，要做一点糖馓，要做一点糍粑。舂糯米！B：是！A：你把它用箩筐用背箩背来。
rows.tujia: qie1hhe1 be2 hai3si2 ga4 si3 bu2-duo3, sang1mi1 la2bie1 ri1-duo3, ba1ba1 la2bie1 ri1-duo3! qie1hhe1 bu2! B: sou2! A: ni2 guo2 luo3kuan3 bei1luo3 huo3lie3 wo4-xie2!
rows.english: We also need to pound several litres of glutinous rice, we need to make some 'tangsa' crisped rice cakes, and make some 'baba' glutinous rice cakes. Pound the glutinous rice! B: OK! A: Use baskets and back-baskets to bring it here!

rows.translation: 用那个小箩筐背来，用小箩筐背一背来。怎么每人只有一升左右的糯米。
rows.tujia: ai1 ka2ti1-ku3li1 huo3lie3 wo4-xie2, ka2ti1-ku3li1 huo3lie3 la2 wo3 wo4-xie2! ni2 zao2 reng3 qie1hhe1 la2 si3 zai2-lang2 bu2.
rows.english: Use a small back-basket to bring it, use a small back-basket to bring a load over here. Pounding only a litre of glutinous rice for each person isn't enough.

rows.translation: 哎！一升少了，要多少呢？B：五升，每人要五升，每人五升。没有外壳的（纯糯米），没有外壳的，要五升，不纯的不要！A：五升纯糯米，五升纯糯米。B：那我给你舂吧！
rows.tujia: ei! la2 si3 pu1ci3, gai4 di4 le? B: ong1 si3, luo4 la2 hu3 ong1 si3-duo3, luo4 la2 hu3 ong1 si3, a1ci3-ku3li1, a1ci3-ku3li1 ong1 si3 di4, mao3mao3ka3ka3 ta3hong2! A: a1ci3-ku3li1 ong1 si3, a1ci3-ku3li1 ong1 si3. B: ai1 nga2 ni2 bo3 bu2 o!
rows.english: Hey, one litre is not enough, how much should we have? B: Five litres, we need five litres per person, five litres each, husked rice, we need five litres of husked glutinous rice, we don't want any impure stuff! A: Five litres of husked rice, five litres of husked rice. B: I'll pound it for you!

rows.translation: 我，你那里没有碓啊！A：碓到那里田家湾姓田的家里有。那姓田的家里，那家，有一架碓呢，到那里舂。
rows.tujia: nga2, ni2 ai1 song2ga1 tai2 me! A: song2ga1 me ai1di1 eng1ge1 tian3ga3wan1 li1-nie3 tian3 jia1ka1 cu1 xie2 hang. ai1 se2-ka3 cu1, tian3 jia1ka1 cu1, ai1 se2-ka3 cu1 song2ga1 yi2 jia1 xie2, ni2 le ai1 cu1 bu2-i.
rows.english: I, there's no pounding apparatus at your place! A: A pounder, the Tian family in Tiangawan has one. That family surnamed Tian, that family has a pounder, go and pound it there.

rows.translation: B：好！（舂碓声）哎哟！我舂得汗水都出来了，你舂几下。
rows.tujia: B: ca2! kuan3tang3 kuan3tang3... jing2a1... ei1ya1! gu1ce3 duo3 zu2-liao3, nga2 die3 bu2 mo3, ni2 le ga4 dong2 bu2 luo.
rows.english: B: OK! (sound of pounding) Hey! I'm covered in sweat from pounding, you pound for a bit.

rows.translation: C：男人没有出息。B：那就是嘛。C：那就我来舂。B：你不能舂啊。A：男人互相抵，不是一样的男人吗？
rows.tujia: C: luo4ba1-die1 la4 tai2 ya. B: ai1 jiu1 si1. C: ai1 jiu1 nga2 le bu2. B: ni2 qie4 bu2-ti2, qie4. A: teng2, luo4ba1-die1 da4 teng2, da4ze3 luo4ba1-die1 bu2si1?
rows.english: C: As a man, why don't you have any staying power? B: That's right. C: I'll pound a bit. B: But you can't do it. A: Stop bickering, aren't we all men?

rows.translation: 现在我来舂，舂碓，有这么累嘛。B：你来舂吧。（舂碓声）
rows.tujia: nga2 le bu2-gu2, song2ga1 bu2, hang2 lao1huo4-liao3. B: ni2 bu2-xie2 le. hang kuan3tang3 kuan3tang3...
rows.english: I'll pound now, with the pounder, it is tiring. B: You come and pound! (sound of pounding)

rows.translation: 你可以做，力气好，力气好。A：舂完了，舂完了。你踩着，糯米舂完了，好了。
rows.tujia: ni2 ri1-de1xi3, xie1qi1 ca2, xie1qi1 ca2. A: bu2-ji2-liao3, bu2-ji2-liao3, ni2 za2-bo3, qie1hhe1 bu2-ji2-liao3, ca2-liao3.
rows.english: You can do it, you're strong, you're strong. A: The pounding's done, done, you tread it, all the glutinous rice has been pounded.

rows.translation: 一起走吧，要舂糍粑，那么一起舂糍粑，先做一下糖馓吧！要做糖馓，这几天做糖馓，做糖馓。B：好！好！好！
rows.tujia: da4 hhi2-hu3, ba1ba1 bu2-duo3 mang, ai1me1 da4 ba1ba1 bu2, sang1mi1 la1 ri1-pie3 o! sang1mi1 ri1-i, eng1 ga4 nie1 sang1mi1 ri1, sang1mi1 ri1. B: ca2! ca2! ca2!
rows.english: Let's go, we have to pound some 'baba', let's pound it together, but first make some 'tangsa' crisped rice cakes. We have to make 'tangsa', make 'tangsa' over these few days, make 'tangsa'. B: OK, OK, OK!

rows.translation: A：糖馓每人十块，每人只有二十块左右，别做多的，二十块。每人二十块，二十块，那就做吧。那一起做，蒸的人就蒸，你把甑子放着，要倒水，要烧柴。
rows.tujia: A: sang1mi1 luo4 la2 hu3 hi2 ci3, ai2 si3 kuai1 zai2-lang2 ri1, a1ri1 ta4 ri1, ai2 si3 kuai1, ai2 si3 kuai1, luo4 la2 hu3 ai2 si3 kuai1, ai1 ri1 mang, ai1 da4 ri1, tong4-xi2 tong4 luo, ni2 bong4 duo1-xie2! ce3 tu2-duo3, ka3 wu2-duo3!
rows.english: A: Ten cakes of 'tangsa' each, make about twenty each, don't make more than twenty. Twenty pieces, twenty pieces each, make them now. Let's work together, those who're steaming get on with steaming, you set up the steamer! You need to fill it with water, you need to light the firewood!

rows.translation: 那一百块，够或者不够？B：够了。A：一百块，一百块糖馓。B：糖馓一百块够了，很多了。A：好！一百块够了，很多了，很多了，然后去舂糍粑，那就一起舂糍粑吧！
rows.tujia: ai1 yi2 be1 kuai1 xiao2 wa tai2-nie2? B: xiao2. A: yi2 be1 kuai1, yi2 be1 kuai1 sang1mi1. B: sang1mi1 yi2 be1 kuai1 xiao2, gei4diu2 o! A: ca2! yi2 be1 kuai1 xiao2, gei4diu2, gei4diu2, ai1lie1 da4 ba1ba1 bu2-i ya, ai1 jiu1 da4 ba1ba1 bu2 eng!
rows.english: We have one hundred cakes now, is that enough? B: Enough. A: One hundred cakes, one hundred cakes of 'tangsa'. B: One hundred cakes of tangsa is enough, plenty for now. A: Good, one hundred cakes, that's plenty, plenty, let's go and pound the glutinous rice, let's go and pound the glutinous rice!

rows.translation: B：什么时候舂？A：过年的二十三舂，过小年。过完小年舂，过完小年舂糍粑！然后一起二十八呢，二十九呢，就过年，一起就吃现成的。B：是！
rows.tujia: B: qi2du1 bu2-i le? A: ci1ka1-nie3 ai2 si3 sang1 le bu2-i, ci1bi2 ka1, ci1bi2 ka1 le bu2 ya, ci1bi2 ka1 le ba1ba1 bu2-i-hu3! ai1lie1 da4 ai2 si3 ba2 me, ai2 si3 jiu1 wa, ci1ka1 me jiu1 da4 xian2-di ga2 hang ang. B: sou2!
rows.english: B: When shall we pound it? A: We'll pound it on the twenty-third day of the month before New Year, during 'Little New Year'. During 'Little New Year', we'll pound it during 'Little New Year'! Then on the twenty-eighth and the twenty-ninth, over New Year, we'll eat what we've made. B: Yes!

rows.translation: A：二十三，舂糍粑，可以舂了，蒸气都上完了。蒸气上完了，上完了，洗糍粑槽。
rows.tujia: A: ai2 si3 sang1 le ba1ba1 bu2. bu2-duo3-hu3, qi2 gu3-ji2-liao3 wa, qi2 gu3-ji2-liao3, gu3-ji2-liao3 ba1ba1 cao3 wo1 mang!
rows.english: A: On the twenty-third we pound 'baba'. Let's start pounding, we've finished steaming, we've finished steaming, that's done, now wash the 'baba' trough!

rows.translation: 那你们两兄弟舂糍粑吧，你们两兄弟舂糍粑吧！女人们呢，就摘糍粑，你们两兄弟舂一下糍粑，女人们摘一下糍粑。
rows.tujia: ai1 se2 qian1ngai4 lian1 hu3 ba1ba1 bu2, se2 qian1ngai4 lian1 hu3 ba1ba1 bu2 o! ma3ma1-die1 me ba1ba1 lao4 tie2 luo, se2 qian1ngai4 lian1 hu3 ba1ba1 lao4 bu2, ma3ma1-die1 me ba1ba1 lao4 tie2 ang.
rows.english: You two brothers, pound the 'baba', you two brothers, pound the 'baba'! The women will shape the 'baba' cakes, you two brothers pound the 'baba', the women will shape the 'baba' cakes.

rows.translation: B：是的！A：那你去打一筐（糯米）来。B：打来了。A：倒吧，舂！（打粑粑声）他又从那里打。（打粑粑声）
rows.tujia: B: sou2 la! A: ai1 ni2 la2 ha2 ha3-xie2 mang. B: ha3-diu2. A: tu2 luo, bu2 o! tang3a3, guo2 you2 eng1ge1 dang3a3...
rows.english: B: Right! A: Now you go and fetch a basket of winnowed rice. B: I've brought it. A: Pour it out and pound it! (sound of pounding) He's hitting from that side. (sound of pounding)

rows.translation: B：舂好了。A：这一碓取出来吧，你用挑棍来挑吧。挑，挑了你就把它放在石磨上面，那些妇女们就摘，摘了就一块一块做。
rows.tujia: B: bu2 mo3 ca2-liao3 eng. A: eng1 la1 suo2 a3-lie3 ba ang, ni2 ai1 xiao2tiao1 huo3lie3 xiao2 mang. xiao2, xiao2-lie3 ni2 bo1zuo1 ga3 la2-lie3 jiu1, meng ai1 ma3ma1-die1 jiu1 tie2 heng, tie2-lie3 meng la2 ci3 la2 ci3 ri1 heng.
rows.english: B: That's enough. A: Go and take what has been pounded, and use this shoulder pole to carry it. After carrying it, put it on the grindstone and then the women can make the cakes, they can make them one by one.

rows.translation: 哎哟！然后现在一起有了糍粑，糖馓有了，怎么搞呢？糍粑糖馓有了呢，就过年了，然后一起过年，过年吧。
rows.tujia: ei1ya1! ai1lie1 da4ha3 ba1ba1 ya xiao2, sang1mi1 ya xiao2, qing3mo1 gao1-i le? ba1ba1 sang1mi1 xiao2 me jiu1 ci1ka1 heng, ai1 da4 ci1ka1 heng, ci1ka1 a.
rows.english: Hey! Now we have enough 'baba', and enough 'tangsa', what shall we do next? We have enough 'baba' and 'tangsa', so let's celebrate New Year, New Year, celebrate together.

rows.translation: 今天是二十三，过年还有几天。
rows.tujia: lei4 die3 ai2 si3 sang1, ci1ka1 ai1 ga4 nie1 xie2-nie2.
rows.english: Today is the twenty-third, there are still a few days until New Year.

rows.translation: 哎哟！你要先给这个大哥娶一个媳妇，要先娶媳妇，要先娶媳妇，他要先娶媳妇。
rows.tujia: ei1ya1! ni2 eng1di1, eng1di1, eng1di1, eng1di1 da3guo1 bo3 zuo4 la2 hu3 lao4 a3-pie3-duo3, zuo4 ming a3-pie3-duo3, zuo4 a3-pie3-duo3, guo2 zuo4 a3-pie3-duo3!
rows.english: Hey! You first need to get a wife for this chap, first find a wife, first find a wife, he needs a wife first!

rows.translation: 过年前娶了，到了春天一起做工夫很忙，没有空娶。现在娶，现在娶。那么你和媒人一起商量一下吧！
rows.tujia: ci1ka1 yi1qian3 a3-lie3-gu2, cun1tian1 ye4-liao3 you2 da4 ye3 ri1-duo3, gao1-ta1-bie1. a3-lie3-gu2, a3-lie3-gu2, ai1me1 ni2 guo2 mei3reng3 da4ha3 sang1lian3 la2 ba4-i le.
rows.english: He needs to marry before New Year; once spring comes there will be lots of work to do, there won't be time to find him a wife then. Get him married now, get him married now, you discuss things with the matchmaker.

rows.translation: 所以就一起，那么就一起，给他娶，给大哥要问一位妻子（即娶媳妇），给他娶媳妇，给他娶媳妇。
rows.tujia: suo1yi1 jiu1 da4, ai1me1 jiu1 da4ha3 guo2 bo3, guo1guo1 tie2ba1 wa, luo3ga3ni2 la2 hhi3 se1li3-duo3. luo3ga3ni2 guo2 a3-xie2-gu2, luo3ga3ni2 guo2 a3-lie3-gu2 le.
rows.english: So together, together let's look for a wife. we need to find a wife for him, elder brother, ourselves. Find a wife for him now, find a wife for him now.

rows.translation: 那你把媒人找来。B：我去叫媒人，我去叫，我去叫：那个大姐啊！借一下你（耽误你的时间），要帮得到我们。M：怎么帮啊？
rows.tujia: ai1 ni2 mei3reng3 ni1-xie2! B: mei3reng3 nga2 jie3-i, nga2 jie3-i, nga2 jie3-i. ai1 da3jie1, ni2 la2, ni2 la2 ong1, ang2 da4xi4 ti3-duo3. M: qing3mo1 da4xi4 yo?
rows.english: You go and get the matchmaker! B: I'll call her, I'll call the matchmaker, I'll call: Sister, we need you to take a moment to help us. M: How can I help?

rows.translation: B：我们一起去他们家，那里我们（未来的）媳妇家走一趟。我们把我们的媳妇娶了。
rows.tujia: B: ang2 da4 ge4 cu1 eng1ge1, eng1ge1, ang2 pii2-ka3 cu1 yi2 zuan1 hhi2 luo. ang2 guo2 ang2-nie3 pii2 a3-lie3-gu2 luo.
rows.english: B: Let's go to their house together, we'll take a walk to the prospective daughter-in-law's home. We've now got a daughter-in-law.

rows.translation: 我们，你今天，过年二十三，我们腊月三十，一家人一起快要团圆，腊月三十团圆，腊月三十团圆，那就腊月三十团圆。
rows.tujia: ang2, ni2 lei4 ci1ka1 ai2 si3 sang1, ang2ni1 la2ye1 sang1 si3 le la1cuo1la1lai1 da4 tuan3yan3-lie3-hu3, la2ye1 sang1 si3 tuan3yan3, la2ye1 sang1 si3 tuan3yan3, ai1 jiu1 la2ye1 sang1 si3 tuan3yan3.
rows.english: Today, we are celebrating 'Little New Year', the twenty-third. On the thirtieth of the month, every household will have a family reunion, on the thirtieth there will be family reunions, on the thirtieth there are family reunions, on the thirtieth of the last month they have family reunions.
