title: 打猎对话
documentTitle: 即席性的故事: 打猎的对话

sections.description: 这是一篇即席性文本，生动地描述了土家族在50年代所采用的传统打猎方式。狩猎队伍必须先献祭给梅山神，才能出动。猎人在山上分散，形成一个大圆圈，把躲在树丛中的动物包围着；动物从圈中逃出来的时候，猎人就把它们抓住。打猎后，他们再次献祭给梅山神，然后就痛快地饱餐一顿。几百年前，土家族地区有许多不同种类的野生动物，包括老虎在内；直至60年代后期，猎物经常包括野猪和野鹿。近几十年来，由于不断的森林采伐，这里的野生动物已经很稀有了。最近，政府采取了“退耕还林”政策，让山坡的植被慢慢恢复，野生动物又逐渐增多了。
sections.meta:
龙山县靛房镇彭武根先生和彭景春先生
记录日期 18 七月 2002

rows.translation: A：哦！大家一起好好地听着，今夜是大年三十。吃完夜饭，要一起敬梅山神！B：好！
rows.tujia: A: o! hu2ni1 da4ha3 cai3mo1 ru3-bo3, la3tie2 sang1 si3 ye2, ye2huan1 ga2-liao3 le da4ha3 mei3sang3 pu3sa3 jing2-duo3 o! B: ca2!
rows.english: A: Right! Everyone listen carefully, tonight is New Year's Eve. When we've finished eating, we need to go together to worship Meishan [the hunting goddess]! B: Fine!

rows.translation: A：然后呢，你把你那里的那个火枪也要带来。B：带来了。A：火药么，给我也拿一袋来。B：拿来了。
rows.tujia: A: ai1lie1 me ni2 eng1ge1, ni2-nie3 ai1di1 huo1qian1 be2 kuai4-adi2-duo3. B: kuai4-adiu2. A: huo1yao3 wa wo1 bo3 da4 yi2 ti3 huo3-xie2. B: huo3-diu2.
rows.english: A: Now, you over there, you also need to bring your gun with you. B: I've got it. A: Gunpowder, bring a pouch of it for us. B: I've brought it.

rows.translation: A：然后呢，你叫一下田三干。叫一下田三干！B：田三干，一起走吧！A：那里，我就在那个突出的地方上面。B：哦！
rows.tujia: A: ai1lie1 me, ni2 guo2 ai1di1 tian3sang1gang1 la2 jie3. tian3sang1gang1 la2 jie3! B: tian3sang1gang1, da4 hhi2-hu3 la! A: eng1ge1, nga2 jiu1 me2la1ku1 bao1bao1 ga3ha2. B: o!
rows.english: A: Right then, you give Tian Sangan a call. Call Tian Sangan too! B: Tian Sangan, let's go! A: Over there, I'm going up onto that Melaku bluff. B: Ah!

rows.translation: A：你呢，就站在屋前面突出的地方上面。B：我就站在那里。A：我呢，就在梅亭上面。B：哦！A：他呢，就在纳堤山上。B：哦！
rows.tujia: A: ni2 le cuo4 zi1ge1 bao1zeng1 ga3 zu1zu4-bo3. B: zu1zu4-bo3-la1. A: nga2 le jiu1 me2ting1 ga3. B: o! A: guo2 me jiu1 nie3ti3 ku1za4 ga3. B: o!
rows.english: A: You, position yourself on the outcrop in front of that house. B: I'm standing there now. A: I'll go up to Meting. B: Right! A: He can go up on to Nieti Hill. B: Fine!

rows.translation: A：我们一起动身了！B：好！来了！哦！A：你在哪里啊？B：就在前面一段路。A：啊！在纳堤山上的那一个人，你没听见吗？好！听到了就好！我就从这里叫！（打猎呼叫）那你叫吧！B：（打猎呼叫）
rows.tujia: A: ang2 da4 dong2seng1-liao3! B: ca2, eng3zou2! o A: kei3 ye4-liao3 wa? B: zi1ge1 la4dao1. A: a! nie3ti3 ku1za4 ga3-nie3 ei1 la2 hu3, ni2 xi4-da2 huo? ca2! xi4-liao3 jiu1 ca2! nga2 ge3-lie1 jiu1 wo3! jie3 ya! o ai1 ni2 jie3 luo! B: wo3wu4...
rows.english: A: Let's set off then! B: Right, we're off! A: Where have you got to? B: I'm on the path in front. A: Hey! You there on Nieti Hill, can you hear me? Fine! If you can hear me, that's great. I'll call from here then. (hunting cry) ... your turn! B: (hunting cry)

rows.translation: A：开枪吧！开一枪大的！B：好！A：对那纳堤山上放一炮，然后一起回家啊！
rows.tujia: A: cong2 po1 mang! lao3ga3 yi2 pao1 po1! B: ca2! A: ai1 nie3ti3 ku1za4 ga3-bo3 yi2 pao1 po1, ai1lie1 da4 song1kuo1-i o!
rows.english: A: Open fire! Fire a big shot! B: Right! A: Fire there over towards Nieti Hill, then we will come back together!

rows.translation: 在那路上呢，我们就一起边叫边回来，要边喊边回来！B：好！（打猎呼叫）（枪声）（打猎呼叫）
rows.tujia: ai1 la4ku1tu3 le, ai1 jiu1 da4 wo3hong1 wo3hong1 mo3 eng3zi3-duo3 la, wo3 jie3 mo3 eng3zi3-duo3 la! B: ca2! wo3wu4... dong3a3 dong3a3... wo3wu4 wo3wu4...
rows.english: On that road, we need to come back calling our hunting cries together, calling as we go! B: OK! (hunting cry) (gunshots, hunting cries)

rows.translation: A：然后敬梅山。B：好！A：把木盘子拿来！B：拿来了。A：啊！梅山菩萨的衣服、裤子、帕子、鞋子、袜子，好好地放在盘子里面。B：好好地摆好了。
rows.tujia: A: ai1 mei3sang3 jing2. B: ca2! A: ai1 ca3pang3 di1di1-axie2! B: di1di1-adiu2. A: ang! mei3sang3 pu3sa3-nie3 ku3, si1ba1, zong2ba1jie2zu1 a, cuo3xie2, wa2zi1 ai1 wo2tu1 re4kuo3kui1 mo3 bai4-bo3. B: re4kui2 bai4-bo3-la1-hu3.
rows.english: A: Now let's worship Meishan. B: Right! A: Bring the wooden tray! B: I've brought it. A: Ah! Meishan's clothes, trousers, headscarf, shoes, socks. Lay them all out neatly on the tray. B: They're all laid out neatly.

rows.translation: A：哼，纸香呢？B：好！全部都在那里了。A：那么你点了蜡烛吗？B：点了。A：香呢，点了吗？B：点了。
rows.tujia: A: ang ci1ki1ta1 xian1 a? B: ca2! yi2si1 ao1-cai3 ye4-ji2-liao3. A: ai1me1 ni2 la2zu1 ti2-liao3 hang? B: ti2-liao3. A: xian1 a ti2-liao3 hang? B: ti2-liao3.
rows.english: A: Hmm, what about the paper for burning and the incense sticks? B: Yes, everything is there! A: Now, have you lit the candle? B: It's lit. A: The incense, have you lit it? B: Yes.

rows.translation: A：好！那我们大家一起都站在那里吧，一起开始敬菩萨啊！B：哦！A：跪着！跪着！B：跪好了。A：磕一个头。B：烧了。A：磕两个头。B：烧了。A：磕三个头。B：烧了。（打猎呼叫）
rows.tujia: A: ca2! ai1 jiu1 hu2ni1 da4ha3 eng1ge1 zu1zu4-bo3-xie2, da4ha3 pu3sa3 jing2-hu3! B: o! A: ki4-bo3! ki4-bo3! B: ki4-bo3-la1-hu3. A: ka1ta1 la2 bu2 bu2. B: wu2-liao3. A: nie1 bu2 bu2. B: wu2-liao3. A: suo1 bu2 B: wu2-liao3. wo3wu4...
rows.english: A: Good! Now let's all stand over there together, and worship the goddess together! B: Right. A: Kneel! Kneel! B: We're kneeling. A: Kowtow once. B: I've burnt a few pieces of paper. A: Kowtow once more. B: The paper's been burnt. A: Kowtow a third time. B: The paper's been burnt. (hunting cry)

rows.translation: A：梅山菩萨啊！我们呢，今夜三十夜给你敬了。然后你今后呢，我们无论在哪个地方打猎，我们都可以得到猎物。
rows.tujia: A: ai1 mei3sang3 pu3sa3 o! ang2ni1 le lei4 la3tie2 ni2 sang1 si3 ye2 po1-bo3 jing2-liao3. ni2 ai1lie1, jing1hou2 le ang2ni1 kou2 si3jie4, ang2ni1 hong3huan4 ti3-ce1.
rows.english: A: Goddess Meishan! We have come here on this New Year's Eve to worship you. From now on, wherever we are hunting, may we always be successful.

rows.translation: 我们追鹿就得到鹿，赶野猪就得到野猪。我们捉麝香鹿就得到麝香鹿，我们捉一只麂子也可以得到。捉两只猴子就把它们的后腿捆着，然后养着它们。捉到鹿呢，
rows.tujia: ang2ni1 la2ji1 jie4 la2ji1 ti3-ce1, ye1zu1 zuo2 ye1zu1 ti3-ce1; ang ang2ni1 se2xian1 zuo2 se2xian1 ti3-ce1; ang2 ji1zi1 lao4 zuo2 be2 ti3-ce1. hhe4 nie1 long3 zuo2, ji3pa2 ga3 ti2 long4-bo3-hu3. la2ji1 le,
rows.english: If we hunt deer, may we find them; if we go after wild boar, may we catch them; if we look for musk deer, may we find them; if we look for a muntjac, may we catch one. If we catch a couple of monkeys, we will tie them by their back legs and raise them; if we catch a deer,

rows.translation: 你就把它用夹子套着。然后一起在正月初一，明天正月初一大年初一，大年初一，有枪的人全都拿着去打猎，带两只狗去。B：好！
rows.tujia: ni2 guo2 jiu1 ri4 huo3lie3 tao2-bo3-hu3. ai1 jiu1 da4ha3 zeng1ye1 cu1yi2, lao2zi1 zeng1ye1 cu1yi2, da2nian3 cu1yi2, da2nian3 cu1yi2, cong2 xie2-ma1 yi2si1 huo3 o, si3jie4-i, ha4lie3 nie1 long3 cuo4-xie2. B: ca2!
rows.english: you can use a clamp to hold it. Then together on New Year's Day, tomorrow is New Year's Day, New Year's Day, everyone who has a gun, bring it and we will go hunting. Bring a couple of dogs too. B: Fine!

rows.translation: A：嘿！这里捉到了一只野猪，快来啊！这只肯定有三百斤！B：是真的！
rows.tujia: A: ai! eng1jie3 ye1zu1 lao4 za4-duo3liao3, kuai2 eng3qie2! eng1di1 lao4 huan2 sang1 be1 jing1 xie2! B: zeng1di1hua1!
rows.english: A: Hey! We've caught a wild boar over here, come quickly! This one must be all of three hundred pounds! B: You're right!

rows.translation: A：嘿！叫景生哥哥把那个，那边的那个，在朗库那一条路拦阻着。B：好！A：白林呢，你就把后面的那条路拦着。C：我拦着了。
rows.tujia: A: ai! jing1seng1 guo1guo1 jiao2 ai1di1, eng1ge1la1bi3-nie3 ai1di1, lang3ku3-nie3 ai1di1 qian2 la4 zi2 duan4-bo3. B: ca2! A: bai2ling3 le, ang ni2 jiu1 ta1nie1-nie3 qian2 la2 zi2 duan4-bo3. C: qian2 la2 duan4-bo3 la.
rows.english: A: Hey! Ask Jingseng to handle that, that one over there, block that path over there on Langku. B: Right! A: Bailing, you block the path over the back. C: I'm blocking it now.

rows.translation: A：年生呢，你快做了！别玩了。你去看一下后院那个坎，然后把它围住。D：好！A：田梅，你快点把狗带去，那只狗，叫那个人把它放了。E：好！
rows.tujia: A: eng nian3sang1 le, ni2 kuai2xie1 ri1-lie3! ta4 ge3ci2, ni2 guo2 ai1 yan3gu2, ai1di1 hao3kang4 ba4-i, hao3 ngang1-bo3. D: ca2 la! A: tian3mei2, ni2 kuai2xie1 ni2 guo2 ai1 ha4lie3 cuo4-lie3, ha4lie3, guo2 ai1di1 lao1 jiao2 po1-xie2. E: ca2!
rows.english: A: Niansang, get a move on! Don't mess about. You go and look after the pit in the backyard, and set up the hurdle for the door. D: Right! A: Tianmei, quickly take your dogs, tell that chap to let the dog come. E: Right!

rows.translation: A：那我们就开始啦！拦着！鹿出来了！野猪也出了一只了。它们一起跑走了，走了！拿火枪的！在上面拦阻的人！注意着！野猪到你下面了！它正在蹲在你那下面，
rows.tujia: A: ai1 jiu1 da4 kai1si4 o! duan4-bo3! la2ji1 zu2-liao3! ye1zu1 wa lao4 zu2-lu3. da4 dang1guo3-lu3 la! zao3 la! ye huo1qian1! qian2 ga3ha2 duan4-ma1-die1! zao1hu1-bo3! ni2 ai1 ji3ta3 ye4-liao3! ni2 ai1 ji3ta3 gu1du4-bo3-la1,
rows.english: A: Now we can start! Block the paths! Here comes the deer! And there's a wild boar as well! They've gone off together! They're gone! Those with guns! You lot up there! Look out! The wild boar is over there below you! It's crouching down below you,

rows.translation: 我从这里都看得很清楚。B：看得很清楚。A：哎！得了！得了！得到一只鹿，带来了！哎！得到一只鹿了。B：带来了！带来了！A：很好！很好！
rows.tujia: nga2 ge3-lie1 duo3 yi3 ca2-la1tai2. B: yi3-liao3 da4ze3 la. A: ei! ti3-liao3... ti3-liao3! la2ji1 lao4 ti3, cuo4-liao3 wa! ai! la2ji1 lao4 ti3. B: cuo4-liao3! cuo4-liao3! A: sang2jing1! sang2jing1!
rows.english: I can see it very clearly from here. B: As clear as crystal. A: Hey! Got it! Got it! Caught a deer! I've brought it here! Hey! We've caught a deer! B: Got it! Got it! A: Great! Great!

rows.translation: 我们也一共只有一二十个人，今天晚上可能每人会有一斤左右了。B：那快去帮忙，还好。A：然后一起挑，一起开始回家。B：然后一起回去吧！
rows.tujia: ang2ni1 be2 luo4 lao3gu1lie1 yi2 ai2 si3 guo2-lang2 ming, lei4 la3tie2 be2 hui1 jing1 ba1 xie2. B: ai1 da4xi4-duo3-hu3, ya2-hao1. A: ai1lie1 da4 ke4-lie3 da4 song1kuo1-i-hu3. B: ai1lie1 da4 song1kuo1-i.
rows.english: There are only twenty of us altogether, there'll be about a pound of meat each tonight. B: Quickly go and help then. We're lucky today. A: We'll carry it home together on a shoulder pole. B: Let's head back home.

rows.translation: A：伙伴们，一起回去吧！B：好！回去吧！A：那些男人们呢，你们不要到处跑。
rows.tujia: A: huo4jiao3-die1, da4 song1kuo1-i-hu3! B: ca2! song1kuo1-i-hu3! A: ai1di1 luo4ba1-die1 le, se2 ke3du1 hhi2-ta1-duo3.
rows.english: A: Friends, let's set off home! B: Right! Let's go! A: You lads, don't run off all over the place.

rows.translation: 大家都来吧！我们一起数一下人。B：好！ A：要点几个人。到底有几个人啊？到家了也一起每个人，每人到底有一斤、两斤还是一两呢？好算啦。
rows.tujia: yi2si1 eng3qie2! ang2 da4 reng3tu3 dian4. B: ca2 la! A: luo4 ga4 long3 dian4-duo3, luo4 dao2di1 gai4 xie2? cu1 ye4-liao3 be2 da4ha3, luo4 la2 hu3 lao4 la2 qi1 xie2 huo1 nie1 qi1 xie2, yi2 lian1 xie2 huo1 da4 suan2 ca2 la.
rows.english: Everyone here! Let's count heads. B: OK! A: We need to know how many we are. How many are we after all? When we get home, we need to work out how much each one will have, a pound, two pounds or less. We'll work it out.

rows.translation: 那么给做工的人要除去多少呢？给打猎的人。B：送那些男人的（指打猎的人）。A：那两只狗呢？B：那些男人的，应该先除掉。A：那应该除。B：那应该除。A：哎！好！
rows.tujia: ai1me1 you2 gai4 cu3 le? ri1-ma1-suo1 bo3. B: ai1 luo4ba1 hu3-nie3 si2. A: ai1 ha4lie3 nie1 long3 la. B: ai1 luo4ba1 hu3-nie3 cu3. A: ai1 ying2gai1 cu3. B: ai1 ying2gai1 cu3. A: ai ca2!
rows.english: How much should we give for those who've done the work? For the hunters. B: Give the hunters some. A: What about the two dogs? B: First take some for the men. A: Take theirs. B: Take theirs A: Right!

rows.translation: 那我们总共一起是二十五个，加两只狗是二十七个。还有提供夹子的也算一个人，算二十八个。
rows.tujia: ai1me1 ang2ni1 zong1gong2 yi2ha1lie1 si1 ai2 si3 wu1 guo2, ha4lie3 nie1 long3 ai2 si3 qi2 guo2, ri4 la2 pu1 le la2 hu3 suan2, ai2 si3 ba2 guo2.
rows.english: So, altogether there are twenty-five of us, plus two dogs, that makes twenty-seven, then add the one who provided the clamp, twenty-eight in all.

rows.translation: 二十八个，那差不多一个人会有多少？一个人会有一斤半，一斤半。B：一斤半就一斤半吧。A：那么就一斤半吧。
rows.tujia: ai2 si3 ba2 guo2, ai1 ca1bu1duo1 hui1 gai4 xie2, luo4 la2 hu3? lao4 die3 la2 qi1 bang1 hui1 xie2, la2 qi1 bang1. B: la2 qi1 bang1 meng la2 qi1 bang1 mang. A: ai1me1 la2 qi1 bang1 o.
rows.english: Twenty-eight, how much roughly will each one have? A pound and a half each, a pound and a half. B: A pound and a half's fine. A: A pound and a half it is, then.

rows.translation: 那鹿的那些内脏呢？哎！快些快些！放锅子，把锅子放在这里，煮一下，煮一下，煮一下，煮一下。
rows.tujia: ai1, ni2 ai1me1 mao3ni1xia2huo1 le? ai! kuai2xie1 kuai2xie1! ta2ku1 duo1, gao2-cai3 ta2ku1 duo1, yi2 luo2, yi2 luo2, yi2 luo2, yi2 luo2.
rows.english: What about the deer's entrails? Hey, quickly, quickly! Set up the pot, put it over there, cook, cook, cook.

rows.translation: 煮好了，你又要敬菩萨。B：要敬菩萨哦。A：啊！那么快些快些，内脏呢？B：好！A：这个肝啊、肺啊、胃啊、肠子啊，肉啊，都搞一点儿。
rows.tujia: luo4-lie3 ni2 you2 pu3sa3 jing2-duo3 mang. B: pu3sa3 jing2-duo3 o. A: eng! ai1me1 kuai2xie1 kuai2xie1, mao3ni1xia2huo1 la? B: ca2 la! A: eng1di1 gang1 a, hui2 ya, se3pe3 ya, bi2la1 ya, si3 ya, la2bie1 gao1 ya.
rows.english: When it's cooked, you have to worship the goddess again. B: Yes, we must worship the goddess. A: Quickly, quickly, where are the innards? B: Right! A: The liver, lungs, stomach, intestines, meat. Cook a bit of everything.

rows.translation: 哦！用这个每一样搞一点。我捅肝，你切。你用竹子棍把它们连成一串。B：好！
rows.tujia: o! eng1di1 huo3lie3 la1ye3la1si1 la2bie1 gao1. nga2 gang1 tong1, ni2 suo4 luo, ni2 guo2 mu4nie3 ka3zu3 huo3lie3 li4-bo3. B: ca2!
rows.english: Oh! Use this to cook a bit of everything. I'll pierce the liver, you slice it and then string the pieces up on bamboo splints. B: Right!

rows.translation: A：你然后把一圈一圈肝往开水里面荡一下，然后搞一点饭。然后熟了就一起倒给菩萨，就一起做，好敬。
rows.tujia: A: ni2 ai1lie1 qian1 qian1 huo3lie3 huo3lie3 ce3 sa2gi1 wo2tu1 yi2 dang4 luo, ai1lie1 mang1mang1 bi3bi1kui1 la1 gao1 o, ai1lie1 meng da4 a1jie1-liao3 meng pu3sa3 la1 tu2-lie3 jiu1 da4 ri1, jing2 ca2 hang.
rows.english: A: Then scald each piece of liver in hot water, and cook a bit of rice. When it's cooked, give some to the goddess, then we can worship her together properly.

rows.translation: 敬了呢，今后我们捉猎物的时候，就不会出问题，我们朋友一场，他总是会保护着我们的。B：好！好！
rows.tujia: jing2-liao3 me jing1hou2 zuo2, ang2ni1 zuo2-la1-hu3 hang, weng2ti3 zu2-ta1, yi2 cang3, ang2ni1, guo2 ang2ni1 huan2 hu1-bo3-i hang. B: ca2! ca2!
rows.english: Once we've worshipped her, whenever we go hunting in the future, we won't have any problems. We're all friends here, she will always protect us. B: Great! Great!

rows.translation: A：年年这样搞就更好了，一起也好玩。去做吧，走吧。正月间，大年初一就一起开张了！
rows.tujia: A: la2 long1 hi4lie3 eng1 da4ze3 gao1 me la4li3die2 le, be2 da4ha3 ge3ci2 ca2 hang. ri1-i, hhi2 o. zeng1ye1-gang1 a ming, da2nian3 cu1yi2 jiu1 da4 kai1zang1-liao3!
rows.english: A: Every year it's right that we do things this way, it's also good to enjoy ourselves together. We'll start now. Let's go. The beginning of the year, it's only New Year's Day and we've already caught something!

rows.translation: 大年初一就得到肉，那很好！这个说起来就是新年大吉，新年大吉啊！B：开张开得好！A：开张开得好！好！
rows.tujia: da2nian3 cu1yi2 jiu1 si3 lao4 ti3, ai1 sang2jing1 a! eng1 li3-di hua1 le hai3si2 xing1nian3 da2 re4, da2ji3 xing1nian3 da2ji3 ming! B: kai1zang1-xi2 ca2! A: eng kai1zang1-xi2 ca2!
rows.english: Getting meat on New Year's Day is really good! This is truly a New Year's blessing, such good luck on New Year's Day! B: This is a brilliant start to the year. A: A good start to the year! Yes!

rows.translation: 那么就一起开始敬菩萨吧！都来吧。B：好！ A：那茶罐放了吧！B：放好了。A：放好了。哎！（打猎呼叫）然后一起结束了！回家吧！B：好！
rows.tujia: ai1me1 jiu1 da4ha3 pu3sa3 jing2-hu3! yi2si1 eng3qie2. B: ca2 la! A: ai1 ca3guan3 ti1-liao3! B: ti1-liao3. A: ti1-liao3 hang. ai! wo3wu4... ai1lie1 da4 jie3su3-liao3! song1kuo1-i-hu3! B: ca2!
rows.english: So let's go together and worship the goddess! Let's go! B: OK! A: Put out the tea caddy! B: It's done. A: It's done. (hunting cries) Now everthing's finished! Let's head home! B: OK!

sections.title: 2.3: 打猎的对话
sections.meta_en:
Peng Wugen & Peng Jingchun, Dianfang Township, Longshan County
recorded on 18 July 2002
sections.description_en: This impromptu text is a vivid portrayal of a traditional Tujia hunt in the 1950s. The hunters begin by making offerings to Meishan, the hunting goddess, and then the hunt proceeds. Men scattered over the hillside form a ring to drive game hiding in the undergrowth into an increasingly small area. Catchers trap the animals as they try to escape. The story ends with a feast after further offerings to the hunting goddess. In previous centuries many different species of wild animals were hunted, including tigers. More recently deer and wild boar were hunted, until game became scarce as a result of deforestation, which began in the late 1960s. Recent reafforestation is beginning to restore the high hillsides to their former splendour and wildlife is increasing again.

title: 有关老虎的故事
documentTitle: 即席性的故事: 关于老虎的故事

sections.description: （播放整段）即席性的故事: 关于老虎的故事
sections.meta:
龙山县靛房镇彭武根先生
记录日期 18 七月 2002

rows.translation: 那时我只有七岁。
rows.tujia: na2 si3jian1 lao3gu1lie1 qi2 sui2 xie2-xi3-nie2.
rows.english: At that time I was only seven years old.

rows.translation: 我今天去背柴，我母亲叫我：“孩子，你今天去背一捆柴，家里没有柴了。你得到几根就背几根，你背一个小背笼去，几根就行了。”
rows.tujia: nga2 lei4 ka3 wo4-xie2, nga2 a3nie1, guo2 nga2 jiao3: "bo1li3, ni2 lei4 ka3 yi2 kong4 wo4-i, cu1 ka3 tai2 la, ga4 zi2 ti3 ga4 zi2, ni2 wo3bi3 ca1cei1 lao4 wo4-lie3, ga4 zi2 xie2 jiu1 xing3liao3."
rows.english: That day I was to go and fetch firewood. My mother called me: "Son, go and fetch a bundle of firewood today, there's none left in the house. Get what you can, take your small back-basket, whatever you find will be fine."

rows.translation: “好！我去背柴，我今天去背柴，我吃完早饭就去背。”我去背了，我背着柴背到叫梯陆的地方。
rows.tujia: "ca2! nga2 ka3 wo4-i, nga2 lei4 wo4-i o, nga2 zao4huan3 ga2-lie3 jiu1 wo4-i-hu3." nga2 wo4-xie2, nga2 wo4-lie3 kei2di1 di2dian1 me jiu1 ti4lu3 jie3-la1.
rows.english: "OK! I'll go and get firewood, I'll go today. I'll finish my breakfast and then go." So I went. I carried the firewood to a place called Tilu.

rows.translation: 我一个人啊，只我一个人，我走呀走，没有觉得害怕。到了大路上，啊！下面有一只美丽的老虎！那里很亮（刺眼）像铜钱一样，尾巴有一庹长。
rows.tujia: nga2 la2 hu3 luo, nga2 la2 hu3 luo, nga2 be2 hhi2 a, hhi2 a, ge4-dao2. da2lu1-sang1 ye4-liao3, ei1 ba3ti3 a1nie1 a1di1 li2 lao4 re4-xi3! ao1du1 qi3hua1 tong3kuo3zi1 da4ze3, lie3pong2 yi2 pai4 hhe3 xie2.
rows.english: I was all alone, just me, walking along, not afraid at all. When I reached the main track, there below me was a beautiful tiger! Those eyes, bright as copper coins, made me dizzy; his tail was over a yard long.

rows.translation: 我们这样对视了一下，我看见它了，我怕死了。然后我特别紧张！今天我看见老虎！摔了！
rows.tujia: nga2 da4 huo2 ba4-lie3, nga2 guo2 yi3-alie3, nga2 ge4-si3-la1-hu3. nga2 ai1lie1 xing1 li1kuo1luo1 jing1zang1 la! nga2 lei4 li2 ba4! da2-lie3!
rows.english: We eyed each other, I looked at him and I began to feel scared to death. Then my heart started thumping like mad, I've seen a tiger today! I fell!

rows.translation: 腰间一躬！蹦地跳下两丈远的坎里，（老虎的沙沙声）！啊！啊！啊！汗淋淋了！怕死了！怕死了！柴都不背了，就回家去，回家去，回家去！
rows.tujia: yao1gang1 yi2 gong1! ta2ka1 beng4 die3 nie1 zang1 hhe3 tiao2-lie3, pa3sao3sao3 la1di3 la! heng! niao3! niao3! gu1ce3 cang3cang3-liao3! ge4-si3-liao3! ge4-si3-liao3! ka3 duo3 wo4-tao1, song1kuo1-i-hu3, song1kuo1-i-hu3, song1kuo1-i-hu3!
rows.english: The tiger arched its back. It jumped twenty feet right down into a pit, with a rustling sound! Oh! Oh! I was dripping with sweat and scared to death. Really scared to death. I didn't even take the firewood. I'm going home! I'm going home! I'm going home!

sections.title: 2.4.1: 遇到老虎
sections.meta_en:
Peng Wugen, Dianfang Township, Longshan County
recorded on 18 July 2002
sections.description_en: These texts describe three individuals' very different encounters with tigers. In earlier centuries the region abounded in wildlife, including tigers and leopards and other large game. Although their numbers had already started to decline in the early 20th century, tigers still posed a considerable threat to livestock right up into the 1960s, when deforestation rapidly destroyed the large contiguous areas of forest habitat required by the tiger. Tigers were still seen in the 1970s (Tian Shunliang, the author of the second text below, saw one as late as 1975), and tiger paw prints were occasionally found locally in the 1980s. Today, the South China tiger is almost extinct in China, although small numbers probably survive further south in the jungles along the common border of Guangdong Province with Hunan, Jiangxi and Fujian Provinces.

sections.description:
龙山县靛房镇彭武根先生
记录日期 18 七月 2002
sections.meta:
龙山县坡脚乡田顺良先生
记录日期 19 七月 2002

rows.translation: 那一年是1962年，家里养了母猪，猪圈在水井附近。有两只母猪，其中有一只生了两只崽子。我有（不祥的）感觉，第二天出去看了一下，有一只小猪不见了。
rows.tujia: ai1 la2 long1 si1 yi2 jiu1 lu2 ai2 nian3, cuo4-nie3 zi4-ni3ga3 long4-la1, zi4-nie3 ce3mong2-ta3. zi4-ni3ga3 nie1 long3, ai1 lao4 bi2bi1 nie1 long3 xia2-lie3. me3 ri1-la1, di2ai2 hu3 lao4 zu2-lie3 la1 ba4-lie3, lao4 yi3-da2,
rows.english: It was 1962, we were raising sows, and the sty was near the well. There were two sows, and one gave birth to two piglets. I had a [bad] feeling, and when I went out to have a look the next day, one piglet was gone.

rows.translation: 然后我认为是被人家偷了。然后夜晚的时候，我就拿了一枝枪挂在肩上。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 nga2 zi2 xian4 luo4die1 duo3 hhe2-lu3. ai1lie1 lang3qi1-cai3 jiu1, nga2 guo2 ai1lie1 cong2 a la2 zi2 kuai4-xie2.
rows.english: I just thought someone had stolen it. So that evening, I had slung a gun over my shoulder

rows.translation: 然后我去守猪，它（指老虎）正在猪圈门的上方的栏杆上面蹲着定睛地看着。嘿！我准备去打他，是这么想的。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 nga2 ka4-xie2, ai1lie1 zeng2zai1 guo2 zi4cuo4 ai1di1 la1meng3, ai1di1 ka1tao1 lang3gang3 ga3ha2 gu1du4-bo3 mo3 zi1-bo3-la1. ei! nga2 guo2 zun1bei3 ha3-i, hang2 xian4,
rows.english: and gone out to keep watch [by the sows]. There it was, [a tiger], right by the sty, by the door, crouching on top of the railings, and staring intently. I got ready to shoot, or at least that was my plan.

rows.translation: 嘿！我一只手呢，抱着一床被子，另一只手呢，就拿着枪。然后我悄悄地把被子往地上一放，可能老虎呢，就发现了我。
rows.tujia: ai! nga2 jie2 la2 ci3 le you si1lang1 la2 pi1 be4-bo3-la1, la2 ci3 le you2 jiu1 cong2 kuai4-bo3-la1. ai1lie1, nga2 ka3kei1die3 si1lang1 li4ti3 la2 po1, kuo1neng3 li2 le, guo2 nga2 hua1jiao3-liao3,
rows.english: One of my hands was clutching a quilt, and the other, that was holding the gun. So I quietly put the quilt on the ground, but perhaps the tiger heard me.

rows.translation: 然后我准备给枪装弹药，弹药都装了。我还没有把弹药装好，老虎就跑走了。嘿，就这么看见过一次。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 nga2 zun1bei3 cong2 bang1 du1 bang1-liao3, nga2 bang1 mo3 ceng1tu1 ti3-da2-nie2, guo2 duo3 beng4 die3 yi2 dong2 le jiu1 xi4ca3-lu3. ai, jiu1 hang2 la2 qie2 yi3.
rows.english: Then I prepared the gun, loading it with powder, but I hadn't finished when the tiger jumped down and ran off. So, that was the time I saw [a tiger].

sections.title: 2.4.2: 老虎与猪崽
sections.meta_en:
Tian Shunliang, Pojiao Rural Township, Longshan County

sections.description_en:

sections.description:
龙山县坡脚乡田顺良先生
记录日期 19 七月 2002
sections.meta:
永顺县大坝乡田心桃女士
记录日期 05 八月 2002

rows.translation: 我的伯父他们打老虎。
rows.tujia: nga2-nie3 a3qi4-nie3 ge4ze1 li2 ha3.
rows.english: My family and my uncle's family fought a tiger.

rows.translation: 我的父亲,他在山里守牛，“我看着它，我一个人在这里守牛，为什么看见两头牛呢？”
rows.tujia: a3ba1 lao4 xie2, guo2 kang3ku1 wu2 ka4, ngo1 guo2 ba4 mo3 be a, "eng nga2 la2 hu3 gei2du1 wu2 ka4, qing3mo1 wu2 nie1 la1hu3 xie2 la?"
rows.english: My father was looking after his cow in the hills, "I was looking at it; here I am on my own looking after our cow, so why are there two of them?"

rows.translation: 嘿！他仔细地看了一下。“老虎！”，他害怕极了，然后爬到山上去了，爬到一棵树上后，
rows.tujia: ei! guo2 la1 ba4-lie3. "li2 ou", guo2 ge4-lie3, kang3ku1-bo3 gu3, ka3mong3 ga3ha2 gu3, ka3mong3 ga3ha2 gu3-lie3,
rows.english: He looked carefully at it: "Tiger!". He was really frightened, and up the hill he went, up a tree he climbed, up he went.

rows.translation: 他就喊呀喊呀：“ 哎哟！来人啊！来人啊！山里有一只老虎在咬我的牛啊！”
rows.tujia: guo2 jiu1 jie3 a, jie3 a: "ei1ya1, luo4 eng3qie2, luo4 eng3qie2! kang3ku1 li2 lao4 nga2-nie3 wu2 ga2 la!"
rows.english: He shouted and shouted: "Hey! Help! Help! There's a tiger in the mountains, eating my cow!"

rows.translation: 我们的房子很大，有很多人。哦！我们都去那里打老虎，打老虎。
rows.tujia: ang2 cuo4 le qi4-nie3-xi2, luo4 le a2bu1 ri3. hou ma2ni1 yi2xi1 eng1ge1 li2 ha3, li2 ha3-lie3.
rows.english: Our household was a big one, with lots of people. We all went there to fight the tiger and kill it.

rows.translation: 那只老虎！枪呢都是“爪子枪”。老虎呢，我们的一个伯伯开一下枪。开枪以后，那只老虎呢，从枪烟中走向我们。
rows.tujia: a1di1 li2 a, cong2 le yi2si1 zua3zi3cong2, guo2 le, ang2-nie3 be3be1 lao4 cong2 la1 ha3, la1 ha3 yi1hou2, a1di1 li2 ou, cong2-nie3 ke2ka4 da4ha3 mo3 eng3jiu3.
rows.english: That tiger! The guns they had were a special type of gun. The tiger, one of our uncles fired a shot at it. After firing the shot, that tiger, it came towards us out of the gunsmoke.

rows.translation: 它抓了我们伯伯的头。好！它就死了，到底死了没有呢？我们的伯伯就骑着它，他和老虎一起打架。
rows.tujia: guo2 ang2-nie3 a2be1 kuo1ba1 la1 za4, hao4! guo2 jiu1 se2-liao3, se2 [huo1] se2-da2, ang2-nie3 ang1bei1, guo2 jiu1 ji4-bo3 mo3 a a1di1 li2 da4 da4ha3,
rows.english: The tiger took a swipe at my uncle's head, and died; but was it dead or not? There was my uncle, straddling the tiger, fighting with that tiger.

rows.translation: 伯伯一只手拿着老虎的胡子，一只手抱着它的脖子。他们一起打架。哎哟！在山里的悬崖上面滚来滚去，滚呀滚呀，都盖满泥土。
rows.tujia: guo2 guo2-nie3 ma1pa3 za4-bo3, jie2 la2 qi3 li2-nie3 kong1di1 be4-bo3, guo2 guo2 da4ha3 da4ha3. yo! kang3ku1 la a3sa3 gai4 [gao1] ga3ha2 geng1ke4-lie3 geng1ke4, geng1ke4-lie3 ba3zi2, ba3zi2, ba3zi2 ri3.
rows.english: He held the hair under its chin in one hand, cradling the tiger's neck with the other, struggling together. They rolled around there on the steep mountainside, rolling to and fro, there was a lot of mud.

rows.translation: 好！那只老虎呢，它也没有力气了，老虎会咬断伯伯的手。哎哟！我们一家都很急，急死了，老虎会咬死他，伯伯的手也快要被咬断了。
rows.tujia: hao4! a1di1 li2 ye, guo2 be4-tao1, guo2-nie3 jie2 be2 die3-la1-hu3 a. ei1ya1! ang2-nie3 la2 cuo4 ji2di1ji2ga2 ou, se2 la, li2 guo2 bo3 ga2 mo3 se2 la, li2 guo2 bo3 jie2 be2 ga2-bo3 die3 la.
rows.english: Well, that tiger, it couldn't hold him, and was about to break my uncle's arm. Our household was on tenterhooks. The tiger was biting him, tried to bite his arm and break it.

rows.translation: 哎哟！一家都很急，我们很怕老虎，我们，老虎好像在爬一样。我们随便扔东西打老虎。
rows.tujia: ei1ya1! yi2xia4 la2 cuo4 ji2di1ji2ga2 ou, ang2ni1 li2 ge4di1ge4ga2, ang2ni1, li2 a xi1pa1-la1 da4ze3. qie4 hui1 mo3 li2 ha3.
rows.english: Well! Our household was very anxious, we were terrified of the tiger, we, the tiger seemed to be crawling still, so we hit it with whatever we could find to hand [and so it died].

rows.translation: 我们还有一个伯伯，他们那里的人少，他们建了一栋专门用来打老虎的房子，这个房子里面呢，再建一个小房子，小房子里面呢，捆着一只狗。
rows.tujia: a4duo3 ang2ni1 be3be1 lao4 xie2, ge4ze1 a1duo1 luo4 you2 luo4 pu1ci3, ge4ze1 a1duo1 a li2 ha3-nie3 cuo4 lao4 su2. ge3di1 cuo4 wo2tu1 le a4duo3 a bi2kui1 cuo4 su2-bo3; bi2kui1 wo2tu1 le ha4lie3 lao4 ti2-bo3.
rows.english: Another of our uncles came from a part where there were few people; they had built a tiger trap, inside the outer cage they built a smaller one, and put a dog inside, tied up.

rows.translation: 晚上，老虎来了，（虎吼声），老虎，它要咬狗。（狗叫声）
rows.tujia: lang3cei1, li2 eng3jiu3 hong3tong3... wa li2, guo2 ha4lie3 ga2-duo3. ha4lie3 be2 kuan3kuan3kuan3... ei!
rows.english: At night a tiger came, roaring, and wanted to bite the dog. The dog was also growling.

rows.translation: 嘿！这只老虎呢，就走进房子里面，我们很快关上门。用枪打老虎，把它关在里面，你打一下，他打一下，就用枪打死了老虎。
rows.tujia: ge3di1 li2 a, ei1 cuo4 wo2tu1 la hhi2, beng4, la3-zu2 la, hou ma3li2 a, cong2 a, li2 ha3, la3-bo3 mo3 cu3 li2, ni2 la1 ca3, guo2 la1 ha3, hou cong2 jiu1, li2 a jiu1 ha3 se2 la.
rows.english: Well, that tiger, he went into the kennel in one bound, and they shut the kennel door. Quickly, the gun, shoot the tiger, keep the door closed, you two take turns to hit it, well, the gun, they shot the tiger dead.

title: 龙山县土匪（第一部分）
documentTitle: 即席性的故事: 龙山县的土匪（第一部分）

sections.description: 这是龙山县南部一位声名狼籍的土匪的故事，这些土匪在1949年解放前活跃在这一带的山区。在当土匪之前，田高粱本来是排长，是控制当地的军阀的下属。因为他的领导对他起了妒忌之心，田高粱就逃到他砂乡以北的新地村去了。在那里，他组织了匪帮，他的手下就开始到处掠夺抢劫。他曾经被捕，坐了三年牢。释放后，他得到了另一个军阀的支持，当了村长；可是，他同时继续匪帮的掠夺活动。当他获悉解放军要把当地匪帮铲除的消息后，就逃到一个山洞里；终于，匪帮被军队包围，田高粱也被枪杀了。故事的大结局可以在下一段参阅。
sections.meta:
龙山县他砂乡鲁邦珍先生
记录日期 30 一月 2003

rows.translation: 信地村的田高粱，个子很高大。
rows.tujia: xing2diu1 tian3gao1lian3, luo4 tie2ba1,
rows.english: Tian Gaoliang from Xindi village, he was a big fellow.

rows.translation: 头呢，有大鼎罐那么大，耳朵呢，有手掌那么大。眼睛呢，非常亮，像老虎眼睛一样，眼睫毛呢，往天上伸着的，很黑。
rows.tujia: kuo1ba1 le nie3 deng1guan3 he2ba3 xie2; eng3qie2 le jie2bi1ta1 he2ba3 xie2; luo2bu1 le ceng3ta3 ceng3ta3, li2 luo2bu1 da4ze3; luo2bu1 si2ga4 le me2 ga3-bo3 zi2zi1-bo3-xi2, lang2ga1zao3zao3;
rows.english: His head, it was as big as a large rice pot; his ears were as big as the palms of your hands; his eyes were very bright, like tiger's eyes; his eyebrows, they reached straight up to the sky, they were jet black;

rows.translation: 鼻子呢，又扁，有茶树果子那么大，又偏；嘴巴呢，像山洞一样。
rows.tujia: eng2qi4-bu2li1 le you2 bi3gua3ta3, ca3pao1 he2ba3, you2 pian1-ga1ca3; za2qi1 le a3tu3 da4ze3.
rows.english: his nose, it was flat, and as big as the fruit of the tea tree, it was also crooked; his mouth was like a cave.

rows.translation: 他们家呢，很穷，他们家呢，什么都没有，弟兄又多。他十多岁的时候呢，他就到洗车刘团长那里去当兵。
rows.tujia: ge4 cu1 le qiong3, ge4 cu1 le tai2, guo2 qian1ngai4-die1 you2 po1la1. guo2 la2 hi2 ta2ci1 xiao2 le, guo2 jiu1 xi1ce3 liu3 tuan3zang3-nie3 eng1ge1 bing1dang1-xie2.
rows.english: Their home was poor, their home had nothing, and he had many brothers. When he was ten or so, he went to Xichehe to serve as a soldier under Commander Liu.

rows.translation: 当了兵呢，这个人，他不识字，他人很狡猾，又聪明，他又会做人。他和任何人的关系都好，人家看见他呢，自然怕他，又对他好。
rows.tujia: bing1dang1-lie3 le, eng1 luo4 la2 hu3, guo2 ci1ci1 ha1tai2 le, guo2 luo4 hhe4jing1, guai1-xi3tai2, guo2 you2 luo4 ri1-hhe1, guo2 a3se4 da4 duo3 dao1ca2, luo4die1 yi3-liao3 le, guo2 zi2 ge4, you2 guo2 ca2.
rows.english: After becoming a soldier, this man, he was illiterate, but he was as sly as a monkey demon, he knew how to get on with other people. He got on with everyone, and when people saw him, they were naturally in awe of him, so they treated him well.

rows.translation: 刘团长在哪里打仗，总是带着他。他参加了呢，总是打赢，不会输。那么，枪也得了。好，后来呢，他当了班长。
rows.tujia: liu3 tuan3zang3 kou2-cai3 dui2wu1 ha3 huan2 guo2 la2 hu3, guo2 cang1jia1-liao3 le, huan2 ha3 mo3 ying3, su1-ta1, ai1 cong2 a ti3-liao3. hao4 qing3nie2 le, guo2 bang1zang1 dang1-liao3.
rows.english: Wherever Commander Liu fought, he always took him along, and when he took part, they always won, never lost. That's how he managed to get a number of guns. Well, afterwards, he served as a squad leader.

rows.translation: 当了班长呢，他更加有劲了。他更加起劲了，然后打几次队伍，他都赢了，他每次都参加了。他那个声名在全团都知道了，后来他又当了排长。
rows.tujia: bang1zang1 dang1-lie3 le guo2 ye2geng1 jing2 xiao2, guo2 ye2geng1 qi1jing2-liao3, ai1lie1 dui2wu1 ji1 ci2 ha3 duo3 guo2 ying3-liao3, huan2 guo2 la2 hu3, guo2 ai1 ming3yi2 you2 qian3 tuan3 hao4rou3, qing3nie2 guo2 you2 pai3zang3 dang1-liao3.
rows.english: As squad leader, he became more powerful than ever, even more energetic. When they fought other bands, he won every time, it was always him. His reputation spread throughout the whole corps, and later he was promoted to platoon leader.

rows.translation: 然后呢，他不识字，他人最聪明，他对战争里的情况最熟悉。当了排长后，人们看到他的样子越来越不对劲了。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 meng, guo2 ci1ci1 ha1tai2 ya, guo2 luo4 zui2 guai1-liao3, guo2 zang2 wo2tu1, guo2 zui2 hao4ri3. pai3zang3 dang1-lie3 le, luo4 kang2duo1 kang2duo1 yan2zi1 bu2die1liao1.
rows.english: Now, he was illiterate, but he was a very clever man, and he understood fighting. As platoon leader, people found him even more terrifying.

rows.translation: 刘团长就怕了他：“这个，这个三排长，要把他除掉。如果不除掉他的话呢，到最后我的枪都会被他带走我的枪都会被他带走。
rows.tujia: liu3 tuan3zang3 jiu1 guo2 ge4-liao3: "eng1di1 ya, eng1di1 suo1 pai3zang3, si2si1, guo2 si2si1-ta1-di hua1 le, sa2guo1-lu3, guo2, nga2 cong2 guo2 duo3 ye4-ji2-lie3-hu3,
rows.english: Commander Liu became afraid of him: "This, this No.3 Platoon Leader, I need to get rid of him. If I don't get rid of him, in the end my guns will be taken away by him.

rows.translation: 然后，他就当那个队伍的领导，到最后我又会被他，他会把我打死的。我用主意，我要把他杀了。”
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 guo2 dui2wu1 dang1-hu3. sa2guo1-lu3, nga2 you2 guo2 duo3, guo2 ngo2 ha3-si3-i, nga2 guo2 zu1yi3 si4-bo3, nga2 guo2 jiu1 bii2-lie3 ti3-xi3."
rows.english: Then he will become commander of the troops. In the end, I will be killed by him, I must make a plan, I must kill him."

rows.translation: 这个刘团长呢，心里就有了这个想法。他就和洗车河的有钱人王珍斋一起说：“你请我们吃一顿饭。
rows.tujia: eng1di1 liu3 tuan3zang3 le jiu1, me3ke3ce1 tu1 jiu1 xing1 qi1-liao3. guo2 guo2 jiu1 xi1ce3huo3 xie2ma1 wan3zeng1zai1 da4ha3 li3: "ni2 ang2ni1 qing4-bo3 la2 mong2 ga2,
rows.english: This Commander Liu, this was what he was thinking. So he spoke with Wang Zhenzhai, a rich inhabitant of Xichehe: "You invite us for dinner,

rows.translation: 你叫我们吃一顿饭，我吃这顿饭的时候呢，我把三排长，把三排长杀了，只有四五个人。”
rows.tujia: ni2 ang2ni1 jie3-bo3 la2 mong2 ga2, nga2 eng1di1, eng1di1, eng1di1 mang1mang1 ga2-zu2 le, nga2 guo2 sang1 pai3zang3, suo1 pai3zang3 bii2-lie3-hu3, luo4 re1 hhi3 ong1 hhi3-lang2."
rows.english: you invite us for dinner. When I'm eating this, this meal, I'll have No.3 Platoon Leader, No.3 Platoon Leader killed, there'll only be four or five men at the meal."

rows.translation: 刘团长呢，他就请了三排长和三排长最要好的两位朋友。枪就放在袋子里面藏着。
rows.tujia: liu3 tuan3zang3 le, guo2 jiu1 sang1 pai3zang3, suo1 pai3zang3 ge4 da4 zui2 dao1ca2-xi2 nie1 hhi3. lian3qian1 le luo2tie1 tu1 kuai4-bo3-xi2, su1su1-bo3-xi2.
rows.english: Commander Liu, he invited No.3 Platoon Leader, and two of his closest friends. They brought guns, hidden away in their bags.

rows.translation: 好！三排长呢，他就把桌子摆好了，然后他就（掉下声）得坐在神龛下面去了。
rows.tujia: hao4! sang1 pai3zang3 le, suo1 pai3zang3 le, guo2 jiu1 zuo2zi1, eng1di1 si3tie2 bai4-ji2-liao3, guo2 jiu1 pian3 die3 seng3kang3 ji3 ong3-liao3,
rows.english: Well! No.3 Platoon Leader, No.3 Platoon Leader, he finished laying the table, and then plopped himself down below the ancestral shrine.

rows.translation: 眼睛到处看，他往外面看着，他什么时候都注意着：“你们今天要取我的命，你们今天要取我的命。
rows.tujia: luo2bu1 ji1li1gu1lu1 ji1li1gu1lu1 dao2cu1 ba4-lie3, guo2 wo4ta3-bo3 ba4-bo3 mo3, guo2 qie4 si3jie3 duo3 zu2yi1-bo3-xi2, "se2 lai4 nga2 ming2 a3-i, se2 lai4 nga2 nie3hhe2 a3-i ya,
rows.english: His eyes were darting everywhere; he looked outside, paying attention all the time: "Today you are planning to take my life, today you are planning to take my life,

rows.translation: 那我也要注意着，我也必须注意着。”一边喝酒呢，一边喝酒呢，一边用手拿着粮枪。
rows.tujia: ai1 nga2 be2 zu2yi1-bo3-duo3, nga2 be2 zao1hu1-bo3 ti3-xi3." bian1 re2 hu3 le, yi2 bian1 re2 hu3 le yi2 bian1 jie2 huo3lie3 lian3qian1 ga3 za4-bo3.
rows.english: so I must stay alert, I must stay alert." He drank wine at the same time, drinking wine, all the time with his hand on his gun.

rows.translation: 吃菜的时候，喝酒的时候呢，他一直都在注意那两个拿着枪的弟兄。那收在袋里面的枪，把那个注意着，注意着。
rows.tujia: ha1ce1 ga2-zu2, re2 hu3-zu2 le guo2 jiu1 luo2bu1 huo3lie3 qie4 si3jie3 duo3 ai1 ge4 da4 dao1ca2-nie3, ai1, ai1di1 qian1ngai4 nie1 hhi3, lian3qian1 ai1 tu1 su1su1-bo3-nie3 ai1 zu2yi1-bo3-xi2, ai1 zao1hu1-bo3-xi2.
rows.english: Whether they were eating or drinking wine, he kept his eyes wide open, all the time watching those 'good friends', those two brothers, with their guns hidden away, fully alert, fully alert.

rows.translation: 然后刘团长就说：“三排长，你为什么一边吃东西，手里还要边拿着枪呢？”
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 liu3 tuan3zang3 jiu1 li3-la1: "suo1 pai3zang3, ni2 qing3mo1 bian1 ye3 ga2 jie2 lian3qian1 za4-bo3-duo3 le?"
rows.english: Then Commander Liu spoke: "No.3 Platoon Leader, why do you keep holding your gun while you are eating?"

rows.translation: 田回答说：“团长，信东坳和利子坳的队伍，时时刻刻都在抢这些老百姓的钱。我打他们打习惯了，我总是要手里拿着枪。”
rows.tujia: "tuan3zang3, xing1dong1ngao2, li3zi3ngao2 dui2wu1 si3si3ke3ke3 lao1be3xing1-nie3 eng1di1, eng1di1 tong3qian3 a4yi3, nga2 ge4ze1 ha3 guan2si1-liao3, nga2 huan2 lian3qian1, lian3qian1-jiao3 za4-bo3-duo3."
rows.english: He replied: "Commander, the troops in Xingdongngao and Lizingao regularly rob the villagers, I've become used to fighting them, so I always have a gun ready in my hands."

rows.translation: 然后，刘团长呢，就心软了，这个，这个打他，今天杀不到他了。他失望了，吃了几口。这个三排长啊，三排长啊！
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 liu3 zi3hui3 le, me3ke3ce1 tu1 le jiu1 ruan4-liao3, eng1di1, eng1di1 guo2 ha3, guo2 lei4 bii2-duo3-ta1ti1, yi2la1 bie4-liao3, ga4 ze2 ga2-lie3 le, eng1di1 sang1 pai3zang3 a, suo1 pai3zang3 a!
rows.english: So Commander Liu, his resolve weakened. - Fight this man? Today he couldn't kill him! - His tongue hung out, and he gulped a few times. This No.3 Platoon Leader, No.3 Platoon Leader!

rows.translation: 他可以看到人的情况，看了一下，他们今天要取我的命，这个也许不能乱喝酒，酒没有喝完。
rows.tujia: guo2 luo4 jing2mian1 ba4-duo3-di1xi3, la2 dong2 ba4-lie3, lai4 ge4ze1 nga2 nie3hhe2 a3-i, eng1di1 xing1 re2 luan2 hu3-ti2, re2 hu3-ji2-bu1ce3.
rows.english: He could read people like a mirror, just one look, today they want to take my life, I mustn't get drunk, so he didn't finish his wine.

rows.translation: 他说：“团长，我们一起在这个席上吃饭，必须结束，每人自己要回家。”他就把粮枪抬起，到外面去了，他走了。
rows.tujia: guo2 [li3]: "tuan3zang3, ang2 da4 eng1di1 xi3sang1, gai2 mang1mang1 ga2-xi2 ai3xi2 ti3-xiu2, guo2duo3 guo2duo3 song1kuo1-duo3." guo2 jiu1 ai1lie1 lian3qian1 di1di1-lie3 wo4ta3-bo3 zao3, guo2 zao3-lie3.
rows.english: He said: "Commander, we're eating this meal together, we must stop now, each of us must go home." So he slung his gun over his shoulder, went outside and then back home.

rows.translation: 那个三排长啊！那个人很厉害！
rows.tujia: ai1di1 sang1 suo1 pai3zang3 a! ai1di1 luo4 eng za2si1!
rows.english: That No.3 Platoon Leader! That man was amazing!

rows.translation: 他就问他的下属，“我们不能在洗车呆了，不能搞了。刘团长，把我们的命给取了都不知道。
rows.tujia: guo2 jiu1 ge4ze3-nie3 jie2 da1bi1-nie3 luo4 da4 se1li3-la1: "ang2ni1 xi1ce3huo3 gao1-ti2, gao1-lie3 liu3 tuan3zang3, guo2 jiu1 nga2 qie4 si3jie3 nie3hhe2 a3-liao3 duo3 ha1tai2,
rows.english: He called his men together and said: "We can't stay in Xichehe. Commander Liu, when will he catch up with me and kill me?

rows.translation: 他什么时候都总是恨我，我记得了，记得了，我因为，我因为，他压不住我了，他骑不住我了，
rows.tujia: guo2 qie4 si3jie3 duo3, guo2 huan2 nga2 heng2, nga2 die2-lie3 die2-bo3-xi2, nga2 ying1wei3, nga2 ying1wei3 le, guo2 nga2 ya2-bu2zu2-liao3, guo2 nga2 qi3-bu2zu2-liao3,
rows.english: He hates me all the time, I remember, I remember, because, because he can't keep me under his thumb, he can't control me,

rows.translation: 我怕他，然后我们今天就回家去。”那就从信东坳爬山去信地，到了信地呢，他想了一个月，他总是要和刘团长一起，要子弹。
rows.tujia: ge4, ai1lie1 ang2duo3 lei4 cu1-bo3 hhi2." ai1 jiu1 xing1dong1ngao2-lie1 ba3 gu3-di2 xing2di1-bo3 eng3zou2. xing2di1 ye4-lie3 le, guo2 yi2 guo2 ye1-nie3 eng1di1 xian4-lie3, guo2 huan2 liu3 tuan3zang3 da4 di4, zi1dang2 a di4.
rows.english: so I'm afraid, that today we must go home." So from Xingdongngao they crossed the mountains back to Xindi. When they got to Xindi, he thought things over for a month, he wanted to be back with Commander Liu, as he needed ammunition.

rows.translation: 刘团长呢，刘叫他，田不肯下去。田给人的要求就是这样那样的，他会做事，就是不识字。
rows.tujia: liu3 tuan3zang3 le, guo2 jie3 le guo2 da3-i-ta1, guo2 luo4 qi4 yi2 gao1, song1 yi2 gao1, a2 yi2 gao1 le, guo2 luo4 hui1 gao1, ci1ci1 ha1tai2 hong.
rows.english: Commander Liu, he called for him, but Tian wouldn't come down. Tian was like that, always asking for this, that and the other; he knew how to manage people, even though he was illiterate.

rows.translation: 寨上周围，这个永顺啊，龙山啊，那里的队伍，老百姓，队伍把这些老百姓抢了的话，他就会带人去打。
rows.tujia: zai2-sang1 zou1, eng1di1 huo2 tuan3tuan3zuan2zuan1, ying1seng3 a, long3sang1, kou2-cai3 dui2wu1, lao1be3xing1, eng1di1 lao1be3xing1 qian1-liao3-di hua1, guo2 jiu1 luo4 ye4-lie3 jiu1 ha3-i-hu3.
rows.english: In the villages around, throughout Yongshun and Longshan, the troops in these places, the ordinary folk, when the troops plundered them, he would lead his men to attack.

rows.translation: 打了总是赢，那里都是他赢，枪也得了，然后部下也多了。看到他们的声名到处都传了，永顺、龙山全部都知道。
rows.tujia: ha3-lie3 huan2 ying3, kou2-cai3 duo3 guo2 ying3, cong2 a ti3-liao3, ai1lie1 meng luo4 ya po1la1-liao3. kang2duo1 ge4-nie3 ming3yi2 dao2cu1 duo3 cuan3-liao3, ying1seng3, long3sang1, yi2si1 hao4rou3.
rows.english: Whenever he fought, he won, wherever he went he won, and he got guns, and more men rallied to him. And so their reputation spread everywhere, and now all of Yongshun and Longshan knew about them.

rows.translation: 田活中呢，和他们姓田的，是龙山县的党部书记长。他呢，就文化高，没有枪。他呢，没有保镖，没有守护他的人。
rows.tujia: tian3huo3zong1 le, ge4 da4 tian3 jia1ka1, long3sang1 xian2 dang1bu2 su1ji1zang1, guo2 le jiu1 ci1ci1 heng4, cong2 tai2, guo2 le suo4ti3 bao4-ma1 tai2, ka4-ma1 tai2.
rows.english: Tian Huozhong, a man of the same Tian clan, was Party Secretary in Longshan, he was highly educated, but had no weapons, nor did he have protectors, or bodyguards.

rows.translation: 然后，他就给三排长写了一封信：“你上来，带一些人来，带一些很好的人来，你和我在这里一起搞。我文化好，你有枪，那不是我们一起就搞得好，没有人能欺负我们。”
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 guo2 jiu1 suo1 pai3zang3 bo3 xing2 la1 cuo1 a2, "ni2 gu3-xie2, luo4 la2bie1 dai2-xie2, sang2jing1-nie3 luo4 la2bie1 dai2-xie2, ni2 nga2 da4 ge3 gao1. nga2 ci1ci1 hao4ri3, ni2 qian1gan1zi1 xie2, ai1 bu2si1 ang2 da4 jiu1 gao1-die3hao1, luo4die1 ang2 qia1-ma1 tai2."
rows.english: So he wrote a letter to No.3 Platoon Leader: "Come up here, bring a few men, bring a few capable men, and we can team up. I'm educated, you have guns, why don't we team up to do things, no one will be able to bully us."

rows.translation: 谁知道哦，那个三排长的师爷，他就写了一封回信给田活中，他反而骂田活中，反而边写边骂他的母亲，说田活中不好，怎么怎么的。
rows.tujia: a4se3 hao4ri3 ou, a1di1 suo1 pai3zang3-nie3 si1ye3, guo2 guo2 jiu1 tian3huo3zong1 bo3 hui3xing3 la2 cuo1 a2-lie3 le, guo2 guo2 dao2 tian3huo3zong1 luo3, a1nie3 luo3-bo3 a2, dao2 guo2 tian3huo3zong1 ca1huo4, qing3mo1 qing3mo1-nie3.
rows.english: Well, who would have guessed, that adviser for No.3 Platoon Leader, he wrote a letter back to Tian Huozhong, abusing him, cursing his mother, criticising him, and so forth.

rows.translation: 田活中看了一下，田活中，他非常生三排长的气，心里就想：“你这样搞，你好好的坐着，我们总会捉你来的！”
rows.tujia: tian3huo3zong1 la2 dong2 ba4-lie3, tian3huo3zong1, guo2 me3ke3ce1 wo2tu1, guo2 suo1 pai3zang3 bo3 me3 rang3rang3 ga2, eng1 huo2 me3 rang3rang3 ga2, "ni2 hang2 gao1-bo3, ni2 cai3mo1 cai3mo1 ong3-bo3, nga2 ni2 huan2 zuo2-i!"
rows.english: Tian Huozhong took one glance, and Tian Huozhong, he was furious with No.3 Platoon Leader, he was so angry: "You behave like this, you sit tight, in the end I will get you!"

rows.translation: 田活中就派了很多人，派了很多人。半夜三更呢，他们家里就会有事，晚上会来个然袭击。
rows.tujia: tian3huo3zong1 jiu1 luo4 za2sai1 pai2-lie3, za2sai1 pa3qie2-lie3, ye2bang1 sang1 geng1 le, ge4 cu1 jiu1 la1di3 (null)-i, ye2luo3sang3 bu1bu3-di2-i.
rows.english: So Tian Huozhong sent many men, sent many men; at midnight, there will be trouble in his home, he'll be caught at night by a surprise attack.

rows.translation: 那个三排长啊，最狡猾，他很熟悉打仗的情况。晚上看不见，他对那个地方都很熟悉。
rows.tujia: a1di1 suo1 pai3zang3 a zui2 jing1wei1, guo2 zang2gong1 da4ha3-nie3 ai1 wo2tu1 be2 su2, la3yao2 ang, yi3 meng yi3-da2, guo2 ai4duo3, guo2 ai1 wo2tu1, guo2 su2.
rows.english: That No.3 Platoon Leader, he was so cunning, he knew all about fighting. By nightfall, there was no sign of him, he was familiar with the local area.

rows.translation: 田活中手下的人，很多人一起到处找他，但还是没有找到。
rows.tujia: tian3huo3zong1-nie3 ai1di1 jie2 da1bi1-nie3 luo4, he2lang3 da4 guo2 zuan2zuan1 ha3-bo3 ni1, ngeng2 ni1-zuo3 tai2.
rows.english: Tian Huozhong's men, so many of them, beat around everywhere looking for him, but they just couldn't find him.

rows.translation: 他就从窗户里面像猫一样向外面走出去，溜走了。悄悄地，他爬上柚子树了。
rows.tujia: guo2 jiu1 ku2li1 die3 lian2cuan1 dong3ga2-lie1, mo3 da4ze3 wo3ta2-bo3 biao1-lu3, biao1-lie3 ka3kei1die3, guo2 ceng3zi3 ka3mong3 ga3 gu3 ti3-liao3,
rows.english: Then, as quietly as a cat, he escaped through a window and slipped away, quietly, and gained the upper branches of a pomelo tree.

rows.translation: 爬到柚子树上呢，他坐在柚子树顶仔细地看着下面。
rows.tujia: ceng3zi3 ka3mong3 ga3 gu3-lie3 le, ceng3zi3 ka3mong3 ga3, eng1ge1 liao1kuo1qi1 ga3 ong3-bo3 mo3 guo2 ba3ti3 cai3mo1 mo3 ba4-bo3-la1.
rows.english: He climbed up the pomelo tree, the top of a pomelo tree, and sat there near the top, scanning the ground below.

rows.translation: 那个田活中部下的人到处看，哪里都看过了。找过了，总是找不到，然后田活中自己走了。
rows.tujia: ai1di1 tian3huo3zong1-nie3 jie2 da1bi1-nie3 luo4, ge3 ba4, eng1ge1 ba4, ngeng2 ba4-ji2-liao3 wa, huan4-ji2-liao3, ngeng2 ni1-ji2-liao3, ni1-zuo3 tai2, ai1lie1 guo2duo3 zao3.
rows.english: Tian Huozhong's men, they looked here, there and everywhere, they turned the place upside down, but they found no trace of him, of his hiding-place, and so Tian Huozhong left.

rows.translation: 田活中部下的人走光了，这个三排长就下来。他从柚子树上下来了，到了家呢，他就终于出现了。
rows.tujia: tian3huo3zong1-nie3 ai1 jie2 da1bi1-nie3 luo4 zao3-ji2-lu3, eng1di1 sang1 pai3zang3 le jiu1 da3-diu2, ceng3zi3 ka3mong3 ga3-lie1 da3-lie3 cu1 ye4-lie3 le, guo2 jiu1 zong1yi3 xian2-liao3,
rows.english: When all Tian Houzhong's men were gone, this No.3 Platoon Leader, down he came, from the top of the pomelo tree. He went back home, and finally appeared again.

rows.translation: 他说：“弟兄们，你们全部自己回家做劳动去吧。我搞不好了，但是你们自己做劳动，你们时时刻刻和我在一起呢，什么时候都和我在一起。”
rows.tujia: guo2 jian1: "di2xiong1-die1, se2 yi2si1 guo2duo3 guo2duo3 cu1 jie2ri1, nga2 ai1lie1 gao1-bu1hao1-liao3, dang2si2 se2 guo2duo3 guo2duo3 jie2ri1, se2 si3si3ke3ke3 nga2 da4 le, qie4 si3jie3 duo3 nga2 da4, da4, da4 la1 yi3-bo3."
rows.english: He said: "Brothers, all of you go back home and work in the fields, I'm done for, but you yourselves go and work, you will constantly be with me, all the time, I will see you all."

rows.translation: 这个田活中的部下的人呢，又没有捉到田高梁，告诉田活中。
rows.tujia: eng1di1 tian3huo3zong1-nie3 eng1di1 jie2 da1bi1-nie3 luo4 le you2 zuo2-bu3ti2 le tian3huo3zong1 bo3 la1 ze2,
rows.english: Tian Huozhong's men again failed to catch him, and told Tian Huozhong.

rows.translation: 田活中哦，更加生气了，就想：“这个三排长，你！我把这个三排长捉了不关的话，我田活中就不当县党部书记长了。”
rows.tujia: tian3huo3zong1 o, ye2geng1 me3ga2-liao3: "eng1di1 sang1 pai3zang3, ni2, nga2 guo2 eng1di1 sang1 pai3zang3 suo1 pai3zang3 zuo2-lie3 la3-ta1 le, nga2 tian3huo3zong1 su1ji1zang1 dang1-tao1, xian2 dang1bu2 su1ji1zang1."
rows.english: Tian Huozhong, he got more and more angry: "This No.3 Platoon Leader, you, if I don't catch No.3 Platoon Leader, I, Tian Huozhong, won't be Secretary any longer, County Party Secretary."

rows.translation: 他就请了国民党军队，去找了国民党军队，找了，他们画了三排长的图形，头又像箩筐一样，画了一下。
rows.tujia: guo2 jiu1 seng1jing1 la2 dong2 qing4, seng1jing1 la2 dong2 ni1, ni1-lie3 ni1-duo3liao3, sang1 pai3zang3-nie3 tu3xing3 la2 dong2 hua2-lie3, kuo1ba1 you2 luo3kuan3 da4ze3, la2 dong2 gao1-lie3.
rows.english: So he sent for the Kuomintang, looked for the Kuomintang, and found them, who drew a sketch of No.3 Platoon Leader, his head was like a wicker basket, they drew him.

sections.title: 2.5: 龙山县的土匪（第一部分）
sections.meta_en:
Lu Bangzhen, Tasha Rural Township, Longshan County
recorded on 30 January 2003
sections.description_en: This text begins the story of the most notorious tufei (literally 'local robber') in southern Longshan County during the turmoil prior to Liberation in 1949. Tian Gaoliang had become a platoon leader in the warlord army controlling the local area. But, fearful of his jealous commanding officer, he fled to Xindi, a village just north of Tasha, where he formed a bandit group which carried out raids throughout the region. At one stage, he was imprisoned for over three years, before gaining his release. With the support of a warlord faction who appointed him village chief, Tian continued his activities in areas under the control of other factions. On hearing of the arrival of the People's Liberation Army, who had vowed to rid the area of banditry, he fled to a local cave where he was besieged and finally shot dead. The story is concluded in the next text.

title: 龙山县土匪（第二部分）
documentTitle: 即席性的故事: 龙山县的土匪（第二部分）

sections.description: 这是声名狼籍的土匪“三排长”田高粱的故事的第二部分，第一部分可以在上一段参阅。
sections.meta:
龙山县他砂乡鲁邦珍先生
记录日期 30 一月 2003

rows.translation: 那一天，三排长注定要坐牢房。他们把他抓到了呢，就在沅陵县把他关在牢房里面。
rows.tujia: ai1 la2 nie1, suo1 pai3zang3 gai1 guo2 bang1huan3 ong3-duo3, ge4 guo2 za4-duo3liao3 le jiu1 yan3leng3 xian2 bang1huan3 wo2tu1 la3-liao3.
rows.english: And so came the day when No.3 Platoon Leader was destined to go to jail. They caught him and locked him up in the Yuanling County jail.

rows.translation: 关在沅陵县的牢房，进牢房的时候呢，已经关在牢房里面的老犯人们呢，
rows.tujia: yan3leng3 xian2 bang1huan3 la3-nie3 qie4li3-nie3 si3jie3 le, ai1 wo2tu1-nie3, xian1 ai1 bang1huan3 wo2tu1-nie3 ai1di1 lao4 huan2reng3-die1 le,
rows.english: At that time, locked up in Yuanling County jail, among the criminals already locked up in the jail,

rows.translation: 犯人们中有一个官，他们要三排长抱着接尿的大桶子。
rows.tujia: guo2duo3 ga2me1 la2 hu3 xie2, suo1 pai3zang3 duo3 guo2 eng1ge1 hhe1ce1 ta4-ci3 ai1 tong1tong1 tie2ba1 a2hu1-duo3,
rows.english: there was an official, who wanted No.3 Platoon Leader to hold the large toilet bucket there,

rows.translation: 三排长生气了，他就蹦地把它推翻了。翻了以后，牢房里面的尿很臭，不能坐也不能睡。
rows.tujia: suo1 pai3zang3 mao2huo1-lie3 guo2 guo2 beng4 die3 xiao1-lie3 la2-lie3, la2-lie3, ai1lie1 bang1huan3 wo2tu1-nie3 hhe1ce1 lang3 le, ong3-bo3-ta1ti1, nie2-bo3-ta1ti1.
rows.english: but No.3 Platoon Leader flared up, and pushed it over with a crash. Afterwards, the prison stank of urine, it was unbearable both day and night.

rows.translation: 那个牢房里面的一个官，他用手指着说：“你们给我打他！”他的手指在三排长的上面，又说：“你们给我打他！”
rows.tujia: ai1 bang1huan3 wo2tu1-nie3 ga2me1 la2 hu3 la, "se2 nga2 bo3 ha3," jie2 zi2zi1 mo3, jie2 jiu1 sang1 pai3zang3 suo1 pai3zang3 ga3 zi2zi1-bo3-la1, "se2 nga2 bo3 ha3!
rows.english: The official in the jail pointed at him and said to them: "Beat him up for me." He pointed at No.3 Platoon Leader: "Beat him up!"

rows.translation: 三排长呢，眼睛一瞪，牙齿一咬，牙齿咬了一下，
rows.tujia: suo1 pai3zang3 la, luo2bu1 la2 dong2 gu4, si1si1 da4 la2 dong2 ga2, si1si1ma3zi3 la2 dong2 ga2-lie3,
rows.english: No.3 Platoon Leader, he glared back, gnashed his teeth, gnashed his teeth,

rows.translation: 头这么一摆，说：“你们试试看，敢打！你们见鬼了！”那里面的犯人们，关在那牢房的全都怕死了，不敢打他。
rows.tujia: kuo1ba1 hang2 la2 dong2 ri1-lie3, "se2 nga2 ha3 mo3 ba4 ba4! se2 gang1 ha3, a1ye3 se2 ni1-la1-hu3!" ai1 tu1-nie3 huan2reng3-die1, ai1 bang1huan3 la3-bo3-nie3 yi2si1 ge4-si3-ji2-liao3, bu2 gang1 ha3.
rows.english: shook his head and said: "You try and beat me up, beat me if you dare, the devil take the lot of you!" The prisoners there, everyone locked up in the prison, they were scared to death, and didn't dare touch him.

rows.translation: 他坐了三年六个月的牢之后，他又出来了，回到家。
rows.tujia: suo1 long1 wo3 si1 ong3-lie3 le, guo2 you2 zu2-diu2, zu2-lie3 cu1.
rows.english: He was in jail for three and a half years, then he was released and went home.

rows.translation: 他还在生田活中的气：“你这样对我，我也会收拾你田活中！”田活中也这样：“你也想收拾我，我也想收拾你！”
rows.tujia: guo2 hai3si2 me3ke3ce1 tu1-lie1 tian3huo3zong1, tian3huo3zong1 me3ga2-bo3-xi2: "ni2 nga2 hang2 ri1, nga2 be2 ni2 tian3huo3zong1 si2si1-i!" tian3huo3zong1 be2 hang2nie3: "ni2 be2 nga2 si2si1-i, nga2 be2 ni2 si2si1-i".
rows.english: He was still furious with Tian Huozhong: "You dare treat me like this, I'll deal with you, Tian Huozhong!" Tian Huozhong likewise said: "You want to get rid of me, I want to get rid of you!"

rows.translation: 他就，他们有一个叔叔，他很有钱，田大板就和他的叔叔商量：“叔叔啊，买几根枪，否则我又要去做。
rows.tujia: guo2 jiu1 ge4ze1-nie3 ang1bei1 la2 hu3 xie2, xie2ma1-ka3, guo2 jiu1 ang1bei1 da4 sang1lian3: "ang1bei1 ya, cong2 ga4 zi2 pu1, ai1ta1 nga2 you2 ri1-i,
rows.english: Tian [Gaoliang] went to one of their uncles, a rich man, and talked things over with him: "Uncle, buy me a few guns, otherwise I'll have to work for a living again.

rows.translation: 我不买枪的话，你家里有那么多东西，你也守不住，你也吃不得，人家会把你的抢完，你又下不了手。
rows.tujia: nga2 cong2 pu1-ta1 le, ni2 cu1 ye3 he2lang3 xie2, ni2 be2 ka4-bu2zu2, ni2 be2 ta4 ti3 mo3 ga2, luo4die1 ni2 a4yi3-ji2-lie3-hu3, ni2 you2 luo4, ni2 you2 luo4 ri1-ti2,
rows.english: If I don't buy any guns, all these possessions of yours, you won't be able to guard them, and you won't be able to buy food, people will rob you, and you won't be able to retaliate.

rows.translation: 我买了几根枪呢，我自己可以保我的命，你也搞好了。”
rows.tujia: nga2 cong2 ga4 zi2 pu1-lie3 le, meng, nga2-nie3 ming2 nga2 bao4-liao3 meng, ni2 ya gao1-hao1-liao3."
rows.english: When I've bought a few guns, I can preserve my own life, and you will be fine as well."

rows.translation: 他买了几根枪呢，就这里搞那里搞，这里搞那里搞，又搞多了。
rows.tujia: cong2 ga4 zi2 pu1-lie3 le, qi4 geng1ke4, ge3 gao1 eng1ge1 gao1, ge3 gao1 eng1ge1 gao1-lie3 you2 gao1 mo3 qi4, you2 gao1 mo3 po1la1-liao3.
rows.english: So he bought a few guns, and went here and there, causing trouble, more trouble than ever.

rows.translation: 然后永顺、龙山呢，这个三排长到哪里打架都精神饱满，每次总是他赢，从来不输，他到那里都有名了。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 ying1seng3, long3sang1 ei, eng1di1 sang1 pai3zang3 kou2 da4ha3 lian2huo1 zu2, ci2ci1, yi2 hui3 he1he1 huan2 ying3 a, su1-da2, ai1di1 kou2-cai3 duo3 ming3yi2 xiao2.
rows.english: Then in Yongshun and Longshan, wherever No.3 Platoon Leader fought he was in fine fettle, and he won every time, he never lost, and became notorious throughout the whole area.

rows.translation: 然后龙山呢，他出了名，那个时候社会开始乱起来。队伍和队伍之间互相打，然后龙山的官呢，就叫他当乡长。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 long3sang1 le, guo2 ming3yi2 xiao2 le, ai1 si3jie3 si2gai1 you2 luan2-la1-hu3, dui2wu1 nie1 dui2wu1 da4ha3, ai1lie1 long3sang1 ga2me1 le jiu1 guo2 jiao2 xian1zang1 dang1-duo3,
rows.english: So he was now well known in Longshan, and at that time society was in chaos, with one set of troops fighting another, then an official in Longshan asked him to be a village head.

rows.translation: 他就当了乡长，当了乡长呢，没当很久，还不到一个月，红军到我们这个寨子里来了，到我们湘西了，
rows.tujia: guo2 jiu1 xian1zang1 dang1 meng dang1 o, xian1zang1 dang1-lie3 le, lao1hua1 dang1-bu3ti2, la2 si1 duo3 gao1-bu3ti2 le, hong3jing1 you2 ang2 ge3 zai2-sang1, ang2ni1 xian1xi1 ye4-ji2-liao3,
rows.english: So he served as village head, served as village head, and before he had done so for long, before even a month had passed, the Red Army came to our village, arrived in Xiangxi.

rows.translation: 到我们这个山沟里了。然后他，三排长，他就知道这个变化，那个乡长很厉害，很有主意，他就是不识字。
rows.tujia: ang2 ge3 sang1ga1ga1 li1 ye4-lie3 le, ai1lie1 guo2 jiu1, sang1 pai3zang3 guo2 eng1di1 me2 bian2-xi2 hao4ri3, ai1di1 luo4 ngeng2, xian1zang1 heng4, zu1yi3 ya xie2, guo2 ci1ci1 ha1tai2 hong.
rows.english: They came to our valley, and then No.3 Platoon Leader, he learnt of this change, he was a hard man, a formidable village head, very aware of what went on around him, but illiterate.

rows.translation: 然后，他的部下就各走各的了。他说：“你们自己回家去吧。”现在人不多了。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 guo2 jiu1, di2xiong1 jiu1 sang2-ji2-liao3: "se2duo3 yi2si1 guo2duo3 guo2duo3 cu1-bo3 hhi2." o luo4 lao1hua1 tao2.
rows.english: So his men all scattered. He said: "Each of you go back to his own home", leaving him with only a few men.

rows.translation: 他又到这里和叔叔一起商量，说：“这个怎么办啊？叔叔啊，这个时候你就要给我们一些米了。”他就把米背到了牛栏洞里面。
rows.tujia: guo2 you2 ge4 ang1bei1 da4 sang1lian3: "eng1di1 qing3mo1 gao1-i le? eng1 si3jie3 jiu1, ang1bei1 ya, ni2 ang2ni1 bo3 zi3hhe3 la2bie1 gao1-duo3." guo2 guo2 jiu1 zi3hhe3 wo4-lie3 liu3lang3dong2,
rows.english: Once again he discussed things with their uncle: "What should I do? Uncle, now you must give us some rice." He carried the rice to Niulan Cave,

rows.translation: 在牛栏洞里面存在几个桶子里面呢，就叫了十几个人，在洞里面筑墙。然后有的就用刺围，躲在那里面，搜山的人呢，都搜不到他们。
rows.tujia: liu3lang3dong2 tu1 tong1tong1 ga4 bu2 ceng3-lie3 le, guo2 luo4 si3 ji1 guo2 gao1-lie3 le, dong2 wo2tu1 jiu1 a3pi2 ce2, ai1lie1 ta2se1 wei3-xi2 wei3 ya, ai1 tu1 ye4-bo3, sou1 sang1 a sou1-zuo3 tai2.
rows.english: and stored it in some buckets inside, got together a dozen or so men, and built a barricade inside the cave. Then he surrounded it with thorns, and hid inside. They searched the mountains, but they couldn't find him.

rows.translation: 后来，他们探找，解放军到了，民兵就找到他了。三排长躲在牛栏洞里面，他在那里筑了墙。
rows.tujia: qing3nie2 ai1lie1 tang2, ni1, gai1huan3jing1 ye4-lie3 le, ming3bing1 guo2 tang2-duo3liao3. suo1 pai3zang3 liu3lang3dong2 ye4-bo3-la1 me, guo2 guo2 eng1ge1... guo2 guo2 a3pi2 le ci2-lie3.
rows.english: Later, they carried on looking. When the People's Liberation Army arrived, the local militia found him. No.3 Platoon Leader was hiding in Niulan Cave, he was inside, and he had built a barricade there.

rows.translation: 整天，他们在山上搜，搜不到，然后找到了。找到了呢，政府呢，政府的解放军，就把马排长，东北的马排长，派了一个排，去打他。
rows.tujia: la2 nie1 hi4lie3 sou1, sang1 ga3 sou1-zuo3 tai2, ai1lie1 ni1-duo3liao3, ni1-duo3liao3 le ga2me1ka3 le jiu1, gai1huan3jing1 ga2me1ka3, guo2 jiu1 ma1 pai3zang3, dong1be3-nie3 ma1 pai3zang3 yi2 guo2 pai3 pai2-lie3, guo2 ha3-xie2.
rows.english: All day they searched the mountains for his hiding place without success, and then they found him, they found him. The government, the People's Liberation Army, they sent Platoon Leader Ma, Platoon Leader Ma from the north-east, with a platoon, to go and deal with him.

rows.translation: 就用枪在牛栏洞的对面，那牛栏洞的上面。打，（枪声），天天打，打了很多呢，打了十天半个月。
rows.tujia: liu3lang3dong2 tie1bi1-lie1 jiu1, cong2 huo3lie3 a1di1 liu3lang3dong2-nie3 dong2 du3 ga3 ha3, dong3a3 dong3a3, la2 nie1 hi4lie3 ha3, gai4 ha3-lie3 le, si3 tian1 bang1 guo2 ye1 ha3-lie3.
rows.english: So from the hill opposite, they sealed off the entrance to Niulan Cave, using their guns, (sound of shooting), shooting every day for ages, for around a fortnight.

rows.translation: 解放军呢，被打死了很多。他们在里面一个都没有被打死，马排长呢，也在那儿被打死了。然后怎么搞呢？好！政府解放军又派了一个人来。
rows.tujia: gai1huan3jing1 meng la2bie1 ha3-si3, guo2 meng ai1 wo2tu1 la2 hu3 duo3 ha3-si3-da2, ma1 pai3zang3 a ao1 ha3-si3-liao3. ai1lie1 ngeng2 qing3mo1 gao1-i le? hao4! gai1huan3jing1 ga2me1ka3 le you2 la2 hu3 pai2-di2,
rows.english: The People's Liberation Army sustained some casualties, but failed to kill a single person inside, and Platoon Leader Ma was shot dead there. What on earth could they do now? Good! The People's Liberation Army will send someone else,

rows.translation: 又派了一个排长呢，打，还是打不得，这个怎么办呢？这个糟糕了！我怎么向政府交代呢？不能交代。
rows.tujia: you2 pai3zang3 la2 hu3 pai2-lie3 le, ha3, hai3si2 ha3 mo3 kai1-ti2, eng1di1 qing3mo1 ri1 ya? eng1di1, eng1di1 huai2-liao3 wa! nga2 ga2me1ka3 bo3 qing3mo1 ze2 le, ze2-di2-ta1ti1.
rows.english: another platoon leader to fight, but still without success; now what do we do? What a disaster! What can I tell the government, there's nothing to report.

rows.translation: 三排长，他是老虎精，他快要死了，在洞周围白天晚上一只公老虎一只母老虎，前爪这样放着，站着叫（老虎声），两只一起抓地。
rows.tujia: sang1 pai3zang3, guo2 si1 li2jing1, guo2 ai1lie1 se2-hu3, ai1 dong2 ye3luo3-bo3 la3yao2, ta1nie3ku3 li2-a1ba1 lao4 ni3ga3 lao4 jie2 huo2 zu1zu4-bo3 mo3 hang3hang3hang3 die3 li4 bi2la1, nie1 long3 da4,
rows.english: No.3 Platoon Leader, he was a tiger demon, just before he died, he prowled around the cave by night and by day, a tiger and a tigress, rearing on their front paws, and clawing the earth together,

rows.translation: （老虎声），尾巴又摇（摇尾巴声）。早上也叫，晚上也叫，白天天天都叫，晚上通夜通夜叫。
rows.tujia: hang3hang3hang3 die3, lie3pong2 you2 bi3li3ba3la3 bi3li3ba3la3 bi3li3ba3la3, zao4gu1die1 ye1 mo2hu1, la3yao2 ye1 mo2hu1, ta1nie3ku3, la2 nie1 hi4lie3 mo2hu1, la3yao2 tong1ye1 tong1ye1 mo2hu1.
rows.english: (sound of tiger), waving their tails. They growled in the morning and the evening, and in broad daylight, all day long they growled, all night long they growled.

rows.translation: 那些附近的人，寨子上的多半人，别人呢，然后说：“三排长快要死了，他是老虎精，然后他快要死了，他的日子不长了，
rows.tujia: ai1di1 pang3, eng1di1 yi2 duo1bang1, eng1di1 zai2-sang1-nie3 luo4die1 la, ai1lie1, "suo1 pai3zang3 se2-hu3, guo2 li2jing1, ai1lie1 guo2 se2-hu3, guo2 nie4, guo2, guo2 lao1hua1 ong3-ta1tiu1,
rows.english: The people round about, most of the people in this village, said: "No.3 Platoon Leader is about to die, he is a tiger demon, he is about to die, his days are numbered, he won't be around much longer,

rows.translation: 他终于走到尽头。”这个新接任的排长呢，他就从政府那里拿来了一根很大的枪，枪有人的大腿那么大。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 guo2 si2xian1-liao3." eng1di1 xing1 jie1reng1-nie3 ai1 pai3zang3 la2 hu3 le, guo2 guo2 jiu1 eng1ge1, ga2me1ka3 eng1ge1-lie1 jiu1 cong2 tie2ba1 la2 zi2 huo3-di2, zi2 duo3 luo4 ji3si3pe1 he2ba3 xie2,
rows.english: he's finished." This newly-appointed platoon leader, he came along, planning to bring a huge gun from the army, a gun with a barrel as large as a man's thigh.

rows.translation: 对着，对着，对着这个牛栏洞的洞口，蹦的一声打了一炮，好像雷在劈柴一样，（雷声）这样劈着。
rows.tujia: zao2-bo3 zao2-bo3 mo3 eng1di1, eng1di1, eng1di1 liu3lang3dong2, eng1di1 dong3ga2 dui2-bo3 mo3 beng4 die3 yi2 pao1 ha3-lie3, me2la1ong3, me2ta1ce3 die3 ka3mong3 sa1-la1 mo3 huo2 sa1-la1, pian3lang3lang3 die3 la,
rows.english: Facing, facing the Niulan Cave, facing the mouth of the cave, the gun boomed out, like a thunderbolt splitting a tree (noise of thunder).

rows.translation: 那里牛栏洞的悬崖都自己着火了。（燃火声）老虎又在那里叫，（老虎声），大地都好像在震动。
rows.tujia: eng1ge1 liu3lang3dong2-nie3 a3ca3 duo3 guo2duo3 mi4 da4-liao3 wa, hu3la3 hu3la3, li2 you2 eng1ge1 hang3hang3hang3 hang3hang3hang3 mo2hu1, li4 ta2pa4 duo3 ki1si1.
rows.english: The cliff-face around the cave was all on fire (sound of burning), and the tigers growled and growled, the very ground seemed to be shaking.

rows.translation: 劳动人民都很怕：“这个三排长是不是出来了？”那个排长，他又开枪，（枪声），就像打雷一样，像打雷一样。
rows.tujia: jie2ri1-ma1-die1 yi2si1 ge4 le, "eng1di1 sang1 pai3zang3 zu2-diu2 huo1 qing3mo1-nie3 hang?" ai1 pai3zang3, guo2 you2 bong3long3 bang3lang3, me2la1ong3 ong3 mo3 huo2 ong3, me2ta1ce3 die3 ong3 mo3 ong3-la1,
rows.english: The villagers were all afraid: "This No.3 Platoon Leader, is he coming out or what?" That platoon leader, he again opened fire, with a noise like thunder, like a thunderclap.

rows.translation: 打到第三第四炮的时候呢，那块石头倒下来了，牛栏洞里面有箱子碗柜那么大的石头，以前筑的墙全都倒了。
rows.tujia: suo1 pao1 re1 pao1 ha3-zu2 le, ai1di1 a3ba3 kua4-diu2, ai1 wo2tu1 tuo4 he2ba3, qing1bao1 he2ba3, zi1ge1 pi2 zu2-bo3-xi2 yi2si1 kua4-ji2-liao3.
rows.english: After three or four blasts, the stones began to collapse, and slabs of stone as big as cupboards rained down, causing the barricade to collapse completely.

rows.translation: 在那里面没有放气了，也没开枪。那些解放军呢，就派了一个民兵偷偷地去看，走了一趟。
rows.tujia: ai1di1 wo2tu1-lie1 si2si1 ya po1-dao2, cong2 a ha3-dao2, ai1di1, eng1di1 gai1huan3jing1 le jiu1 ming3bing1 la2 hu3 pa3qie2 le ba4-xie2, hhe2 mo3 yi2 tang1 ba4-lie3,
rows.english: Not a sound came from inside, and the guns were now silent, so the People's Liberation Army sent a militiaman to creep in and have a look, to look around.

rows.translation: 哎哟！里面横七竖八的，尸体这样有的翻天睡着，有的就歪着，歪着，有的趴着，死的死，有的就抱着枪。现在没有放气了，现在没有人了。
rows.tujia: a yo! wo2tu1 di3di1da3tao1 mo3, huo2 me2 ba4-bo3 nie2-xi2 nie2, geng1ke4-bo3-xi2 geng1ke4-bo3, pe3-bo3 nie2-xi2 nie2, se2-xi2 se2, cong2 a2hu1 mo3 gao1-bo3, si2si1 duo3 po1-dao2, luo4 tao2.
rows.english: Well! Inside everything was in disarray, [corpses] lying on their backs as though sleeping, others tumbled all over the place, some prone as though sleeping, others obviously dead, some still clutching guns. Not one of them stirred, not one was left alive.

rows.translation: 过了一会，他带了解放军一起去看，找着看，找不到这个三排长。
rows.tujia: la2 dong2 la2die1, guo2 gai1huan3jing1 da4 cuo4-lie3 ba4-xie2, ni1 mo3 ba4, eng1di1 suo1 pai3zang3 ni1-zuo3 tai2,
rows.english: After a little while, he brought the People's Liberation Army in to have a look, and they looked all over, but they couldn't find No.3 Platoon Leader.

rows.translation: 那个三排长，人真是了不起，他真是猴子精，猴子都没有他聪明。他自己往洞里面去了，往里面去了。他把炒好的米用袋子带走了，吃了就往里面去了。
rows.tujia: ai1di1 suo1 pai3zang3, luo4 ngeng2 liao1bu3qi1, guo2 ngeng2 hhe4jing1, hhe4 duo3 guo2 guai1-nie1. guo2duo3 dong2 wo2tu1-bo3 zao3, wo2tu1-bo3 zao3-lie3, guo2 zi3hhe3 cao4-bo3-xi2 luo2tie1 kuai4-lie3, ga2-lie3 wo2tu1-bo3 qie4lu3,
rows.english: That No.3 Platoon Leader, he really was amazing, truly a monkey demon, cleverer than any monkey. He had gone even further into the cave, further in. He had a bag of fried rice with him which he ate, and then slipped further in.

rows.translation: 他往里面去了，民兵呢，解放军呢，就把洞围起来，用石头把洞口堵塞了，用刺紧紧地塞着。
rows.tujia: wo2tu1-bo3 qie4li3-lie3 jiu1, ming3bing1 a, gai1huan3jing1 a jiu1 da4 dong2 wei3-bo3, dong2 a3ba3 huo3lie3 ci2-bo3, song3-bo3, ta2se1 huo3lie3 kang1lang1 kang1lang1 song3-bo3,
rows.english: He went further in, the militia, the People's Liberation Army, they blocked up the cave, blocking the mouth of the cave with stones, and sealing it ever more tightly with thorns.

rows.translation: “你不能出来了，你里面也没有地方走了，你，刺会刺你的手！你推不动这块石头，石头是三四个人一起抬起来的，用桌子那么大的石头筑起来的，筑起来的！”
rows.tujia: "ni2 zu2-di2-ta1ti1, ni2 wo2tu1 qie4li3-zuo3 tai2, ni2 ta2se1 ni2 jie2 he1-i ang! a3ba3, ni2 guo2 xiao1 mo3 la2-ti2, a3ba3 suo1 hhi3 re1 hhi3 da4 di1di1 le ci2-bo3-xi2, si3tie2 he2ba3 huo3lie3 ci2-bo3-xi2 you!"
rows.english: "You won't be able to get out, there's nowhere for you to go inside, the thorns will pierce your hands! You can't push the stones clear, it took three or four people to lift them, we built it, we used stones as big as tables to build it!"

rows.translation: 谁知道那是怎么搞的，不知道啊！一两天后呢，这个三排长出来了，他饿了，他就这样在农民家里在找饭吃。
rows.tujia: ai1 xiao1 qing3mo1 gao1-di2-xi2 ha1tai2 ya! la2 nie1 nie1 nie1 (null)-lie3, eng1di1 suo1 pai3zang3 zu2-diu2 wa, guo2 li2a4-liao3, guo2 jiu1 huo2 huo2, eng1di1 jie2ri1-ma1-nie3 cu1 mang1mang1 ni1-bo3 ga2-la1.
rows.english: But who knows how he did it, nobody knew. After a day or two, No.3 Platoon Leader emerged, because he was hungry, off he went to a peasant's house to find something to eat.

rows.translation: 那边呢，在牛栏洞周围，探长多了，便衣队多了，带着枪，那里到处都是解放军，像天上的星星一样，这么多了。
rows.tujia: eng1ge1la1bi3 meng liu3lang3dong2 ao1 ye3luo3-bo3 meng tang2zang1 po1la1-liao3, bian2yi1 dui2 ya po1la1-liao3, lian3qian1 kuai4-bo3 mo3, gai1huan3jing1 guo2 eng1ge1 pu1-ji2-liao3, me2 ga3-nie3 xi4bu2li1 da4ze3 he2lang3-liao3.
rows.english: On that side, round about Niulan Cave, there were many scouts, many plain-clothes troops, all carrying guns, the whole place was crawling with the People's Liberation Army, as many as the stars in the sky.

rows.translation: 有一天，探子把他探到了，这个三排长，他呢，在桐岩那个地方呆着。那些便衣队就在那里打着转找他，
rows.tujia: ai1 la2 nie4 le, tang2zi1 guo2 tang2-duo3liao3 yi, eng1di1 suo1 pai3zang3, ma1lao1 wa, tong1ngai3 qie1sa1 ai1 di2huan1 gao1-la1, ai1di1 bian2yi1 dui2-die1 jiu1 ao1 zuan2zuan1 ha3-bo3 ni1 mo3 ba4,
rows.english: One day, a scout spotted him, this No.3 Platoon Leader, at Malao, hanging around on Tongngai Mountain. So the plain-clothes troops surrounded him to try and catch him.

rows.translation: 到处看。那一夜，三排长，鸡都还没叫，他渴了，无法忍受了，他准备去喝水，他就刮了一根火柴，（刮火柴声），
rows.tujia: ba4-lie3 le ai1 la2 pe1, suo1 pai3zang3 ra3 duo3 rong2-da2-nie2, guo2 ze2ga3 le seng3-bo3-ta1tiu1, guo2 ce3 hu3-i ya le, guo2 yan3huo1 sei3 die3 la2 zi2 gua2-lie3,
rows.english: They watched all night, and No.3 Platoon Leader, before cockcrow, he was unbearably thirsty, so he went to drink some water, and struck a match.

rows.translation: 那些便衣就用枪把他（枪声）打倒了。
rows.tujia: ai1di1 bian2yi1 dui2-die1 jiu1 guo2 cong2 huo3lie3 bao1wa die3, guo2 jiu1 ao1 geng1ke4-liao3.
rows.english: The plain-clothes troops then felled him there with their guns.

rows.translation: 第二天呢，去看，然后民兵呢，去看了，那个三排长在这里倒了，打死了。后来呢，把他的头割下了。挂在马比寨小学的旗杆上面。
rows.tujia: di2ai2 tian1 le ba4-xie2, ai1lie1 ming3bing1 le ba4-xie2, ai1 ya suo1 pai3zang3 eng1-cai3 geng1ke4-liao3, ha3-si3-liao3. qing3nie2 le, guo2 ai1 kuo1ba1 suo4-lie3 le ma1bi1zai1 ai1 xiao1xiao3 wo2tu1 le, ai1 qi3gang3 ga3 gua2-bo3-la1.
rows.english: The next day, they went to have a look, the militia went to see, No.3 Platoon Leader lay fallen there, shot dead. Afterwards, his head was cut off, and was hung on the flagpole in the primary school in Mabizhai.

sections.title: 2.6: 龙山县的土匪（第二部分）
sections.meta_en:
Lu Bangzhen, Tasha Rural Township, Longshan County
recorded on 30 January 2003
sections.description_en: This text concludes the story, begun in the previous text, of 'No.3 Platoon Leader', a notorious tufei bandit.

title: 来自永顺县的故事
documentTitle: 即席性的故事: 永顺县的故事

sections.description: （播放整段）即席性的故事: 永顺县的故事
sections.meta:
永顺县大坝乡田心桃女士
记录日期 05 八月 2002

rows.translation: 我以前读书的时候，强盗从后面来。他们打枪，（枪声）...
rows.tujia: nga2 di1ga1 ci1tu1, ye3 a4yi3-ma1 qing3nie2 eng3jiu3, ge4ze1 cong2 ha3 du1du1du1...
rows.english: When I was at school, robbers found their way [into the city]. They fired their guns. Bang! Bang! ...

rows.translation: 哎哟！我们怕，就往外面跑。哎哟！他们来啊！开着枪，在你头上面啊！
rows.tujia: ei1ya1! ang2ni1 a ge4-bo3 mo3 xi4ca3 ou, wo4ta3-bo3 zu2 ao, ei1yo1! ge4ze1 eng3jiu3 ou! cong2 ha3 mo3 ni2 kuo1ba1 ga3ha2 a!
rows.english: Oh dear! We were scared stiff and ran outside. Oh no! They're coming! Firing their guns, right over our heads!

rows.translation: 当我看见他们后，哎哟！我们很怕啊，立即跑，立即跑，去躲起来！哪里躲呢？
rows.tujia: nga2 da4 yi3-zu2 ou, ei1ya1! ang2ni1 ge4di1ge4ga2 ou, xie2hui1 mo3 xi4ca3 ao, xie2hui1 mo3 xi4ca3-bo3 ye4 ao! kei3-bo3 ye4 a?
rows.english: When we saw them, we were so frightened, we ran off at once, straight away off to hide!

rows.translation: 哎哟！再摸一下身体，有没有出血？看一下，没有血！又继续跑，使劲地跑。
rows.tujia: ei1ya1! a4duo3 suo4ti3 la1 bu1mu3, mie4 zu2 zu2-da2? eng la1 ba4, mie4 tai2 ao! you2 jie4-bo3 mo3 xi4ca3, jie4-bo3 mo3 xi4ca3.
rows.english: Where should we hide? Oh! I felt my body again, to see if I was bleeding. I looked, but there was no blood! Off we ran, off we ran again.

rows.translation: 哎哟！那里有两只狗，（狗叫声）。
rows.tujia: ei1yo1! ai1du1 ha4lie3 nie1 long3 xie2, kuan3kuan3kuan3 kuan3kuan3kuan3 kuan3kuan3kuan3.
rows.english: Look! There are two dogs over there. Woof! Woof! Woof!

rows.translation: 哎哟！我们怕，像死了一样。哎哟！我们很怕！
rows.tujia: ei1ya1! ang2ni1 a ge4 mo3 se2-liao3 da4ze3, ei1ya1! ang2ni1 ge4di1ge4ga2!
rows.english: We were scared to death, we were so frightened!

rows.translation: 嘿！我们两个伙伴在泥土上睡着坐着，睡着坐着也怕。
rows.tujia: ai! nga2 nie1 zuo1ba1 ang2 nie1 la1hu3 ba3zi2 ga3ha2 ou, nie2-bo3, ong3-bo3, nie2-bo3 ong3-bo3 be2 ge4, ge4-ji2 la.
rows.english: Hey! My male classmate and I, the two of us we sat and slept on the ground. Sitting or sleeping, we were completely petrified.

rows.translation: 那些强盗啊！他们会把人家所有的东西都背走，都搬走。他们去了，我们就回来。我们回来时，房屋里的全部东西都抢完了。
rows.tujia: a1di1 ye3 a4yi3-ma1 ou, luo4die1-nie3 qi3qie1 xie2 du1 wo4-ji2-i la, be4-ji2-i la. ge4ze1 zao3, ang2ni1 song1kuo1, song1kuo1-bo3, ang2 cuo4-nie3 ye3 yi2si1 a4yi3-ji2-liao3.
rows.english: Those robbers, they will take absolutely everything, they will take it all away on their backs. When they had gone, we came home, and when we returned, we found that everything in our house had been stolen.

rows.translation: 我的祖父母也很怕，我的父母很怕；我的小妹妹不怕。
rows.tujia: nga2-nie3 po3pa1 be2 [ge4-xi3], nga2-nie3 nie3ba3 [ge4-xi3]; nga2-nie3 mei3mei1 a1mi1 bi2kui1, guo2 ge4-da2,
rows.english: My grandparents were very frightened, and so were my parents; but my younger sister was unperturbed.

rows.translation: 她放学后，还去看强盗！她一点儿都不怕，我也就没有说她。
rows.tujia: guo2 ci1tu1-lie3, guo2 a4duo3 ye3 a4yi3-ma1 ba4 ou! guo2 la2bie1 duo3 ge4-da2, nga2 jiu1 li3-da2.
rows.english: When she finished school, she went to watch the robbers! She wasn't the slightest bit afraid, but I didn't stop her.

sections.title: 2.7.1: 遇到土匪
sections.meta_en:
Tian Xintao, Daba Township, Yongshun County
recorded on 05 August 2002
sections.description_en: This is a selection of texts drawn from Mrs Tian Xintao's memories of her early life in the Yongshun area prior to Liberation in 1949. The first two texts illustrate the rigours of life, at the hands of both men and nature. The third text provides a brief vignette of a traditional Tujia woman, accomplished in the economies of daily life. The final text describes the journey home from Changsha, the provincial capital of Hunan, to Yongshun, an arduous trip of over two hundred miles. Transport in the area was very limited at that time, and rivers were important arteries of communication.

sections.meta:
永顺县大坝乡田心桃女士
记录日期 05 八月 2002

rows.translation: 我小的时候，我的祖母喊我：“你要去山里背柴。要扯猪草呀！要切牛草呀！”，一句一句地教我。
rows.tujia: nga2 qing2die1 bi2 si3, nga2-nie3 a3ba1 nga2 jie3-bo3 mo3: "ni2 kang3ku1 hhi2-duo3, ka3 wo4-duo3, zi4xi3 wu4-duo3 a! wu2xi3 suo4-duo3 a!", la2 ze2 la2 ze2 nga2 bo3 a2yi1.
rows.english: When I was small, my grandmother called to me: "Go up into the hills and fetch some firewood, You also need to get some weeds for the pigs, and cut some grass for the cows!" So she lectured me, one sentence after another.

rows.translation: 我的姑母呢，她和我一起去山里去，去背柴。我们那时背柴，背的都是干柴，背干柴，要爬山。
rows.tujia: nga2-nie3 ma3ma1 le, guo2 nga2 da4ha3 le, kang3ku1-bo3 hhi2 ao, ka3 wo4-i. ang2ni1 ei1-zu2 ka3 wo4, yi2xi1 ga3 ka3 wo4, ga3 ka3 wo4-lie3 ba3 gu3-lie3.
rows.english: So my aunt, she went with me to the hills, to fetch firewood. So there we were collecting firewood, our backs laden with dry wood. With that on our backs, up the hill we went.

rows.translation: 一棵桐子树的叶子快要全部掉下来了，没有几块绿叶子。
rows.tujia: tong3 ka3mong3 lao4 pu2ta1 yi2xi1 bie4-la1-hu3, tong3 pu2ta1 xing2ga1die3 ga4 [hhi1] tao2,
rows.english: There was a tung tree which was beginning to shed all its leaves, with no green leaves left at all.

rows.translation: 我爬到树上，上呀上呀，树倒下来了！哎哟！我和树一起倒下来，一句话都不能说。
rows.tujia: nga2 ji4-bo3 mo3 ka3mong3 gu3, ka3mong3 gu3 a, gu3 a wa, guo2duo3 ka3mong3 ga3ha2-lie1, ka3mong3 geng1ke4 la! ei1ya1! nga2 ka3mong3 da4ha3 geng1ke4 la, sa3 la2 ze2 be2 li3-ta1ti1.
rows.english: I began climbing the tree, up and up I went, to the top of the tree, and then the tree fell down! Oh no! Down I came with the tree, there I was, utterly speechless.

rows.translation: 我的姑母喊：“山里死人啦！滚死了！怎么办？怎么办？”她哭着喊，哭着喊，喊了。
rows.tujia: nga2-nie3 ma3ma1 jie3 a, jie3 a: "kang3ku1 li1 se2 la! geng1ke4-lie3 se2 la! qing3mo1 ri1 a? qing3mo1 ri1 a?" guo2 ji2-bo3 mo3 jie3, ji2-bo3 mo3 jie3, jie3-lie3,
rows.english: My aunt was screaming: "Someone's died in the mountains! Tumbled to her death! What shall we do, what shall we do?" She shouted and wept, shouted and wept, shouted and shouted.

rows.translation: 寨中的祖父、叔父们、兄弟们来了。我的祖父也来了，我的父母也来了。
rows.tujia: luo1you1-nie3 pa3pu1 a, ang1bei1-die1, qian1ngai4-die1 eng3jiu3, nga2-nie3 pa3pu1 be2 eng3jiu3, nga2-nie3 nie3ba3 be2 eng3jiu3.
rows.english: My grandfather, my uncles, and brothers came from the village, my grandfather and my parents all came.

rows.translation: 哎哟！他们爬山了，抱着我，抱着我，我还是不能说话，抱回来了。
rows.tujia: ei1yo1! ba3 gu3-lie3 nga2 be4, be4-bo3, nga2 a4duo3 sa3li3-ta1ti1, be4-bo3 mo3 song1kuo1 la.
rows.english: Well! They crossed the mountains, carrying me, and I still couldn't speak, and so they carried me home.

rows.translation: 喝这个水（药），喝那个水，都喝完了。啊！好！可以说话了。
rows.tujia: ge3di1 ce3 hu3, ai1di1 ce3 hu3 ao, hu3-ji2-lie3, a! ca2 la! li3-de1xi3 la!
rows.english: Drink this medicine, drink that medicine - I drank them all up. Ah! That's better! I could speak again.

rows.translation: 我住的那个地方呢，山里有许多悬崖。
rows.tujia: nga2 ong3-nie3 a1di1 kuo1 a yo, a3sa3 gai4 qi4, kang3ku1 hhi2 a.
rows.english: Where we lived, when you went up in the hills, there were big cliffs.

rows.translation: 我的哥哥，他有一年在山里种东西，背着一背屎，那个背笼很大啊！
rows.tujia: nga2-nie3 a3kuo1, guo2 qi3 long1 kang3ku1-bo3 ye3 se1, la2 wo3 se3 wo4, wo4-bo3 mo3, wo3sa3 gai4 qi4!
rows.english: My brother, one year he was in the mountains planting crops, with a load of manure on his back, what a huge back-basket it was!

rows.translation: 他从上面滚下来，话也不能说，什么也不能做，几天像死了的样子。
rows.tujia: guo2, guo2 ga3ha2-lie1 geng1ke4-lie3 ba3ti3 hhi2 yo, sa3 be2 li3-ta1tiu1, qing3mo1 guo2 ri1-ta1ti1, ga4 nie1 duo3 se2-liao3 da4ye2ze3.
rows.english: He, he fell down from the top, and couldn't speak any more, nor could he do anything else. For several days he lay there as though dead.

rows.translation: 我还有一个姑母，她家有东西。她在外面玩，扯野葱，她在山里走。
rows.tujia: nga2-nie3 a4duo3 ma3ma1 lao4 xie2, guo2 cu1 a ye3 xie2. guo2 le, wo4ta3 ge3ci2 ei, ra3ki1ci3 xi3, guo2 kang3ku1 hhi2-lie3,
rows.english: I also had an aunt, from a rich family. She went outside to have fun and to pick some wild onions,

rows.translation: 哎呀！走呀走，滚倒了，从这个悬崖上面滚下来，滚下来，滚到那个悬崖上面去了。
rows.tujia: ei1ya1! hhi2 a hhi2, geng1ke4-le, gai3di1 a3sa3 ga3ha2 ba3ti3 geng1ke4, geng1ke4, eng1di1 a3sa3 ga3ha2-bo3 zao3.
rows.english: off she went up into the mountains. As she was walking, she fell down from this cliff, down she tumbled, down onto the cliff-face.

rows.translation: 哎哟！他们家很急，把她挑回来，她已经死了。
rows.tujia: ei1ya1! ge4 cuo4 a, ji2di1ji2ga2 ao, ke4-bo3 mo3 song1kuo1, guo2 be2 se2 la!
rows.english: Oh! Her family, they were very upset, carrying her back home, but she was already dead.

sections.title: 2.7.2: 上山时发生的意外事件
sections.meta_en:
Tian Xintao, Daba Township, Yongshun County
recorded on 05 August 2002
sections.description_en:
Tian Xintao, Daba Township, Yongshun County
recorded on 05 August 2002

sections.meta:
永顺县大坝乡田心桃女士
记录日期 05 八月 2002

rows.translation: 我小时候，我和祖母一起住。
rows.tujia: nga2 bi2kui1 si3, nga2 a3ba1 da4ha3 ong3-bo3.
rows.english: When I was small, my grandmother lived in our home.

rows.translation: 我祖母什么都能做。她吃辣椒时，在火里面烧完辣椒，放一点油，舂一下，吃完了。
rows.tujia: nga2 a3ba1 qi3qie1 xie2 be2 ri1. guo2 pa1ruo1gu1 ga2, mi4 wo2tu1 la1 wu2, wu2-ji2-lie3, se3si2 la2bie1 po1, la1 bu2, ga2-ji2-lie3.
rows.english: My grandmother could do everything. She used to eat chilli peppers, she would cook them in the fire, and when they were done, add a little oil, crush them a little, and then eat them up.

rows.translation: 她的碗呢，她不肯洗碗。为什么？因为还有油和盐。
rows.tujia: guo2-nie3 qie3bi2 a, guo2-nie3 a, [wo1-ta1-duo3] a, qie3bi2 [wo1-ta1-duo3] a, [wo1-ta1-duo3] a, qing1mo3nie3? se3si2 la2bu1 xie2.
rows.english: Her bowl, her bowl, she wouldn't wash it, she wouldn't wash it, why? Because there was both salt and oil left [which she wanted to save for the next meal].

rows.translation: 她不肯把新衣服穿在外面，他穿的衣服旧了，就穿在外面。
rows.tujia: guo2-nie3 xi1ba1, a2xi1 mo3 guo2 wo4ta3 da2-ta1; guo2 da2-bo3 mo3 xi1ba1 a2pei1-liao3 ba, guo2 wo4ta3-bo3 da2.
rows.english: Her clothes, the ones she considered new she wouldn't wear outside: when the clothes she was wearing began to wear out, then she would wear them outside.

rows.translation: 她去山里背柴，又会在山里找东西。她还搓大麻，养大我的姑母，她从来都不浪费一点东西。
rows.tujia: guo2 a4duo3 kang3ku1 a ka3 wo4, a4duo3 kang3ku1 a ye3 ni1, guo2 a4duo3 ce3ku1 ce4, ma3ma1 long4, guo2-nie3 ye3 la2be1 duo3 bie4-ta1.
rows.english: She would go up into the hills for firewood, and would look for useful plants too. She also spun hemp fibre and looked after my aunts, she never wasted a single thing she had.

rows.translation: 她教我，教了我很多东西，我全部记得。
rows.tujia: guo2 nga2 bo3 a2yi1-bo3, a2yi1-lie3 ri3di2ri3ga2, nga2 yi2xi1 die2-bo3-la1.
rows.english: She taught me, taught me many things, all of which I can still remember.

sections.title: 2.7.3: 我的祖母
sections.meta_en:

sections.description_en:
Tian Xintao, Daba Township, Yongshun County
