sections.meta:
永顺县大坝乡田心桃女士
记录日期 05 八月 2002

rows.translation: 我从前读书，在外面读书，还要走路。我们去长沙读书，我们走路，要走十五天才到长沙。
rows.tujia: nga2 di1ga3 ci1tu1, wo4ta3 ci1tu1, a4duo3 la4 hhi2-duo3. ang2ni1 cang3sa1-bo3 ci1tu1, ang2ni1 la4 hhi2, hi2 ong1 nie1 mo3 hhi2 mo3 cang3sa1 ye4,
rows.english: When I was a student, I went away to study, and had to walk there. We went to Changsha to study, and we walked, walked for a full fifteen days to reach Changsha.

rows.translation: 哎哟！脚很痛，手也很痛，就再也走不动了。
rows.tujia: ei1ya1! ji3 a, di2di1di2ga2, jie2 be2 di2di1di2ga2, hhi2 du1 hhi2-ta1tiu1.
rows.english: Oh! Our feet were ever so painful, our hands were also painful, we couldn't have walked any further.

rows.translation: 到那里睡着也痛，坐下来也痛，走又不能走。哎哟！我们啊，我们都很急。
rows.tujia: ai1du1 ye4, nie2-bo3 be2 di2, ong3-bo3 be2 di2, hhi2 be2 hhi2-ta1ti1, ei1ya1! ang2ni1 ya du1, ma2ni1 duo3 ji2di1ji2ga2.
rows.english: When we got there, our feet hurt even while we were sleeping, when we sat they hurt, and we couldn't walk. Well, we were all totally worn out.

rows.translation: 我们读完一年书回来，从长沙回到永顺，回来时，在路上有很多强盗。
rows.tujia: ang2ni1 song1kuo1-bo3 la2 long1 tu1 la, tu1 la, [cang3sa1-lie1 ying1seng3-bo3] song1kuo1, song1kuo1-bo3, la4qiu1-lie1 ye3 a4yi3-ma1 ri3di2ri3ga2.
rows.english: We went home after a year of studying, coming back to Yongshun from Changsha, coming back, there were bandits everywhere on the way.

rows.translation: 哎哟！回来时要经过沅陵永顺，我们坐船了。船呢，在途中，船里的人全部被打翻了。
rows.tujia: ei1yo1! yan3leng3 ying1seng3 du1 hhi2 a, ang2ni1 bu4 ong3, bu4 le, la4qiu1-lie1 luo4die1 cu4-ma1 yi2xi1 ha3 mo3 pie2 la,
rows.english: Well, we had to go through Yuanling and Yongshun. We got on a boat, on the way, the boat was overturned [by bandits] and everyone was thrown into the water,

rows.translation: 人全部走了，看不见人啦！我们什么都没有，我们很怕，开始回家。我们的盐也被他们抢了，一斤盐都没有，他们抢了十斤桐油。
rows.tujia: luo4die1 be2 yi2xi1 zao3, luo4 be2 yi3-bo3-da2 la! nga2 bo3 a qi3qie1xi3 du1 tao2, ang2ni1 ge4di1ge4ga2, song1kuo1-diu2 ba. nga2 duo3 la2bu1 be2 ga2-ci3 tai2, la2bu1 la2 qi1, tong3 se3si2 hi2 qi1 mo3 a4yi3.
rows.english: everybody ran away, there was nobody in sight! We were left with nothing and we were all very frightened, so we set off back home. As a result, we didn't even have any salt to eat, not even a pound, and they took all ten pints of tung oil.

rows.translation: 那些日子不能过啊！一天像一年那么长！
rows.tujia: a1di1 nie4 ka1-ta1ti1 a, ka1-ta1ti1 a, la2 nie1 la2 long1 da4ze3-bo3 hhe3!
rows.english: Those days were unbearable, unbearable, one day as long as a whole year!

rows.translation: 吃早饭，晚饭到哪里去吃呢？还要躲那些抢犯。早晨强盗把人捆着，晚上就开枪杀人！
rows.tujia: zao4gu1die1 zi3 ga2 la, lang3cei1 zi3 kei2-bo3 ga2, a4duo3 a4yi3-nie3 luo4 ye4-duo3. zao4gu1die1 a4yi3 luo4 luo4 ti2 la, lang3cei1 a4yi3 luo4 luo4 bu2 la!
rows.english: Breakfast, evening meals, where could we eat - we still had to hide from the bandits. They tied people up in the daytime, and slaughtered people at night!

rows.translation: 那些日子不能过啊！人人都说不能过啊！
rows.tujia: a1di1 nie4 ka1-ta1ti1, ka1-ta1ti1 a! a3se4 li3 be2 ka1-ta1ti1 a!
rows.english: Those days were unbearable, unbearable, everyone said they were unbearable!

title: 童年回忆
documentTitle: 自然对话: 童年的回忆

sections.description: （播放整段）自然对话: 童年的回忆
sections.meta:
龙山县他砂乡鲁云花小姐和鲁美艳小姐
记录日期 30 一月 2003

rows.translation: M：你小时候做什么？Y：我小时候比较好玩。去守牛，守牛的时候比较好玩。
rows.tujia: M: ni2 bi2kui1-zu2 qie4 gao1-la1? Y: nga2 bi2kui1-zu2 ya2 ge3ci2 ca2 la. eng wu2 ka4-xie2, wu2 ka4-zu2 ya2 ge3ci2 ca2 la.
rows.english: M: What did you do when you were small? Y: When I was small I had a good time. I used to look after the cow while it grazed, it was fun.

rows.translation: M：在哪里守啊？Y：在茄列山上面。然后在山上，这样守牛。
rows.tujia: M: kei3 ka4-la1? Y: qie1lie1 ku1za4 ga3 ya, ai1lie1 me qie1sa1 ya, hang2 wu2 ka4-la1.
rows.english: M: Where did you take it? Y: Up on Qielie Mountain, then also up in the hills, that's where I looked after it.

rows.translation: M：和谁一起？Y：伙伴们好多。我们在那儿守牛的时候，玩的人玩、背柴的人背柴、守牛的人守牛。
rows.tujia: M: a3se4 da4ha3? Y: a2guo1-die1 gai4 yo. ang2 ai1jie3-lie1 wu2 ka4-zu2 me, ge3ci2-ma1 ge3ci2, ka3 wo4-ma1 ka3 wo4, wu2 ka4-ma1 wu2 ka4.
rows.english: M: Who did you go with? Y: Lots of friends. When we were watching the cows, those with nothing to do enjoyed themselves, those who'd come to fetch firewood did so, and those who'd brought their cows grazed them.

rows.translation: 你呢？你小时侯做什么？M：我呢，小时候守牛，守牛很好玩。
rows.tujia: ni2 le? ni2 bi2kui1-zu2 qie4 gao1-la1? M: nga2 me bi2kui1-zu2 wu2 ka4, wu2 ka4 ge3ci2 ca2-xi3tai2.
rows.english: And you? What did you do when you were young? M: Me, when I was young I looked after our cow, that was great fun.

rows.translation: Y：你守牛的时候做什么？M：我守牛的时候和伙伴们一起，把牛一放，你就可以做你自己的事情。
rows.tujia: Y: ni2 wu2 ka4-zu2 qie4 gao1-la1? M: nga2 wu2 ka4 me a2guo1-die1 da4ha3, wu2 lao4 po1-lie3 me ni2 jiu1 ni2duo3 ni2-nie3 gao1-di1xi3.
rows.english: Y: What did you do whilst grazing your cow? M: When I was grazing the cow with my friends, you let the cow go and then you could do what you wanted.

rows.translation: 背一个大背笼，背一把柴刀，然后就去找柴呀！
rows.tujia: wo3sa3 lao3ga3 lao4 wo4, su1ku1 la2 pa1 wo4, ai1lie1 jiu1 ka3 ni1 ya!
rows.english: I would carry a big back-basket, and a firewood knife, and then go and look for firewood!

rows.translation: Y：是的，我们那个时候背柴，反正也是背着一个大背笼，然后就把柴刀磨得很锋利。然后找柴，那些找得快的人呢，就在那儿休息。
rows.tujia: Y: ang si2di1, ang2 ai1 si3jie3 ka3 wo4 ye1 huan3zeng4 wo3sa3 lao4 wo4-bo3 mo3, ai1lie1 jiu1 su1ku1 mo3-lie3 xi1la3 xi1la3, ai1lie1 ka3, ka3 ni1 ang, ai1di1 kuai2-ma1 me jiu1 ai1di1, ai1jie3 hi4-bo3.
rows.english: Y: Yes, we used to carry firewood, we always carried a large back-basket, and honed the firewood knife until it was very sharp. We then went off to look for firewood, those who had collected their firewood quickly would rest there.

rows.translation: 有些人还没有一捆，然后就自己找柴，找到以后呢，就在那儿玩。
rows.tujia: la1sa1die1 yi2 kong4 tai2-nie2 me jiu1 ka3, ai1lie1 jiu1 guo2duo3 guo2duo3 ni1 ang, ni1-lie3 yi1hou2 me jiu1, ai1 jiu1 ge3ci2 ang.
rows.english: Those who hadn't even got a bundle would go off on their own to find some. When they had collected firewood, they could play there.

rows.translation: M：哦！到家了，到家了就休息，什么都不要做。背的柴担子大就煎一只鸡蛋吃。
rows.tujia: M: o! cu1 ye4-liao3, cu1 ye4-liao3 jiu1 hi4-bo3, qie4 duo3 gao1-ta1-duo3 o eng, ka3 wo4-xi2 kong1zi1 ci4 jiu1 ra3lie3 la2 bu2, ra3lie3 la2 bu2 ta2-duo3 o.
rows.english: M: Oh! When we came home, we would rest at home, we didn't need to do anything else. If we had collected a big load of firewood, we could fry ourselves an egg, a fried egg.

rows.translation: 那时是小的时候，我们说的你都知道吧？Y：知道。M：就是这样，然后呢？Y：那么就一起玩，守牛嘛，没什么的。
rows.tujia: ai1 si3jie3, bi2kui1-zu2 ang2 li3-xi2 la, ni2 hao4ri3 ba? Y: hao4ri3. M: hang jiu1 huo2nie3, ai1lie1 le? Y: ai1me1 jiu1 da4 ge3ci2 ang, wu2 ka4 me qie4.
rows.english: Those were the days when we were young; you must know what we've been talking about. Y: I know. M: It was like that, and afterwards? Y: Well, we played together, grazed our cows, nothing much.

rows.translation: 那时我记着，那时候我们两家人只有一头牛。那守牛的时候，我就和我的姐姐我们两个，她就背柴，我就专门守牛。
rows.tujia: ai1 si3jie3, nga2 die2-bo3 me, ai1 si3jie3 ang2-nie3 wu2, nie1 ma1 da4 wu2 lao4-lang2, ai1 wu2 ka4-zu2 le jiu1 ang2-nie3 a2da1 ang2 nie1 hu3 mang, guo2 le jiu1 ka3 wo4, nga2 le jiu1 zuan1meng3 le wu2 ka4.
rows.english: I remember it well, we used to only have one cow between two households, and when we took the cow out to graze, my elder sister and I went together. She collected firewood, but my job was grazing the cow.

rows.translation: M：我现在知道了。我现在知道了。我呢，就和你不一样，我们就一家有一头牛。
rows.tujia: M: eng... o nga2 hao4rou3, nga2 hao4rou3! nga2 le jiu1 ni2 da4 da4ze3-da2, ang2 le jiu1 la2 ma1 le wu2 lao4-lang2.
rows.english: M: Hmm, I know, I know. It wasn't the same for me, just one household to look after the cow.

rows.translation: 一家有一头牛，天天都要我自己守，别人不肯守，又是我们的牛，我自己要守。
rows.tujia: wu2, la2 ma1 wu2 lao4 xie2, wu2 la2 nie1 hi4lie3 ang2duo3 ka4-duo3. luo4die1 ka4-ta1 mang, you2 ang2-nie3 wu2, nga2duo3 ka4-duo3.
rows.english: Our family had one cow, so we had to look after it ourselves every day. There was nobody else to look after it, we had to look after our cow ourselves.

rows.translation: 那时侯，下雨了走路很难！有太阳就好玩，下雨了就很累，路又不好走。有太阳的时候就很好玩，太阳下山时，我们就骑着牛，然后，然后就往家里去。
rows.tujia: ai1 si3jie3 la4 hhi2 me2ze3-liao3 die3! lao3ci3 meng ge3ci2 ca2, me2ze3-liao3 jiu1 lao1huo4 la, la4 you2 hhi2-xi2 lang1, lao3ci3-zu2 jiu1 ge3ci2 ca2-xi3tai2, lao3 bie1li3-zu2 ang2 jiu1 wu2 ji4-bo3 mo3; ai1lie1, ai1lie1 jiu1 cu1-bo3 eng3qie2.
rows.english: In those days, going out in the rain, ugh! When it was sunny we had fun, but when it rained it was tiring, and not easy to get around. When the sun was shining, it was great fun, and when the sun went down we would ride our cows, then we would go home.

rows.translation: 你呢？Y：一样的，那时我们守牛的时候，我们背一个背笼，有时候拿一本书。
rows.tujia: ni2 le? Y: da4ze3, ai1 si3jie3, ang2 wu2 ka4-zu2 mang, ang2 wo3 la2 da2 wo4, sang1mei1zai1 me ci1pei1 la2 pei1 hao3 a.
rows.english: How about you? Y: The same, when we used to look after the cow, I would carry a back-basket, and sometimes I would take a book.

rows.translation: 拿一本书，不背柴就看书，看书，看书，那些书好看，大家一起就看那些带着得书。
rows.tujia: ci1pei1 la2 pei1 hao3 me, ka3 wo4-da2 me jiu1 ci1pei1 ba4, ci1pei1 ba4, ci1pei1 ba4, ai1di1 ba4-bo3 ca2, ai1di1 ci1pei1 huo3-bo3-xi2 da4 la2 dong2 yi2qi3 da4 ba4.
rows.english: I would take a book, when I wasn't collecting firewood, I would read, I would read. If the books were interesting, we would sit together and read them.

rows.translation: M：哦！然后在山上面喊，在那上面喊，下面的人就回答，很好玩。现在呢，要读书了，然后好久都没有做那些事情了。
rows.tujia: M: o ai1lie1 ai1 ga3ha2 mo2hu1, ai1 ga3ha2 mo2hu1-lie3 jiu1, ba3ti3 luo4 jiu1 ti2, ge3ci2 ca2-xi3tai2. mu2lang1 me ci1tu1 le, ai1lie1 ai1di1 gai4jiu4 duo3 gao1-bo3-dao2 ao.
rows.english: M: And we used to shout up on the mountainside, shout from up there, and folk down below would shout back, that was great fun. Now we need to study, so it's a long time since we did such things.

rows.translation: Y：现在的小孩很快活，一点都不要做。M：我们那时候很苦，要天天守牛。
rows.tujia: Y: mu2lang1 qing2die1 di2yi1 kuai2huo1, qian2 duo3 gao1-ta1-duo3. M: ang2 ai1 si3jie3 me ku4-xi3tai2, la2 nie1 la2 nie1 wu2 ka4-duo3.
rows.english: Y: Nowadays children are very lucky, they don't do a stroke of work. M: We worked hard in those days, having to take the cow out every day.

rows.translation: 大人还要骂，不肯守就骂，就要打死。现在我们就是读书人，读书的时候，我有时还会想起那些好玩的日子。
rows.tujia: luo4ci1ba1 duo3 luo3-lie3, ka4-ta1 jiu1 luo3, ha3-si3-i. mu2lang1 le ang2 jiu1 ci1tu1-ma1, ci1tu1, ci1tu1-zu2 le nga2 you1 si3jie3 ai4duo3 die2-bo3-la1-nie2, ai1di1 ge3ci2 ca2-xi3.
rows.english: All the grown-ups scolded us, if you wouldn't take the cow out, they'd scold you, and give you a thrashing. Now we are students, and when I am studying, sometimes I remember what fun we used to have.

rows.translation: 天天记着，你呢？Y：我们那个时候也是一样的，你记得什么啊？
rows.tujia: la2 nie1 la2 nie1 die2-bo3-la1-nie2, ni2 le? Y: ang2 ai1 si3jie3 be2, ni2 qie4 die2-bo3-la1?
rows.english: Every day, I still remember, how about you? Y: We used to do the same things; what do you remember?

rows.translation: M：就是守牛的事。Y：那个谁都记着，那时侯最好玩了。都不肯呆在家里，总是去山里，去山里想守牛，守牛，背一捆柴。
rows.tujia: M: jiu2si2 wu2 ka4-xi2 la. Y: ai1 a3se4 duo3 die2-bo3-la1 heng, ai1 si3jie3, zui2 ge3ci2 ca2-liao3 wa! cu1 duo3 gao1-ta1lie3, huan2 kang3ku1-bo3 hhi2, kang3ku1-bo3 wu2 ka4-ca2. wu2 ka4 me, ka3 yi2 kong4 wo4.
rows.english: M: Just looking after our cow. Y: Everyone remembers that, those days, they were such fun! We didn't want to stay at home, we were always heading for the hills, always wanted to take the cow out to graze. Graze the cow, or collect a load of firewood.

rows.translation: M：不会忘记的，像今天一样。我们就要好好地读书，那个守牛的苦我们自己知道啊！
rows.tujia: M: si1ma3-ta1-ce1, lei4 da4ze3. ang2ni1 jiu1 cai3mo1 ci1tu1-duo3, ai1 wu2 ka4-xi2 ku4 le ang2duo3 hao4ri3 o!
rows.english: M: I can never forget it, just as if it's happening today. Now we have to study hard, we ourselves know what difficult times we had looking after our cows!

rows.translation: 我们自己好好地、长进地读书。你呢，现在就长进地工作。Y：是的。M：好吧！
rows.tujia: ang2duo3 cai3mo1 ci1 zang4jing3 tu1, ni2 le jiu1, mu2lang1 zang4jing3 gao1-duo3. Y: ang si2di1 eng. M: ca2-liao3 ba!
rows.english: We have to study hard, and you, you have to do well in your job. Y: True. M: OK!

title: 坡脚乡的日常生活
documentTitle: 自然对话: 坡脚乡的日常生活

sections.description: 这两位妇女是特意走到乡政府办公室来接受我们访问的。她们描述了日常生活中两个重要的负担：背柴和浇水；村里的可灌溉稻田只是可耕种田地的小部分。
sections.meta:
龙山县坡脚乡田玉英女士、彭彩娥女士、向培花女士和田伍翠女士
记录日期 19 七月 2002

rows.translation: A：你，你今天早晨，你今天早晨起得比较早啊！B：早什么？每天早晨都是一样的。
rows.tujia: A: ni2, ni2 lei1huan1lang1, ni2 lei1huan1lang1 zu2-xi2 ya2 zao4 mang! B: lei1xi3 zao4? lang2lang1he4lie3 da4ze3 sou2.
rows.english: A: You, this morning you, this morning you were out rather early! B: Early? I do this every morning.

rows.translation: A：今天早晨打算做什么呢？B：今天如果你没有来叫我呢，我今天就去背几根柴了。
rows.tujia: A: lei1huan1lang1 be2 lei1xi3 la1 ri1 o? B: lei4 ni2 nga2 jie3-di2-da2 me, nga2 lei4 ka3 ga4 zi2 wo4 ya le, ong.
rows.english: A: What were you going to do this morning? B: If you hadn't called me today, I would have gone and fetched some firewood.

rows.translation: A：那么，今天耽误你的工夫了。B：那没有，你今天已经说了嘛。农民呢，对什么都支持一点，对你们的工作也要支持一点。柴呢，每天都在背呀！
rows.tujia: A: ai1me1 ni2 lei4 hu3 dang1guo1-liao3. B: ai1 lei4 dang1guo1, ni2 lei4 li3-liao3 wa meng, jie2ri1ma1 me, kei2di1 ya la2bie1 ai1di1 le o, se2-nie3 gong1zuo3 be2 la2bie1 ai1di1 (null)-duo3 hang. ang, ka3 me la2 nie1 hi4lie3 wo4 ya meng!
rows.english: A: Oh, so we've interrupted your work today. B: Not really. It doesn't matter. As farmers, we should be ready to help with anything, we should support your work. Firewood, I have to fetch it every day!

rows.translation: A：那么，你吃完早饭没有？B：早饭吃了，我准备去背柴呢。A：早饭吃了吧。B：哼!
rows.tujia: A: ai1me1 ni2 zao4huan3 ga2-liao3 tai2? B: zao4huan3 meng ga2-liao3 le, ka3 wo4 die2-bo3-la1 ming. A: zao4huan3 ga2-liao3. B: eng!
rows.english: A: So, haven't you had breakfast yet? B: I've had breakfast, and I was about to fetch firewood. A: So you've had breakfast. B: Hmm!

rows.translation: A：吃了饭没有？饭呢？那么，你今天又背不到柴了！B：背不到柴也不要怕！柴呢，家里每天都有，不用贴着烧，要支持你的工作。A：事情已经变成这样子了。
rows.tujia: A: ye3 ga2-liao3 tai2? ye3? ai1 ni2 eng1ge1 lei4, ai1me1 lei4, lei4 ka3 you2 wo4 ti3-dao2 luo! B: ka3 wo4 ti3-dao2 ge4-ta1-duo3! ka3 me la2 nie1 hi4lie3 xie2, cu1 ye4 tie2-bo3 wu2-da2 luo, ni2 gong1zuo3 zi1ci3-duo3. A: gai2 sa3 zi2-liao3.
rows.english: A: What about lunch? Well, you are here today, so you won't be able to collect firewood now! B: Not being able to fetch firewood doesn't bother me! We always have firewood at home, we don't need to be too careful how much we burn, I should help you with your work. A: Since you have already come.

rows.translation: 那么，你今天从这里回去后，打算做什么呢？做一下什么呢？ B：有时间就做几下，没有空就不做吧。在田坎上方转一下，就是这么做。
rows.tujia: ai1me1, ni2 eng1ge1 gai2 da4ze3 song1kuo1-lie3, lai1 ri1 le? lei1xi3 la1 ri1 le? B: ri1-bie1 me guo2 ga4 dong2 ri1 ang, ri1-ta1-bie1 me ta4 ri1-gu2. tian3kang3 ka1tao1 zuan2-li1lian1di3 ang, gai2 me lai1xi3 gao1 o.
rows.english: Well, when you get back home today, what are you planning to do? What are you going to do? B: If I have time I'll do a few things, if not, I'll leave it. I might take a turn round the fields, that kind of thing.

rows.translation: A：今年稻谷好吗？?B：稻谷苗尖尖的，好久没下雨，都已经枯死了。
rows.tujia: A: long3bai3 li2bu1 ca2 mang? B: li2bu1 me miao3 jian1-ga1ca3, me2ze3-da2 guo2 ga3-si3-ji2-liao3.
rows.english: A: How is the rice this year? B: The rice seedlings are pinched and thin, there's been no rain, so they're completely parched.

rows.translation: A：干死了！雨也不下，真是没办法，没有办法。那么，你给稻谷放水没有？B：水天天都在放，晚上总是到十二点以后。
rows.tujia: A: ga3-si3-ji2-liao3! me2 ya ze3-ta1, gao1-ci3 tai2, bang2hua1 tai2. ai1me1 ni2 eng ce3, li2bu1 ce3 po1-la1 tai2 le? B: ce3 la2 nie1 hi4lie3 po1, lang3cei1-cai3 me huan2 po1 mo3 si3 ai2 dian1 ta2ci1 ye4 la.
rows.english: A: Withered up! When it doesn't rain, there's nothing you can do, nothing you can do. So, are you watering the rice? B: I water them day in day out, I water them every evening until after midnight.

rows.translation: A：天亮。 B：哼！有时候总是到天亮，晚上在麻柯里上，又有一点怕。十二点钟以后，我真的有一点怕，真是的。
rows.tujia: A: me2su3. B: eng! you1 si3hou3 huan2 me2su3, lang3cei1-cai3 eng, ma1kuo3li1 ma1kuo3li1 ga3, ge4 you2 la2bie1 ge4 la. si3 ai2 dian1zong1 yi1hou2, nga2 zeng1di1hua1 la2bie1 ge4 la, ngeng2 si1.
rows.english: A: Daybreak. B: Mm! Sometimes right till daybreak, in the evening on Makuoli, sometimes I'm a bit scared. After midnight, I'm really a bit afraid, really.

rows.translation: 哼！A：只有一个人，那是有点怕的。然后说完了。
rows.tujia: eng! A: la2 hu3-lang2 ai1 si1 ge4. ai1lie1 li3-ji2-liao3, ai1lie1...
rows.english: Hmm! A: Just on your own, that's scary. Now, we've finished talking ...

sections.description: 这位男孩刚刚吹完唢呐，是为土家族的传统打溜子活动作伴奏的。这一段对话记录村中的一位老师，鼓励孩子给我们讲讲他的日常生活。
sections.meta:
龙山县坡脚乡彭南京先生和11岁男孩
记录日期 19 七月 2002

rows.translation: A：你说汉语，你说土家语，别说汉语，你自己说！你说：“我今天在玩，去守牛，伙伴们一起去守牛。”B：我说或...A：啊！你自己说。
rows.tujia: A: ni2 pa1 li3, ni2 bi2zi1 li3, pa1 ta4 li3, ni2duo3 li3 a! ni2, "nga2 lei4 ge3ci2-la1, wu2 ka4-i-hu3, a2guo1-die1 wu2 ka4-i-hu3". B: nga2duo3 li3 huo1... A: a ni2duo3 li3.
rows.english: A: You are speaking Chinese; speak Tujia, don't speak Chinese, say something yourself! Say: "Today I am playing, I'm going to look after the cows, my friends and I are going to look after the cows." B: Shall I speak or ... A: Yes, say something yourself.

rows.translation: 你就这样说下去，你就不用说别的，你今天在做什么？?B：我在玩。A：你在哪里玩？B：我乱玩。A：你乱玩也要玩出一条路子来呀！
rows.tujia: ni2 jiu1 hang2 li3 mo3 da3-lie3, ni2 jiu1 ge2wai1 li3-ta1-duo3, ni2 lai1 ri1-xie2, lai4? B: ge3ci2-la1. A: ni2 kei2 ge3ci2-la1? B: nga2 luan2 ge3ci2-la1. A: ni2 luan2 ge3ci2 be2 ni2 be2 huan2 ge3ci2 mo3 la4 zu2-di2-duo3 mang!
rows.english: Just speak like this, you don't need to say anything else. What are you going to do today? B: I'm playing.. A: Where are you playing? B: I'm just messing around A: You are always messing around, even if you are only playing, you need to do it with some purpose!

rows.translation: B：伙伴们一起，一起快要去守牛了。今天正在玩，正在吹喇叭，打几下这些乐器。太阳已经到那儿了，快要去守牛了，好吧！
rows.tujia: B: a2guo1-die1 da4ha3, da4ha3 wu2 ka4-i-hu3, lai4 ge3ci2-la1, la1ba3 mie2-la1, gai2 jia1lian1 ga4 dong2 ha3. lao3ci3 eng1ge1 ye4-liao3, wu2 ka4-i-di2-hu3, ca2 la!
rows.english: B: My friends and I, we're going to look after the cows. Today we are playing, blowing trumpets, banging these instruments. The sun is already high in the sky, so we must take the cow out to graze. Good!

龙山县他砂乡张凤莲女士和刘珍英女士
记录日期 21 七月 2002

rows.translation: A：说土家语，现在不能说汉语了。孩子完全说土家语，家里完全用土家语，全部，孩子往外面去也全部是土家语。
rows.tujia: A: bi2zi1sa3 li3 me li3, mu2la1 pa1 sa3li3-di2-ta1tiu1. ang, bai1die1 wan3qian3 bi2zi1sa3, ang2 cu1 me, wan3qian3 bi2zi1sa3, qian3bu1, bai1die1 wo4ta3 hhi2 be2 wan3qian3 bi2zi1sa3 ang.
rows.english: A: Speak Tujia, don't speak any Chinese now. The children are completely Tujia-speaking, we all speak Tujia at home, all of us, the children always speak Tujia outside the home.

rows.translation: 其他的没有什么，说什么呢？老人家们全部是土家族，现在年轻人，我们这一伙全部是土家族。
rows.tujia: ang qi3ta1di1 me qie4 tai2 me, qie4 li3 yo? ang, lao4reng3ga3-die1 wan3qian3 tu1jia1zu3, mu2la1 nian3qing1reng3-die1 ang2 yi2 pao1 qian3bu1 si1 bi2zi1ka3, ang.
rows.english: Other things, there's nothing to add, what should I say? The old people are all Tujia, nowadays our young people, we are all Tujia.

rows.translation: 年猪...怎么几个孩子一起，真的有很多苦事。孩子几个一起真的很累，养啊，养着孩子真的很苦。
rows.tujia: nian3zu3, qing3mo1 bai1die1 ga4 la1hu3 da4 zeng1di1hua1, ku4-di you1 mai2-di eng, bai1die1 ga4 la1hu3 da4 zeng1di1hua1 lao1huo4 me, tuo1 eng, bai1die1 ye4-bo3 mo3 zeng1di1hua1 ku4 lie3 ku4.
rows.english: The New Year pig... All these children together, truly, we could have opened a shop to sell our unhappy times, we had so many. Having all these children was really tiring, raising them, raising the children really was hard.

rows.translation: 现在呢，快活了，说解放了快活也不快活，快活了。那你现在比较好了。那个时候，他辛苦到背都驼了，他自己...
rows.tujia: mu2la1 me you2 kuai2, gai1huan3-le, kuai2huo1-liao3 me be2 kuai2huo1-da2, kuai2huo1-liao3. ai1, ni2 ai1 mu2la1 me, you2 ya2-hao1-liao3. ai1di1 si3jie3 die3, guo2 ku4 mo3, ku4 mo3 guo2 yao1gang1 duo3 tuo3-liao3, guo2duo3...
rows.english: Now it's better, liberation, things are better, and sometimes not, happier. Things are better for you nowadays. Those days, your husband worked so hard that his back became bent, he himself...

rows.translation: B：现在呢，孩子全部长大了，你和成伯伯一起那可以...你不像我们，像我们孩子都还小。
rows.tujia: B: mu2la1 me, bai1die1 yi2si1 qi1si2-ji2-liao3, ni2 ceng3long3be2 da4 ai1di1 (null)-di1xi3... ni2 ang2 da4ze3-da2, ang2 da4ze3 meng bai1die1 yi2si1 bi2kui1-bo3-la1-nie2.
rows.english: B: Now the children are all grown up, you and Cheng Longbe together can... you are not like us, we have children who are still small.

rows.translation: 年轻的时候也是这样。我们的年龄也没有隔多少，你起码比我大十来年，十来年。
rows.tujia: nian3qing1 be2 hong3huan4 hang2nie3, be2 gai4-lang2 ge2-bo3-da2 la, nga2 ni2 qi1ma1 si3 lai1 nian3, si3 lai1 nian3 ci4.
rows.english: It's always like this when they are young. Our ages are not that different, You are at least ten years older than I am, ten or so years.

rows.translation: A：那大十、十一年，我今年七十岁了。你们呢，三四十。B：我四十六七了。A：就是嘛，像你们呢，还在后面。
rows.tujia: A: ai1 si3, si3 yi2 nian3 ci4-nie3, nga2 long3bai3 qi2 si3 sui2-liao3 wa. se2 me, sang1 si2. B: nga2 me, si2 si3 lu2 qi2-liao3. A: jiu1 jian1 luo, se2 da4ze3 me hai3 zai2 qing3nie2.
rows.english: A: Ten, eleven years older, I'm seventy this year. You, you are in your thirties or forties. B: I'm forty-six or seven. A: There you are,

rows.translation: B：也是这样的。那又这样啊，身体也这样，做工也比较累。总是这样，你自己苦，不做又没有办法。
rows.tujia: B: ye1 hang2nie3 la. ai1di1 you2 hang2nie3, suo4ti3 be2 hang2nie3, ye3 ri1 be2 ya2 lao1huo4, hong3huan4 gai2 da4ze3, ni2 guo2duo3 ku4 me ri1-ta1 you2 bang2hua1 tai2.
rows.english: your time is still to come. B: Indeed it is, that's the way it is. Your health is the same, you work and you tire more easily.

rows.translation: A：那总是要做的。养猪啊，养几只猪啊，做工呢，你给它们一年的肥料呢，也要钱。
rows.tujia: A: ai1 huan2 ri1-duo3, zi4 la long4 a, zi4 ga4 long3 long4 me, ye3 ri1 me ni2 be2 ge4 bo3 la2 long1 hui3liao2 le, be2 tong3qian3...
rows.english: It's always like this, you work hard, but you have no choice. A: You have to keep on working: raise some pigs, raise a few pigs, work in the fields, you give them fertiliser for a year, you need money...

rows.translation: B：就是这样嘛，你到家也算不拢帐，你搞什么都累。又做工，搞什么也都是这样的。
rows.tujia: B: jiu1 huo2nie3 bu2si1, ni2 cu1 gao1 be2 suan2 bu2 long1 zang2, ni2 qie4 gao1 duo3 be2 lao1huo4, you2 ye3 ri1, qie4 gao1 duo3 be2 hang2nie3.
rows.english: B: It's like that, isn't it; you can't make ends meet, whatever you do leaves you tired, you work some more, whatever you do is like this.

rows.translation: A：现在孩子又在读书，读书的时候，养一两只猪，充当他们的学费。就这样，钱也有一点，供一下他们读书。
rows.tujia: A: you2 bai1die1 mu2la1 ci1ci1 tu1-nie3 si3jie3 me, zi4 lao4 nie1 long3 long4 a, ge4ze1 lao4 cong1 heng, jiu1 huo2nie3, be2 tong3qian3 dian2 xie2, ci1ci1 la1 pang3.
rows.english: A: Now my child is at school, when they're at school, I keep two pigs, enough for school fees. In this way, I can have some money to send them to school.

rows.translation: B：不搞这个的话，钱从哪里来呢？你投生了农民，不搞没有办法，是这样的。
rows.tujia: B: gai2 gao1-ta1 me kei3-lie1 huo3-di2 o? ni2 ye3ri1ma1 tou3seng1-bo3 bang2hua1 tai2, gao1-ta1 me, hang2nie3.
rows.english: B: If you don't do this, where would you get [money] from? If farming is your lot, that's the only way to get it.

rows.translation: A：农民呢，总是要长进，总是自己要有个计划。
rows.tujia: A: ye3ri1ma1 me, huan2 zang4jing3, huan2 guo2duo3 ji2hua1 la2 di4 o.
rows.english: A: Farmers, they're getting ahead, but they must have their own plans.

rows.translation: B：哼！不搞不行，你不搞就没有，这样一点都没有了，这样，你搞得呢，也有一点，就是这样。
rows.tujia: B: eng, gao1-ta1 me bu2xing3, ni2 gao1-ta1 me tai2, hang2nie3 dian2 duo3 tai2, hang2la3, ang ni2 gao1-ce1 me, be2 dian2 xie2 ang, hang2la3 ang...
rows.english: B: If you don't, it won't do; if you don't, then you can't [earn money], you won't have anything. If you do something, then you'll get a bit, it's like that...

rows.translation: A：你自己就是一个人，劳动力你总是有点。B：田里没有水，雨从哪里来啊？什么都没有，那时候一样，在家做。A：你又没有那个做得厉害的家属。
rows.tujia: A: ni2 guo2duo3 luo4 la2 zi2-bo3, lao3dong2li3 me huan2 dian2 xie2. B: si3tie2 ngang2-da2-nie2, me2ze3 kei3-lie1 huo3-di2 o? qie4 duo3 tai2 la, ai1 si3jie3 da4ze3, cu1 gao1. A: ni2 ai1di1 ri1 heng4-ma1 jia1cu1 me you2 tai2 luo.
rows.english: A: You're also an able-bodied individual, you do have the ability to work. B: There's no water in the paddy fields, where are you going to get rain from? There's nothing worth selling, so we stayed at home, just like in the past. A: You don't have any fit young relatives who can help you.

sections.title: 3.3.1: 村里的生活
sections.meta_en:
Zhang Fenglian & Liu Zhenying, Tasha Rural Township, Longshan County
recorded on 21 July 2002
sections.description_en: These two texts paint starkly contrastive pictures of daily life. At first glance it might seem as though women do all the work, but this is not really the case. Educating children costs money, so typically the men go into the big cities to work in factories or on building sites while their wives manage the family farm on their own. Once their children have left home, life becomes a little more relaxed. Older folk often just look after the livestock while younger family members farm the land.

sections.description:
龙山县他砂乡张凤莲女士和刘珍英女士
记录日期 21 七月 2002
sections.meta:
龙山县他砂乡彭施宽先生和王焕明先生
记录日期 21 七月 2002

rows.translation: A：我呢，早晨呢，大概八点钟以前起来。起了以后呢，抬两桶水。抬水以后呢，然后就洗一下鼎锅。
rows.tujia: A: nga2 le zao4gu1die1 le, ei1di1 da2kai1 ba2 dian1zong1 yi1qian3 zu2-diu2, zu2-le yi1hou2 le ce3 lian1 tong1 di1di1, ce3 di1di1 yi1hou2 le, ai1lie1 jiu1 xie1pong1 la2 dong2 wo1
rows.english: A: In the morning, I usually get up before eight o'clock. After getting up, I fetch two buckets of water. After getting the water, I wash the cooking-pot.

rows.translation: 洗了鼎锅以后呢，洗了米就在那煤炉子上煮一下饭。这边煮饭，那边又准备菜。准备一下菜，然后用菜刀把蔬菜好好地切一下。
rows.tujia: xie1pong1 wo1-le yi1hou2 le, zi3hhe3 wo1-lie3 jiu1 ai1 mei3lu3zi3 ga3-lie1 jiu1 mang1mang1 la1 bang2, ge3la1bi1 bang2 le eng1ge1la1bi3 ha1ce1 you2 dian2 la2 dong2 zun1bei3, ai1lie1 tuo3tuo3 [huo3lie3] guo2 cai3mo1 la2 dong2 suo4,
rows.english: When I've washed the pot, I wash some rice and cook it on top of the coal burner. While the rice is cooking, I prepare a few vegetables and slice them up neatly with a chopper.

rows.translation: 切了以后，然后我就一个人开始吃早饭。总是买酒喝，每餐五六口酒，我还是要喝的。
rows.tujia: suo4-lie3 yi1hou2 eng, ai1lie1 nga2 jiu1 zao4huan3 la2 hu3-lang2 ga2-la1-hu3. re2 huan2 di1di1-bo3 hu3-la1, nga2 huan2 da2kai1 ong1 wo3 ze2 hai3si2 hu3-duo3.
rows.english: After slicing them, I start eating my breakfast, on my own. I'm always bringing wine back to drink, five or six mouthfuls with every meal, I still need my wine.

rows.translation: 我可以喝六口，六口还可以，体质还是好像还可以。嘿，今天没有事情，吃完早饭就洗一下碗。
rows.tujia: nga2 ri1-xi2 mang, wo3 ze2, wo3 ze2 ri1-la1-nie2 a, ti1zi1 hai3si2 hao1qian2 gao1-di1xi3-nie2. ai, lai4 sa3 tai2, zao4huan3 ga2-ji2-lie3 jiu1 qie3bi2 la1 wo1.
rows.english: My habit, six mouthfuls, I'm still used to six mouthfuls, my body is still able to take that much. And if I've nothing to do that day, I wash up after finishing breakfast.

rows.translation: 放了牛，然后我自己又在那里跟他们一起打几下牌。打了牌以后，然后又煮夜饭吃。
rows.tujia: wu2 jie4-lie3, ai1lie1 nga2duo3 you2 eng1ge1 ge4 da4ha3 pai3 ji1 pai3 ha3, pai3 ha3-lie3 yi1hou2 le you2 eng, ai1lie1 you2 ye2huan1 bang2-bo3 ga2.
rows.english: I take the cow out, and then I go round to their place to play a few rounds of cards. After playing cards, I cook my evening meal and eat it.

rows.translation: 吃过夜饭又看几下电视。看到大概十来点钟，我习惯了。
rows.tujia: ye2huan1 bang2-bo3 ga2-lie3 me you2 dian2si2 ga4 dong2 ba4, ba4-lie3 da2kai1 si3 lai1 dian1zong1, nga2 xi3guan2-liao3.
rows.english: After the evening meal, I watch a bit of television, watching until about ten o'clock, that's my usual habit.

rows.translation: 唉！还有宵夜，还吃一餐。喝三口左右的酒，然后就睡觉了。哟！我一天的生活就是这个习惯，讲完了！
rows.tujia: ei! xiao1ye1-duo3-nie2, you2 ye3 la2 mong2 ga2-nie2; re2 suo1 ze2 zai2 hu3-lie3; ai1lie1 jiu1 nie2-bo3-hu3. you! ngo1 yi2 tian1-di seng1huo3 jiu1 ze2guo1 xi3guan2, jian1-wan3liao1 o!
rows.english: Oh! I also have a midnight snack, I still need another meal, drinking about three mouthfuls of wine, and then I go to bed. So, my daily life follows this pattern, that's all!

rows.translation: B：我好像没有什么讲的。A：说吧！B：我好像没有什么说的，什么都已经说了，再没有说的。
rows.tujia: B: ngo1 hao1qian2 mei3you1 seng1mo3 jian1-di. A: ri1 la! B: nga2 hao1qian2 he2ba3 la li3-ci3 tai2 me, qie4 duo3 jing1 li3-lie3 li3-ci3la1 tai2.
rows.english: B: I don't really have anything to say. A: Go on! B: I don't have anything worth saying, you've said it all, there's nothing more to say.

rows.translation: 每天吃了就做，做了就吃，然后其他的有什么讲的呢？这个没有什么意思，没什么说的。
rows.tujia: la2 nie1 hi4lie3 ga2-lie3 me jiu1 ri1, ri1-lie3 me ga2, ai1lie1 me qi3ta1di1 qie4 li3 yo? gai3di1 qie4 yi2si3 la1 tai2, li3-ci3la1 tai2 ya!
rows.english: Every day I eat and I work, work and eat, what else is there to say? This really isn't very interesting, there's nothing to say.

rows.translation: A：你不能喝酒吧。B：我不能喝酒，我不喝酒。每天都这样，没什么说的，没有好多讲的！
rows.tujia: A: ni2 re2 hu3-ti2. B: nga2 re2 hu3-ti2, nga2 re2 hu3-da2. la2 nie1 hi4lie3 qie4, he2ba3 li3-ci3 tai2, mei2die3 hao1duo1 jian1-di!
rows.english: A: You can't drink. B: I can't drink, I don't drink. Every day is the same, there's nothing to say, I don't have much to say!

rows.translation: A：那我就没有讲的啦！
rows.tujia: A: na2 wo1 jiu1 mei3you1 jian1-di la!
rows.english: A: I don't have anything to say either!

龙山县他砂乡彭施宽先生和王焕明先生和乡长向华先生
记录日期 21 七月 2002

rows.translation: A：你说。B：你先说，说吧。A：田大板呢，那个人还是比较凶，样子又不太好看。
rows.tujia: A: ni2 ri1. B: ni2 ri1-pie3, ri1 luo. A: tian3da2bang4 le, ai1 luo4 hai3si2 bi1jiao1 wo2, yan2zi1 you2 hang2 ze3-da2.
rows.english: A: You do it. B: You speak first. A: Tian Daban, he was a rather ferocious character, not so good-looking either.

rows.translation: 但是他在我们他砂这个范围呢，他还是不会乱来的。为什么呢？他呀，在本地这里还是要留一点情。所以呢，他还是不肯乱搞。
rows.tujia: dang2si2 guo2 ang2ni1 ta1sa1 gai2 huan2wei3 le, guo2 hai3si2 luan2 gao1-da2, qing1mo3nie3 le? guo2 ri, gai2 beng2di1 gao2-cai3 hai3si2 dian2kui1 liu3qing3-duo3-nie2, suo1yi1 le, guo2 hai3si2 luan2 gao1-ta1,
rows.english: But to us in the Tasha area, he didn't cause any trouble. Why? Because he had to show some consideration for the local area. Therefore, he didn't cause trouble here.

rows.translation: 但是呢，这个人呢，心还是比较毒。如果是你得罪了他呢，他就会把你弄死。人家呢，也怕他。
rows.tujia: dang2si2 le, gai2 luo4 le hai3si2 bi1jiao1, xing1 bi1jiao1 du2, guo2 ru3guo1 si1 ni2 dian2kui1 ai1di1 (null)-liao3 le, guo2 jiu1 ni2 ri1-alie3-hu3. luo4die1 le be2 guo2 ge4.
rows.english: However, this chap, he was pretty wicked. If you upset him at all, he would do away with you. All the folk, they were afraid of him.

rows.translation: 那家伙很厉害！嘿！哪时死在他手上都不会知道。啊！这个家伙真不得了！所以，他在我们这里算是比较...B：凶的一个人。A：是不是这样，你又讲吧。
rows.tujia: ai1 jia1huo1 za2si1 ei! hei! qie4 si3jie3 guo2-jiao3 se2-liao3 duo3 ha1tai2, a! gai3di1 jia1huo1 bu2die1liao1! suo1yi1, guo2 ang2 gao2-cai3 si1 suan2 bi1jiao1... B: ze2-lu3 wo2-nie3-xi2 luo4 la2 hu3. A: si1 bu2si1 hang2nie3, ni2 you2 ri1.
rows.english: That fellow was amazing! Hey! You could die at his hands without even knowing about it. Wow! That chap was really amazing! So, in our area he was reckoned to be rather... B: ... a fierce chap. A: Wasn't he like that? You say your bit as well.

rows.translation: B：真正被他弄死的，就是信地村的田珍树，他就是进了牛栏洞，他把解放军的人打死了。
rows.tujia: B: guo2 zeng1zeng2-di ri1-si3-liao3, xing2di1 jiu1 tian3zeng1su2 la1 hhi3-lang2, guo2 jiu1 si1 liu3lang3dong2 qie4li3-lie3, guo2 gai1huan3jing1 yi3luo2pai3 ha3-si3-lie3.
rows.english: B: The only one he actually killed was Tian Zhengshu, from Xindi village, he went into Niulan Cave [to hide], and there he shot dead Yi Luopai from the People's Liberation Army,

rows.translation: 打了，当时可能最快了，还是天桥村姓卫的，他们那一群人服侍他。最后了，解放军把他抓到了，以后呢，砍头了。
rows.tujia: ha3-lie3, dang1si3 kuo1neng3 zui2 kuai2-le hai3si2 tian3qiao3 wei2ji1wan2 a, ge4 ai1 yi2 pao1 guo2 hu1si4, sa3guo1 le gai1huan3jing1 guo2 zuo2-duo3liao3 yi1hou2 le, kuo1ba1-bu2li1 tie2-liao3.
rows.english: he shot him. Perhaps the first person to arrive there after the shooting was Wei Jiwan from Tianqiao Village; there was a group under his command. In the end, the People's Liberation Army caught him, and afterwards cut off his head.

rows.translation: A：砍了还在树上挂了三天啦。B：挂了三天，后来挂了三天以后呢，他的头依然被领导拿去了。
rows.tujia: A: tie2-lie3 hai3 ka3mong3 ga3 suo1 nie1 gua2-lie3 ba. B: suo1 nie1 gua2-lie3, qing3nie2 suo1 nie1 gua2-lie3 yi1hou2 le, guo2 kuo1ba1-bu2li1 yi1rang3 ga3ha2 duo3 huo3-lu3 la, eng, huo3-lu3.
rows.english: A: Cut it off and hung it on a tree for three days. B: Hung it up for three days, and after those three days, his head was taken away by the leaders.

rows.translation: 哼！拿去了。A：用纸包去的。B：拿纸包去的。A：那最后呢，听说，他被埋葬的那地方以前是有水的。后来，怎么他埋了以后呢，水又没有了。
rows.tujia: A: ci1ki1ta1 huo3 pe1-lu3-xi2. B: eng, ci1ki1ta1 huo3 pe1-lu3-xi2. A: ai1di1 zui2hou2, guo2 bong3-bo3-xi2 ao1-cai3, da3pie1 si1 ce3 xie2 huo2 li3-la1 o, qing3nie2 qing3mo1, guo2 bong3-lie3 yi1hou2 le ce3 you2 tao2 wa.
rows.english: They took it away. A: Took it off wrapped in paper. B: They wrapped it in paper. A: Then finally, the place where they buried him, it used to have a spring, then after he was buried, there was no longer any water.

rows.translation: 你听说过这个没有？B：听说过，听说过。A：其他的，
rows.tujia: ni2 gai2 xi4 huo1 xi4-bo3-da2? B: xi4-bo3-la1, xi4-bo3-la1 o. A: qi3ta1di1 hai3 eng... guo2-nie3 du1 hang2 ai1di1 (null)-da2. B: he2ba3 la2 li3-ci3 tai2.
rows.english: Had you heard about this? B: Yes, I've heard of it, heard of it. A: Other stories...

rows.translation: 他的事都没这么多说的。B：没有那么多说的。A：当时呢，我们这里是大概在1951年那时解放的。嘿！乡长刚才说了，我们出生以后呢，社会真的搞得乱七八糟。
rows.tujia: A: dang1si3 le, ang2-nie3 ge3 si1 da2kai1 wu1 yi2-nie3 ao1-cai3 gai1huan3-bo3-xi2, ai! xian1zang1 mo1cai3 li3-liao3, ang2ni1 cu3seng1 yi1hou2 le, se2hui1 zeng1di1 gao1-lie3 guo2 luan2qi3ba3zao1!
rows.english: there are not so many other things to say about him. B: Nothing much else. A: In those days, our area was one of those liberated in about 1951. Ah! As the village head has just said, after we were born, society was changing, it was total chaos!

rows.translation: 到这个里面好像又没那么...那一句没说好，可能你说吧...
rows.tujia: gai3di1 wo2tu1 ye4 hao1qian2 you2 dian2 ai1di1 (null)-dao2 da4ze3... ai1 la2 ze2 ri1-bu1duo3, kuo1neng3 ni2 ri1...
rows.english: But it wasn't as bad in our village ... that sentence was all wrong, perhaps you should speak...

rows.translation: A：他们那里，那里，那个是溜子，那个动作叫什么？打锣的，他们是打锣的。他们那些是石堤人吧，你知道不知道？B：是那里的人，是报格人。
rows.tujia: A: ge4ze1 eng1ge1, eng1ge1, ai1di1 liu1zi1, ai1di1 lai1xi3 jie3 la? luo2 ha3 ao, luo2 ha3-nie3-xi2, ge4ze1, ge4ze1 eng1ge1 si3ti3-suo1 ba, ha1 ha1tai2 ou? B: eng1ge1-suo1, bao2ge3-suo1.
rows.english: A: The ones over there, over there, that's 'daliuzi' [musical entertainment], what do you call that? They are striking gongs, the ones striking gongs. They are from Shidi, don't you know? B: Yes, they are from there, and from Baoge.

rows.translation: A：你会打吗？你把这个打溜子，打锣的，打一下试试，你不能练那个嘛，也不会练。报格人打锣的，对，就是这个，这个。打得好！
rows.tujia: A: gai3di1 ha1 ha1tai2? ni2 liu1... gai3di1 luo2 ha3-nie3-xi2 qian2la1 ha3 ba, ni2 guo2 ai1 lian2-ta1ti1 ma o, lian2-ci1hhe1 ma. bao2ge3-suo1 luo2 ha3-nie3-xi2, ang jiu1 gai3di1, gai3di1 me ha3-xi2 ca2 ang.
rows.english: A: Do you know how to ['daliuzi']? You try striking the gong, try it, you can't do it, you don't know how to do it. The one from Baoge on the gong, that's this one here. He plays well.

rows.translation: 你没有另外可以说的话，你会念（打溜子的节拍）就念几句吧。我不会念，现在没有别的可以讲了。它就是打溜子，没有讲的啦！
rows.tujia: ge2wai1 ni2 ai1 li3-ci3 tai2, ni2 ai1di1 nian2-hhe1 ga4 ze2 nian2, nian2-ci1hhe1, ge2wai1 li3-ci3 tao2, bie2di1 mei3you1 jian1-di la, ta1 jiu2si2 da1liu1zi1, mei3you1 jian1-di la!
rows.english: If you don't have anything more to say, and you know [the rhythm for 'daliuzi'], then beat us a few bars. I don't know how to, I have nothing else to say now, nothing more to say. That's 'daliuzi', there's nothing more to say!

rows.translation: 打锣的...哒哒咚咚...哒哒咚咚...是这样打的，哒哒咚咚...
rows.tujia: luo2 ha3-nie3-xi2 dai1dai1... dang3dang3... dang3 dang3... hang2 ha3-nie3-xi2, ang... dai1dai1... dang3 dang3...
rows.english: The ones on the gongs go... (sound of gongs) like this ... (sound of gongs)

sections.description: 这段描述舍巴节中的茅古斯表演。茅古斯是土家族传统的古老舞蹈，跳舞者穿着用茅草做的服装，模仿不同的动作，包括农耕与打猎时的活动。
sections.meta:

记录日期 19 七月 2002

rows.translation: 那就是往天做茅古斯的，茅古斯就是那里的人们，像现在的人们做工一样。嘿！那时候，他们就是从前原始社会的人演变而来的，从变乱的时候开始搞的。
rows.tujia: ai1di1 jiu1 si1 wan1tian3 mao3gu3si1 ri1-nie3-xi2, guo2 jiu1 si1 be2 eng1ge1 luo4-die1, mu2la1 ye3 ri1-nie3-xi2 da4ze3 ang. ai! ai1 si3hou3, jiu1 wan1tian3 yan3si1 se2hui1 luo4 die3, luo4 die3 bian2-bo3-xi2, luan2-nie3 si3hou3-lie1 gao1-nie3-xi2.
rows.english: They are performers of the ancient 'maogusi' dance, that is, the people [in the photos] are performing actions similar to the way we work nowadays. Ah! In the past, people living in primitive communities used to do this, they started these dances during times of conflict.

rows.translation: 然后他们也要在那里吃东西。要过日子，然后他们就总是在山里做工。那里砍荒地、做工、摘小米，然后就在那里，
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 me ge4ze1 jiu1 be2 eng1ge1 ye3 ga2-duo3 le, nie4ka1-duo3, ge4ze3 jiu1 ai1lie1 jiu1 huan2 kang3ku1 ye3 ri1 a, ai1di1 eng1ge1 ye4 za2, ye3 ri1, hhi3 tie2, ai1lie1 eng1ge1 jiu1,
rows.english: Then they have to go there and eat; in order to live, they have to go and work in the mountains. There they open up wasteland and farm; they harvest millet.

rows.translation: 然后在那里摘小米呢，然后就在那里摘了呢，到家以后就打小米，打了以后就舂糍粑。
rows.tujia: eng1ge1 ai1lie1 hhi3 tie2 me, ta1nie1 jiu1 eng1ge1, ai1lie1 tie2-lie3 me cu1 ye4-liao3 jiu1 hhi3 ha3, ha3-lie3 meng jiu1 ba1ba1 bu2,
rows.english: Later, they harvest millet there, then having harvested it, they go home and thresh it and make it into glutinous 'baba' cakes.

rows.translation: 舂了糍粑后，就一起分开吃。吃完了呢，然后就吃饱以后，就是这样的，茅古斯就在那里做那些事情。
rows.tujia: ba1ba1 bu2-lie3 meng jiu1 da4pi3 mo3 ga2 ang, ga2-liao3 meng ai1lie1 me ga2 mo3 me3jie2-liao3 meng, jiu1 si1 luo4die1 hang2la3, luo4die1 eng1ge1, ai1di1 eng1ge1.
rows.english: When they've prepared the 'baba' cakes, they share them round and eat together. After they've eaten, then they're full. That's what they're doing [in the photos] in the 'maogusi' dance.

rows.translation: 他也有问媳妇的，他那里有男人也有女人。边走边找女人，找到了，就要那些女人做媳妇。
rows.tujia: guo2 be2 ye1 zuo4 si1lie3-nie3-xi2, guo2 be2 ye1 eng1ge1 luo4ba1-die1 ma3ma1-die1 xie2 ang. hhi2-lie3 jiu1 ma3ma1-die1 ni1 mo3 ni1-lie3 jiu1 zuo4 ni1 mo3 si1lie3-nie3-xi2.
rows.english: They also look for brides, there are both men and women. They're looking for women as they go, when they've found some, those women will become their daughters-in-law.

rows.translation: 然后呢，后来就一起抢女人的（图片里的动作）。哼！就这样，这个后面说的多得是。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 meng jiu1, ta1nie1 meng jiu1 da4ha3 ma3ma1-die1 a4yi3-nie3-xi2 ang, jiu1 hang2la3, gai3di1 ta1nie1 li3-nie3-xi2 die3 gei4di3 gei1.
rows.english: After that, they are the ones who are grabbing the women [in the photos]. Well, that's what they do, there's a lot more to say [about 'maogusi'].

sections.description: 这段描述舍巴节中的摆手舞表演。摆手舞是土家族于每年初春举行的舍巴节的高潮；大摆手舞包括一千人左右，舞中动作模仿农耕和其他日常活动，这些动作比茅古斯的动作更形式化。有些历史学家认为，摆手舞是由古代巴人的战阵舞演变出来的。

rows.translation: A：这个做东西的嘛（图片里）。B：好好地说，我不会说，慧慧。A：这是做工吧，做工的。B：打谷子的。
rows.tujia: A: gai3di1 ye3 ri1-nie3-xi2 mang. B: cai3mo1 li3, nga2 li3-ci1hhe1, hui2hui1. A: ang ni2 jiu1 ye3 ri1 mang, ye3 ri1-nie3-xi2. B: li2bu1 ha3 ang.
rows.english: A: These ones are working [in the photos]. B: You speak, Huihui, I don't know what to say. A: These are farming actions, these are farming actions. B: Threshing grain.

rows.translation: A：那么摆手舞近年才开始的，以前就砍荒地，那里砍了就是砍了荒地，就种小米、小米。做了东西呢，就在那里犁地、挖土、种玉米。
rows.tujia: A: ai1me1 bai1sou1wu1 gai2 nie4 ti3, xian1 ye4 za2, eng1ge1 ye4 za2-lie3 me jiu1 si1 ye4, ye4 za2-lie3 me jiu1 hhi3, hhi3 ri1 ang. ye3 ri1-lie3 me, jiu1 eng1ge1 li4 huo qie3, li4hong1 ga4, bao1bu1 ri1.
rows.english: A: Well, we've started doing the 'baishouwu' dance in recent years. In the past, they just got on with clearing the land, they broke up the soil, broke up waste ground, and grew millet. After this, they plough, dig the fields, and plant maize.

rows.translation: 种了玉米呢，种了玉米呢，就锄玉米。锄了玉米呢，就种烟草，种了烟草呢，就在那里种了烟草，烟草就生长了。
rows.tujia: bao1bu1 ri1-lie3 meng jiu1, bao1bu1 ri1-lie3 meng jiu1 bao1bu1 pu2 ang, bao1bu1 pu2-lie3 meng jiu1 yan1 se1, yan1 se1-lie3 meng jiu1, eng1ge1 yan1 se1-lie3 meng jiu1, yan1 si3 ang.
rows.english: When they've planted maize, planted maize, then they hoe between the maize. Once they've finished hoeing, then they plant tobacco. After planting tobacco, planting tobacco there, it grows.

rows.translation: 然后就背玉米，打稻谷，打了稻谷呢，就全部一起，然后就到那里挑了稻谷就... B：用扁担挑去了。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 meng jiu1 bao1bu1 wo4, li2bu1 ha3, li2bu1 ha3-lie3 meng jiu1 jie3-xi2 da4ha3, ai1lie1 jiu1 eng1ge1 li2bu1 ke4-lie3 jiu1... B: bian1dang3 huo3lie3 ke4.
rows.english: Later, they harvest the maize and thresh the grain. After threshing the grain, everybody together, they then carry the grain there, then ... B They're using shoulder poles.

rows.translation: A：挑了稻谷，就回家去了，就像这个。好！先犁，今天就...（犁地声音）...就那么...
rows.tujia: A: li2bu1 ke4-lie3 jiu1 cu1-bo3 song1kuo1-nie3-xi2, gai2 da4ze3 jiu1... ca2! qie3-pie3, lei4 jiu1 ang bian4dong3... jiu1 na2me1...
rows.english: A: After carrying the grain, they go home, like this ... Right! Plough first, then today... (sound of ploughing) then...

sections.description_en: In this text a photo of a baishouwu performance at the cultural festival is being described. Baishouwu, literally 'hand-waving dance', is the focal point of the traditional shebajie festival, which is held in early Spring. The dance, which has a large-scale form involving up to a thousand dancers, contains actions representing farming activities and other aspects of daily life, but in much more formalised forms than in maogusi. Some historians believe the dance to be directly descended from the war dances of the ancient Ba people, who are generally thought to be the ancestors of the Tujia. See the photo in the photo archive.

rows.translation: 骂媒人。

rows.english: Scolding the Matchmaker

rows.translation: 新娘：干豆开花夹对夹，背时媒人想鞋袜；板栗开花结球球，背时媒人想猪头。
rows.tujia: Bride: kuo2ti1 ka1pu1pu3 la2 ru1 la2 ru1, bei1si1 tu3ga3 cuo3xie2 ji1la1 di4; su2xi1bu2li1 ka1pu1pu3 bu2li1 ji2, bei1si1 tu3ga3 zi4 kuo1ba1 di4.
rows.english: Bride: The beans have flowered in pairs, Even at this time of sadness, the matchmaker is pestering me for shoes and socks; The chestnuts have flowered and are bearing fruit, At this unfortunate time, the matchmaker wants a pig's head.

rows.translation: 你男家吃女家走，到男家讲女家长得好，到女家吹男乖又巧。
rows.tujia: ni2 luo4bi3 cuo4 ga2 biu2 cuo4 hhi2, luo4bi3 cuo4 li3 biu2 si3-xi2 ca2; biu2 cuo4 li3 luo4bi3 re4kuo3kui1.
rows.english: You eat at the groom's home and then head for my home, You tell the groom's family that the bride is pretty, You tell the girl's family that the groom is very handsome.

rows.translation: 你骗我到公婆家，变成人家牛和马，人家动手就来打，打了骂了不解恨，
rows.tujia: ni2 nga2 ca4-bo3 luo4ba1 cuo4 ye4, luo4die1-nie3 wu2 ge3 da4ye2ze3, luo4die1 jie2 di1di1-bo3 ha3, ha3-ji2 luo3-ji2 me2ga3;
rows.english: You deceive me into marrying into the groom's home, To become like their cow or horse, People raise their hands to strike me, Even after hitting and scolding me their enmity remains,

rows.translation: 还要吃我的肉啊！还要吸我的血呀！
rows.tujia: a4duo3 nga2-nie3 si3 ga2-duo3! a4duo3 nga2-nie3 mie4 hu3-duo3!
rows.english: They want their pound of flesh! They want every last drop of blood!

rows.translation: 我只有逃出虎穴，山上岩屋是我家；山上鸟儿是我伴，山果子是我的饭。
rows.tujia: nga2 li2-nie3 cuo4 wo2tu1 xie2hui1 zu2-duo3, kang3ku1 a3ji1la3 nga2-nie3 cuo4; kang3ku1-nie3 ni2bi1 nga2 da4xi4; kang3ku1-nie3 bu2li1 nga2-nie3 zi3.
rows.english: I must escape from the tiger's den, The mountains will be my home; The birds on the hills will help me, And wild fruits are my food.

rows.translation: 这个日子实在苦，山上鸟儿背我走，飞向天空求自由。
rows.tujia: ge3di1 nie4 ke2ji1ji1, kang3ku1 ni2bi1 nga2 wo4-bo3 hhi2, me2 ga3ha2 ra2 ca2-xi2 ni1.
rows.english: These are truly bitter days, Would that a bird from the mountains would bear me away, And fly me high to a better life.

rows.translation: 媒人：天上无雷不下雨，地上无媒不成亲；媒人吃了千家饭，尽做好事配成双。
rows.tujia: Matchmaker: me2 ong3 ta1nie1 me2ze3 tai2, tu3ga3 tai2-nie3 zuo4ni3 be2 tai2; tu3ga3 zi3 ga2 ri3 cuo4 ri3-xi3tai2, ca2 sa3 ri1 mo3 zuo4ni3 xie2.
rows.english: Matchmaker: Without thunder rain will not fall, Nor will there be marriage without a matchmaker; The matchmaker eats in many a home, Working hard that marriages may occur.

sections.title: 5.1.1: 哭媒人
sections.title_en: 5.1.1: The Bride Sings with the Matchmaker
sections.meta_en:
Tian Xintao, Daba Township, Yongshun County
recorded on 05 August 2002
sections.description_en: Kujia, literally 'crying marriage' is a custom found among a number of ethnic groups in China, but it is practised to a far more sustained degree among the Tujia than in other minority groups. During the period prior to her wedding, the bride visits various relatives or friends each evening, staying to weep and sing with them. The tradition is hundreds of years old, but appears to have been given special impetus by the gaituguiliu reforms imposed on the Tujia in the early 18th century by the Qing court (see Introduction). Kujia may have developed to this level of sophistication among the Tujia as a covert form of protest against the Qing imposition of matchmaker-mediated arranged marriages, rather than the traditional love match. In the past, brides from wealthy families who could afford the time might weep every night for two or three months, while poorer brides would only weep for a week. Nowadays the practice has almost disappeared, though many older women are still able to perform kujia songs. On this and the next page, Mrs Tian Xintao sings a complete cycle of such songs. See the photo in the photo archive.

sections.meta:
永顺县大坝乡田心桃女士
记录日期 05 八月 2002

rows.translation: 新娘：天上星多月不明，爹娘为我费苦心：
rows.tujia: Bride: me2 ga3ha2 xi4bu2li1 ri3, su3su3 jia1jia1-da2, a3ba1 a1nie3 nga2 bo3 long1ke3si2li1 niao3:
rows.english: Bride: The sky is full of stars, but the moon does not shine, My father and mother have worked hard for me:

rows.translation: 一怕女儿受饥寒，二怕女儿巴病生，三怕穿戴不如人。
rows.tujia: la2 ge4 biu2 bo3 li2a4, sa4, nie1 ge4 biu2 bo3 suo4ti3 di2, suo1 ge4 biu2 da2-nie3 luo4die1-nie3 ca2-da2.
rows.english: Afraid lest their daughter should be hungry or cold, Afraid lest their daughter should suffer illness, Afraid lest their daughter's clothes should not be as good as others'.

rows.translation: 勤耕苦种费尽心，娘的恩情说不完，教我五岁学劳动。
rows.tujia: a2lie1 qie3 ke2ji1 se1 li1kuo1li1 si4-ji2, a1nie3 ca2-xi2 li3-ji2-da2, ong1 se1tong1 a1nie3 nga2 jie3-bo3 jie2ri1.
rows.english: My parents plough and sow with all their strength; I cannot describe all my mother's kindness, When I was five, my mother taught me how to farm.

rows.translation: 一教女儿学煮饭，二教女儿学结麻，三教女儿学背柴，四教女儿学挑花，五教女儿学写字。
rows.tujia: la2 jie3 biu2 mo3 zi3 ri1-duo3, o nie1 jie3 biu2 mo3 ce3ku1 pi3, suo1 jie3 biu2 mo3 ka3 wo4-duo3, a re1 jie3 biu2 mo3 ka1pu1 ri1, ong1 jie3 biu2 mo3 ci1ci1 a2.
rows.english: Taught me how a daughter should cook, Taught me how a daughter should twist hemp, Taught me how a daughter should fetch firewood, Taught me how a daughter should embroider, Taught me how a daughter should write.

rows.translation: 你把女儿养成人，你把女儿白抱了，你把女儿白背了。
rows.tujia: ni2 biu2 long4-bo3 mo3 gei1 qi4, ni2 nga2 be4 a be4-lie3 yi1 be4 la, ni2 nga2 wo4 a wo4 a yi1 wo4 la.
rows.english: You raised your daughter to adulthood, But it was in vain you nurtured me, In vain you bore me on your back.

rows.translation: 生来是个女儿命，好像霜打落地叶，狂风一吹到处飞；好像水打烂船板，巨浪一打到处漂。
rows.tujia: [long4-lie3] biu2-die1-nie3, suo1ce3 ha3-nie3 pu2ta1 da4ye2ze3, re2su4 su4-ji2 ke3du1 ra2; ce3 ha3-nie3 bu4 ka3 da4ye2ze3, ce3 lao3ga3 la2 ha3 duo3 [yi3-dao2].
rows.english: I'm born a woman, Like leaves nipped by frost, Blown by the wind, they fly in all directions; Like a ship's timbers buffeted by the waves, The waves break once and are seen no more.

rows.translation: 我快离别爹和娘，悲痛不止泪汪汪，生女不能养父母，重男轻女太不平。
rows.tujia: nga2 xie2hui1 a3ba1 a1nie3 pie4-bo3 hhi2, ji2-nie3 bu1ce3 duo3-xi2 ri3, biu2 si3 a3ba1 a1nie3 long4-ta1ti1, luo4bi3 du4 biu2 ru4 a4se3 ze2 be2 ca2-da2.
rows.english: Soon I will be uprooted from my mother and father, Shedding endless tears, Raising a daughter does not benefit her parents, Valuing male over female is so unfair.

rows.translation: 我的头发未长齐，我的个子未长大，结麻纺线还不会；
rows.tujia: nga2-nie3 sa2qi1 ong2 hhe3-da2, nga2-nie3 suo4ti3 ong2 qi4-da2, ce3ku1 ce4, tu4mong3 za2 a4duo3 ha1tai2;
rows.english: My hair has not grown long, My body has not grown tall, Twisting hemp and spinning thread I have not learnt;

rows.translation: 一担水也挑不起，一捆柴也背不起，千斤贵女未做饱，四两媳妇做到死。
rows.tujia: ce3 la1 ke4 be2 ke4-ta1ti1, a ka3 la1 wo4 be2 wo4-ta1ti1, du4ji3ji3 biu2 ri1 mo3 me3jie2-da2, re1 ji1-nie3 pii2 ao ri1 mo3 se2-bo3-duo3.
rows.english: A load of water I cannot carry, Nor can I bear a load of firewood, I haven't finished enjoying life as a precious daughter, A lowly wife must work until she dies.

rows.translation: 吃了一碗米的饭，要呕一担米的气；冷饭冷菜吃不进，冷言冷语听不得。
rows.tujia: zi3 la2 su1 ga2, me3ga2 hi2 po2 zi3-nie3 xie2; wu2qi1qi1-nie3 zi3, ha1ce1 ga2-ta1ti1, sa4-nie3 sa3 ze2 ru3-ta1ti1.
rows.english: For every bowl of rice I eat, I will have to endure a bushel of woe; I cannot bear to eat cold rice and vegetables, I cannot cope with heartless words.

rows.translation: 六月太阳晒不死，三姊四妹赛死人，你们真是狠心呀！硬把生女赶出门！
rows.tujia: wo3 si1 lao3ci3 ta2 se2-da2, zuo4ni3-die1-nie3 ye3 ri3 a2ci1 mo3 se2, se2ni2 li1kuo1li1 wo3ki1ki1! suo4ti3 si3-nie3 biu2 jie4 mo3 la1ming3 zu2!
rows.english: For six months the sun shines without fading, People are envious of my sisters' beauty, You are truly cruel to me! Pushing your own daughter out of the door!

rows.translation: 我头包人家的帕，要受人家爹娘骂；我身穿人家的衣，要受人家老少欺；
rows.tujia: nga2 luo4die1-nie3 jie2zu1 pe1, luo4die1-nie3 a3ba1 a1nie3-nie3 luo3; nga2 luo4die1-nie3 xi1ba1 da2, luo4die1 la2 cuo4 nga2 luo3, ha3;
rows.english: I will put on other people's headscarves, I have to endure scolding from my parents-in-law, I have to wear other people's clothes, I have to endure harsh words from another household,

rows.translation: 身穿人家的裤裙,要听人家老少话；包了人家的裹脚，要受人家的折磨。
rows.tujia: suo4ti3 luo4die1-nie3 ku3 da2, luo4die1 la2 cuo4-nie3 sa3 ru3-duo3; luo4die1-nie3 ji2la1 pe1, luo4die1 la2 cuo4 nga2 ha3, luo3.
rows.english: I have to wear other people's trousers, I have to obey those from another household, I must wear other people's leggings, I have to endure scoldings and beatings.

rows.translation: 这个日子怎么过，我的爹呀我的娘！
rows.tujia: ge3di1 nie4 qing3mo1 ka1, nga2-nie3 a3ba1 a1nie3 a!
rows.english: How can I get through the days, My father, my mother!

rows.translation: 娘：我的女儿呀！你的娘真贫穷呀！给你三件无一件，给你三样无一样。
rows.tujia: Mother: nga2-nie3 biu2 a! ni2-nie3 a1nie3 qi3qie1 ye3 be2 tai2! nga2 ni2 bo3 suo1 pi1 cu4-nie3 la2 pi1 be2 tai2, nga2 ni2 bo3 suo1 ye3 cu4-nie3 la2 ye3 be2 tai2.
rows.english: Mother: My daughter! Your mother has no possessions! I should give you three sets of clothing, but not one do I have, I should give you three kinds, but not one do I have.

rows.translation: 娘穷得一干二净，金器银器看不到，木器竹器也没有，不好把你嫁出门。
rows.tujia: nga2 lei4 ye3 tai2 ta2si1-liao3, kuo1-nie3 wo4-nie3 ni2 ba4 ti3-bo3-da2, ka3-nie3 mu4nie3-nie3 wo3sa3 wo4-nie3 wo4-xi2 be2 tai2, ni2 cuo4zu4 nga2 si2-xi2 tai2.
rows.english: Today I am penniless and weak, Gold and silver you will not be able to see, Not even wooden or bamboo back-baskets, Nothing to send when I give you in marriage.

sections.title: 5.1.2: 母女对哭
sections.title_en: 5.1.2: The Bride Sings with her Mother
sections.meta_en:
Tian Xintao, Daba Township, Yongshun County
recorded on 05 August 2002
sections.description_en:
Tian Xintao, Daba Township, Yongshun County

sections.meta:
永顺县大坝乡田心桃女士
记录日期 05 八月 2002

rows.translation: 新娘：我的姑母呀！往日你到我家来，双脚跳到大门外，喜笑颜开接你来。
rows.tujia: Bride: nga2-nie3 ma3ma1 a! ni2 di1ga3 ang2 cuo4 hhi2, hu4ca3-bo3 la1ming3 wo4ta3 hhi2, nie4li1nie4ga2 nga2 ni2 a3-xie2.
rows.english: Bride: My aunt! You used to come to my house, Running up outside our door, Happily I welcomed you.

rows.translation: 今日你到我家来，哭脸要把笑脸代。父母会生不会送，房屋田地都没有，没有吃的没有穿，那个日子怎么过？
rows.tujia: lei4 ni2 ang2 cuo4 eng3qie2, nie4 gu2 lie3 ji2 [gu2] ri1-duo3. a3ba1 a1nie3 si3 ca2 si2 ca2-da2, si2-nie3 cuo4 si3tie2 pe2ti1 tai2, ga2-ci3 tai2 da2-ci3 tai2, a1di1 nie4 qing3mo1 ka1?
rows.english: Today you have come to my home, You must mask your tears with smiles. My parents raised me but cannot see me off, Without house or land to be my dowry, Nothing to eat, nothing to wear, How can I live through those days?

rows.translation: 姑母：我的女儿呀！你莫伤心呀！你莫流泪，我们生来女儿命，
rows.tujia: Aunt: nga2-nie3 biu2 a! ni2 ta4 ji2! ni2 bu1ce3 ta4 duo3, ang2ni1 si3-bo3 ma3ma1-die1,
rows.english: Aunt: My daughter! Do not weep! Stop crying, We were born women,

rows.translation: 长大一定要出闺；土王女儿招驸马，官家小姐也结婚。
rows.tujia: ong2 qi4 cuo4zu4-duo3; ga2me1-nie3 biu2 be2 luo4ba1 ni1-duo3, kua2-nie3 biu2 be2 cuo4zu4-duo3.
rows.english: When we grow up, we all must marry; Even a chieftain's daughter must find a husband, And an official's daughter be given in marriage.

rows.translation: 河边杨柳你最青，满天星子你最亮，满园萝卜你最大。
rows.tujia: ni2 ce3 tie1bi1-nie3 ce3ci1ke3 da4ye2ze3, xing3di1xing3ga2; ni2 me2 ga3ha2-nie3 xi4bu2li1 da4ye2ze3, jia1jia1-ga2, ni2 wo1la1 wo2tu1 la1be1 da4ye2ze3, ni2 tie2ba1.
rows.english: You are fairer than the willow trees across the water; You are brighter than the stars of heaven, Everyone notices you, like the largest turnip in the garden.

rows.translation: 人人都爱把你夸，人家想看都不能，你对人家要尊敬；人家老少大声喊，你要仔细仔细听。
rows.tujia: ma2ni1 ze2 ni2 ca2di3ca2ga2, luo4die1 ni2 ba4-ca2-ta1ti1, ni2 luo4die1-nie3 luo4 be2 cai3mo1 ri1-duo3; luo4die1 a2qi4 jie3, ni2 ta3tie3bo1 ru3-bo3-duo3.
rows.english: We all praise your comeliness, People yearn to see you, You must honour other people; When others shout out to you, You must listen carefully.

rows.translation: 服侍老的一杯茶，服侍大的一袋烟。你上有父亲母亲，你下有兄兄弟弟，人家不敢看贱你。
rows.tujia: ni2 luo4die1-nie3 pa3pu1 a3ba1 bo3 ra2ce3 la2 su1 tu2, ni2 luo4die1 luo4ba1-die1 bo3 [ke2ka4] la2 zi2 si2. ni2 a3ba1 a1nie3 xie2, ni2 qian1ngai4-die1 be2 xie2, luo4die1 ni2 luo3-ta1ti1, ha3-ta1ti1.
rows.english: You must pour tea for the elders of another household, You must offer pipes for the men of another household to smoke. You have a mother and father, Brothers you also have, Other people will not dare scold or strike you.

rows.translation: 姑母生来苦命人，姑父死后留孩子，我背一个抱一个，屋里还要留几个；吃了早饭愁午饭，无吃无穿怎么活。
rows.tujia: ni2 ma3ma1 si3-zu2 be2 ke2ji1-nie3 luo4, ka3ke3 se2-ji2 qing2die1 bie4, nga2 la2 hu3 wo4-bo3 la2 hu3 be4, cuo4 wo2tu1 a4duo3 ga4 la1hu3 po1; zao4gu1die1 zi3 ga2-ji2 ong1ga3 tai2, ga2-ci3 tai2, da2-ci3 tai2 qing3mo1 si3.
rows.english: Your aunt was also born to a harsh fate, My husband died, leaving the children, I bore one on my back and carried another in my arms, Yet still more remained at home; Breakfast eaten, there was none left for lunch, No food and no clothing, how could we live?

rows.translation: 世上只有黄连苦，我比黄连苦十倍；世上只有草籽贱，我比草籽贱十倍。
rows.tujia: si2sang1-nie3 ze1ge3 ke2ji1ji1, nga2 ze1ge3 hi2 xi1 ke2ji1; si2sang1-nie3 xi3bu2li1 jian2, nga2 xi3bu2li1 bo3 hi2 xi1 jian2.
rows.english: In the world nothing is as bitter as goldthread, Yet my bitterness is ten times worse; In the world nothing is of less value than grass seed, Yet I am ten times more despised.

rows.translation: 我家全是苦命人，好比水打的破船；想给你的做不到，一样礼品也未送。
rows.tujia: ang2 cuo4-nie3 luo4 yi2xi1 ke2ji1-xi3tai2, ce3 ha3-nie3 bu4 da4ye2ze3; nga2 ni2 bo3 die2-xi2 ca2 ri1-xi2 tai2, ni2 bo3 ye3 la2 ye3 be2 si2-da2.
rows.english: My whole family has a bitter fate, Like a boat buffeted by the waves; That which I would do for you I cannot, Not a single present can I give you.

永顺县大坝乡田心桃女士
记录日期 05 八月 2002

rows.translation: 柑子好吃十二瓣，姊妹好坐要分散；柚子好吃要剥皮，姊妹好坐要分离。
rows.tujia: qie2xi1 ga2 ca2 hi2 nie1 mi3, a2da1 a1mi1 ong3 ca2 da4pi3-duo3; ceng3zi3 ga2 ca2 ta2pa4 xie4, a2da1 a1mi1 ong3 ca2 be2 pi3-bo3-xi2.
rows.english: It's good to eat the twelve segments of an orange, It's good to be with your sisters, but one day you must separate; It's good to eat a pomelo, but you must discard the peel, It's good to be with your sisters, but one day you will be separated.

rows.translation: 我们姊妹同呼吸，时时刻刻都不离；昔日头发二面排，好姊好妹排拢来。
rows.tujia: ang2ni1 ma3ma1-die1 luo4 la2 hu3 da4ze3, la1si3la1nie1 be2 pie3-ta1ti1; di1ga3 sa2qi1 se2ta1 xi3, ca2-nie3 a2da1 a1mi1 eng3jiu3-diu2.
rows.english: We sisters are as one, Always inseparable; Once we combed our hair to the side, All of us sisters are gathering together.

rows.translation: 今日头发往上梳，好姊好妹往后丢；叫我怎能舍得你，越思越想越悲泣。
rows.tujia: lei4 nie4 sa2qi1 ga3ha2 xi3, ca2-nie3 a2da1 a1mi1 qing3nie2 po1; nga2 qing3mo1 ni2 po1-die1xi3, die2-bo3 die2-bo3 bu1ce3 zu2.
rows.english: Now our hair is combed on top, One by one my good friends have got married; How can I let you go, The more I think of it, the more my tears flow.

rows.translation: 姊妹好比一朵云，狂风吹散永难集；白云吹在蓝天上，回头不见本寨人。
rows.tujia: a2da1 a1mi1 me2la1ong3 da4ze3, re2su4 re2-ji2 yi2xi1 zao3; me2la1ong3 me2 ga3ha2 su4, ta1nie1 ba4 ang2-nie3 luo1you1-nie3 luo4 yi3-da2.
rows.english: My sisters are like a cloud, Blown along by the wind never to return; The cloud drifts in the sky above, Looking back, our villagers are no longer in sight.

sections.title: 5.2.1: 姐妹对哭
sections.title_en: 5.2.1: The Bride Sings to her Sisters
sections.meta_en:
Tian Xintao, Daba Township, Yongshun County
recorded on 05 August 2002
sections.description_en: The songs on this page make up the second half of a cycle of kujia songs, begun on the previous page.

sections.meta:
永顺县大坝乡田心桃女士
记录日期 05 八月 2002

rows.translation: 天上星多数不清，兄妹今朝要分离；小妹今日要出嫁，不能在家孝父母。
rows.tujia: me2 ga3ha2 xi4bu2li1 ri3 hi4-ji2-ta1, a1guo1 a1mi1 lei4 pie3-bo3 zu2; a1mi1 lei4 cuo4zu4-duo3, cuo4-nie3 a3ba1 a1nie3 long4-ta1ti1.
rows.english: The stars in the sky cannot be counted, Today my brother must part with his sister; Little sister must be married today, She can no longer look after her parents.

rows.translation: 堂上父母你孝敬，千斤担子落你身；父母眼前要和气，子女应报养育恩。
rows.tujia: cuo4-nie3 a3ba1 a1nie3 ni2 long4-bo3-duo3, du4ji3ji3-nie3 sa3 ni2 ke4-bo3-duo3; a3ba1 a1nie3 da3bie1 nie4-bo3-duo3, qing3nie2-die1 a3ba1 a1nie3 long4-bo3 ca2-duo3.
rows.english: You must care for our father and mother, This heavy burden now falls to you; Smile before your father and mother, Children must look after their parents well.

rows.translation: 兄弟之间要和气，免得父母操苦心。
rows.tujia: a3kuo4 ang1ngai4 da4xi4-duo3, a3ba1 a1nie3 ta4 ke2ji1.
rows.english: Brothers must help one another, Lest their parents should taste bitter days.

sections.title: 5.2.2: 哭哥哥

rows.translation: 天上下雨路难行，姑嫂好坐要分离；妹妹好比浮萍草，长大漂到别人家。
rows.tujia: me2 ga3ha2 me2ze3 la4 hhi2-ta1ti1, ma3ma1 ca3qi2 ong3 ca2 pie3-lie3-duo3; a1mi1 ce3 ga3ha2 ta3-xi2 da4ye2ze3, ong2 qi4 luo4die1 cuo4-bo3 hhi2.
rows.english: The rain cannot find a path through the heavens, Though I sit with you, sister-in-law, we must part; I am like a floating weed, Grown up, I float to another's house.

rows.translation: 妹妹好比树一根，嫂是树来妹是花；只见花在镜中长，硕果落在婆婆家。
rows.tujia: a1mi1 ka3mong3 la2 zi2 da4ye2ze3, ca3qi2 ka3mong3 sou2 a1mi1 ka1pu1 sou2; ka1pu1 jing2zi1 wo2tu1 ong2-bo3 yi3, bu2li1 ji2-bo3 luo4ba1-die1 cuo4 bie1li3.
rows.english: I am like a tree, Sister-in-law is a tree and I am the flowers; I see the flowers bud in the mirror, Ripe fruits fall in another's home.

rows.translation: 感谢嫂嫂操心大，教我结麻又绣花，切望嫂嫂孝敬好。
rows.tujia: ca3qi2 nga2 die2-bo3 ri1-bo3 ri3di2ri3ga2, nga2 bo3 a ze2, ce3ku1 ce4, ka1pu1 ri1, ca3qi2 ni2 a3ba1 a1nie3 long4 ca2-duo3.
rows.english: Sister-in-law has remembered me and cared for me, Taught me to twist hemp and embroider, Sister-in-law, you must look after your parents.

rows.translation: 昔日伯母慈母心，把我头发扎辫子，高高兴兴过日子。
rows.tujia: di1ga1 nie3qi1 li1kuo1li1 ca2, nga2 bo3 sa2qi1 hhe2la1 ti2, nie4li1nie4ga2 nie4ka1 ca2.
rows.english: Aunt, once you were a mother to me, You helped me fasten my hair, We were always so happy.

rows.translation: 今日伯母好狠心，把我头发三把梳；扯了眉毛改了样，扯了汗毛改了相。
rows.tujia: lei4 nie3qi1 li1kuo1li1 ca2-da2, nga2 bo3 sa2qi1 suo1 pa1 xi3; luo2bu1 xi2ga4 pie4 mo3 da4ze3-da2, bu1ce3 xi2ga4 pie4 mo3 da4ze3 tai2.
rows.english: Why are you hard-hearted to me today, Dividing my hair into three; Plucking my eyebrows; I no longer look the same, With eyebrows plucked, I am a different person.

rows.translation: 从今变成下贱女，日日夜夜受人欺，这个日子怎么过！
rows.tujia: qing3nie2 luo4die1-nie3 pii2 ri1-duo3, la2 nie1 la2 nie1 luo4die1 duo3 luo3, gai3di1 nie4 qing3mo1 ka1!
rows.english: From now on I am a daughter in another household, Scolded by others day after day, How can I live through such days!

rows.translation: 双脚跪在神堂前，明早小女嫁远方；世世代代家兴旺，清香红烛亮堂堂。
rows.tujia: ji3 la2 ru1 ye3cuo3 da3bie1 ki4-bo3, lao2ji1 zao4gu1die1 biu2 si1li1 cuo4zu4; si2si1dai2dai1 cuo4-nie3 ca2, qing1xian1 mian1jie1 tie4tie3 jia2li1jia2.
rows.english: Kneeling before the shrine, Tomorrow morning to be married far away; May my family prosper forever; Sweet incense and red lamps shining.

rows.translation: 小女不忘祖宗育，勤劳垦种祖先传；祝愿祖先保佑我，娘家婆家都兴旺。
rows.tujia: ga2me1-die1 biu2 bo3 long4-nie3 a2yi1-die1 die2-bo3-duo3, jie2ri1 sa3 ri1 ga2me1-nie3 a2yi1; ga2me1-die1 nga2 bo3 ri1, cai2 ri1-duo3, nga2 cuo4 luo4ba1-die1 cuo4 yi2xi1 ca2-duo3.
rows.english: Daughters must remember their elders' words, Labouring according to the precepts of their ancestors; May my ancestors bless and protect me, May my husband's family prosper.

rows.translation: 今朝不穿露水衣，不受人家老少欺；露水裙子穿不得，穿了离爹又离爷。
rows.tujia: lei4 suo1ce3 xi1ba1 da2-ta1ti1, luo4die1 la2 cuo4 luo3-ta1ti1; suo1ce3 jie3long1 da2-ta1ti1, da2-ji2 luo4ba1 pa3pu1 bie4.
rows.english: Today I cannot wear my special clothes, Cannot bear to be scolded in another household; I cannot wear my special skirt, Wearing them, I shall leave the menfolk of my home.

rows.translation: 罗盘镜子挂不得，好姊好妹舍不得；露水帕子搭不得，哥哥嫂子离不得。
rows.tujia: luo3pang1 jing2zi1 kei3yi1 kei3yi1-ta1ti1, ca2-nie3 a2da1 a1mi1 po1-ta1ti1; suo1ce3 jie2zu1 die4-ta1ti1, a3kuo4 ca3qi2 bie4-ta1ti1.
rows.english: I can no longer hang my oval mirror, Nor abandon my good sisters; I cannot wear my special headscarf, Cannot leave my brother and his wife.

rows.translation: 远方来了一只牛，走到我家磕响头；远方来了一只狗，走到我家不开口。
rows.tujia: si1li1 wu2 lao4 eng3qie2, ang2 cuo4 eng3qie2 ka1ta1bu2; si1li1 ha4lie3 lao4 eng3qie2, ang2 cuo4 eng3qie2 sa3 ze2-ta1.
rows.english: An ox comes from afar, Comes to our house to kowtow; A dog comes from far away, Comes to our house, but does not bark.

rows.translation: 哥哥呀！哥哥呀！为何这样下狠心，今日背妹下火坑。
rows.tujia: a3kuo4 a! a3kuo4 a! qing3mo1 li1kuo1li1 hang2la3 tai2, lei4 a1mi1 wo4-bo3 mo3 mi4tang3 tu2.
rows.english: My brother! My brother! Why are you so hard-hearted? Bearing me today and plunging me into the fiery pit.

rows.translation: 打开后门竹叶青，我口喊的是亲人；打开前门竹叶黄，我喊人家爹和娘。
rows.tujia: se2ta1 la1ming3 tong2, mu4nie3 pu2ta1 xing2ga1die3, nga2 jie3-nie3 zuo4ni3-die1; da3bie1 la1ming3 tong2, mu4nie3 pu2ta1 wan3ga1die3, nga2 luo4die1-nie3 a3ba1 a1nie3 jie3.
rows.english: Opening the side-door, the bamboo leaves are green, I call out to my own family; Opening the front door, the bamboo leaves are yellow, I call the parents from another family.

rows.translation: 把我背到岩坎上，变只小鸟满天飞；把我背到大河里，变只鱼儿真自由。
rows.tujia: wo4-bo3 mo3 a3sa3 ga3ha2 po1, nga2 ni2bi1 da4ze3 me2 wo2tu1 ra2; wo4-bo3 mo3 hu3pao2 wo2tu1 po1, song2 bi2 la2 zi2 ge3ci2 ca2.
rows.english: Bear me away and leave me on a cliff-top, Let me fly high in the sky like a bird; Carry me away to the river, Like a fish, to live in freedom.

rows.translation: 过山只见高山顶，过河只见浪涛天；哪年哪月才回家，再对爹娘诉衷情。
rows.tujia: nga2 ku1lie1 ga3ha2 a2 ku1za4 ba4, hu3pao2 a2 ce3 ong2 gei1 qi4; ga4 long1 ga4 si1 song1kuo1-diu2, a3ba1 a1nie3 po1 die2-nie3 sa3 nga2 la1 ze2.
rows.english: I climb the hills, but all I see are peaks, I cross the river, but meet only tall waves; How many years and months before I return, To listen to what my parents have to tell me.

rows.translation: 我的女儿啊！你快去别的地方，跟人家父母在一起。
rows.tujia: a1re1la1di3! ni2 me le, si1ke1-bo3 hhi2-lie3 ou, luo4die1-nie3 a1nie3 a3ba1 da4ha3.
rows.english: My daughter! You are leaving for another place, to live with someone else's parents.

rows.translation: 你要顺服人家的父母，要好好地服侍他们，要好好地看顾父母。我的女儿啊！
rows.tujia: ni2 guo2 luo4die1-nie3 a3nie1 a3ba1 bo3 sun2-bo3-duo3, luo4die1-nie3 a3nie1 a3ba1 cai3mo1 hu1si4, ni2 a3nie1 a3ba1 bo3 cai3mo1 ca2-bo3-duo3, a1re1la1di3 ye!
rows.english: You must obey someone else's parents, serve them well, you must be good to them. My daughter!

rows.translation: 不像跟你自己父母一起住，责任不能推给别人，我的女儿啊！
rows.tujia: ni2 guo2duo3-nie3 a3nie1 a3ba1 da4ha3 ong3-bo3, li3-xi2-nie3 a4se3 ta4 pa3 ma, nga2-nie3 a1re1la1di3 ye!
rows.english: It's not like living with your own parents, you can't push these duties off on to someone else, my daughter!

rows.translation: 月梅你别再玩耍，要把辣椒合一下，我的女儿啊！
rows.tujia: ye4mei2 ye, ni2 ta4 ge3ci2, ni2 pa1gu1 huo4, nga2-nie3 a1re1 li3 ye!
rows.english: Yue Mei, you mustn't play any longer, gather up the chillis, my daughter!

rows.translation: 不是只有你一个人，以后的都要嫁出去，我的女儿啊！
rows.tujia: ni2 la2 hu3-lang2 bu2si1, nga2-nie3 qing3nie2 luo4-nie3 si1ke1-bo3 a3-la1 mang, nga2-nie3 a1re1 li3 ye!
rows.english: You are not alone, every girl will also have to marry away from home, my daughter!

rows.translation: 母亲啊！养我就是为别人养，我的父母啊！
rows.tujia: a3nie1 ei! ni2 le long4-bo3 mo3 luo4die1 bo3 luo4 long4 o, nga2-nie3 a3nie1 a3ba1 la!
rows.english: My mother! You raised me for the benefit of other people, my parents!

rows.translation: 我和你们一起坐，服侍你们还不足，现在嫁给人家去，我的父母啊！
rows.tujia: nga2 me se2 da4ha3 ong3-bo3 me nga2 se2 hu1si4, nga2 se2 bo3 gei1 o, ai1me1 luo4die1 bo3 zu2-lu3 mang, nga2-nie3 a3nie1 a3ba1 ye!
rows.english: I lived with you both, I haven't served you enough, and I am now leaving for another home, my parents!

rows.translation: 我家的客人来到我们这里，我们没有到路边迎接你们。
rows.tujia: nga2-nie3 cu1-nie3 bu1cuo3 ang2 ge3 ye4 you, nga2 se2 la4ku1tu3 a3-bu1ce3.
rows.english: As our guests you have come to our home, but we didn't even meet you at the roadside.

rows.translation: 我今天和你们一起走，我到今天才认识你们。
rows.tujia: nga2 me lei4 me se2 da4ha3 me da4ha3 hhi2 yo, nga2 lei4 mo3 se2 you reng2-duo3-lie3.
rows.english: Today we can spend time together; I only got to know you today.

rows.translation: 我今年有六十多岁了，不知道怎样对你们说？
rows.tujia: nga2 long3bei3 me lu2 si3 ta2ci1-lie3 you, me qi3mo1 se2 you you2 li3 le?
rows.english: I am over sixty this year, how should I speak to you?

rows.translation: 经常说话的机会不会再有这么多，不然我就不会来看你们。
rows.tujia: jing1 li3-nie3 ji1hui1 be2 hang2la3 tao2 yo, nga2 bu2si1 me da4ha3 ba4-i-ta1 yo.
rows.english: We won't have an opportunity to talk like this again, otherwise I wouldn't have come to see you now.

rows.translation: 你们辛辛苦苦地到我们这里，翻山越岭走到了。
rows.tujia: se2 ku4 mo3 ku4 mo3 ang2 ge3 ye4 you o, ku1ca4 huan4-alie3 hhi2-lie3 ge3.
rows.english: You have had a hard journey coming here, you came over the mountains to get here.

rows.translation: 你们辛苦地过河来到这里，我会记在心里的。
rows.tujia: hu3pa3 a2-lie3 me ge3du1-cai3, gai2 ku4-nie3-xi2 nga2duo3 me3-lie1 die2.
rows.english: You had a hard river crossing to get here, I will never forget this.

sections.title: 6.1.1: 欢迎歌
sections.meta_en:
Peng Jizhen, Dianfang Township, Longshan County
recorded on 18 July 2002
sections.description_en: These two songs were performed one after the other. The first, a song of welcome, was sung to welcome us to the area, and should be antiphonal, but we were unable to respond in kind! The second song is more typical. Such singing is often impromptu, after eating and drinking together. The format is that of a friendly competition, with each singer trying to leave the other lost for words. In this example, after agreeing that current living standards are much higher, singer B tries to portray (in jest) singer A, who is from a wealthier background, as a typical oppressive landlord. Singer A retorts by singing that he is nothing of the kind, and that the only reason other people farm his land is his increasing age!

sections.description:
龙山县靛房镇彭继珍先生
记录日期 18 七月 2002
sections.meta:
龙山县靛房镇彭继珍先生和龚平清先生
记录日期 18 七月 2002

rows.translation: A：我这时候一起谈话吧，我的外甥你讲什么呢？我到底在哪里搞这个，你今天这样骂我，你自己想一想吧。
rows.tujia: A: nga2 gai2 si3jie3 yo da4 huan1xian1 tiao4 mo3 ba you, nga2 wai2wai1 ni2 jian1 qi3mo1 la? nga2 dao2di1 me kei3du1-cai3-bo3 gao1-i, ni2 lai4 nga2 luo3 mo3 ni2 la1 ba4 ba4.
rows.english: A: Let's talk together now. What do you have to say, nephew? Where should I go? You are scolding me like this, think about it!

rows.translation: B：我真的是土家族，我说和唱都用土家语。全靠党的政策好，我们今天一起在台上唱歌。
rows.tujia: B: nga2 me zeng1di1 you bi2zi1ka3, nga2 sa3li3 cang2guo1 ya bi2zi1sa3. qian3 kao2 me dang1-nie3 zeng2ce3 ca2 a, lei4 da4 tai3 ga3 cang2guo1-la1.
rows.english: B: I'm really and truly Tujia. I use Tujia whenever when I speak or sing. Thanks to the Party's good policies, today we can sing together here.

rows.translation: A：我认为你也是这样想的，我也觉得欢喜。我们整天守牛，没有机会碰到这样的领导。
rows.tujia: A: nga2 ni2 be2 me3-lie1 hang2 die2-la1 you, nga2 be2 me3-lie1 huan1xi4 la. ang2ni1 la2 nie1 hi4lie3 me you wu2 ka4 ou, gai2 da4ze3 ling1tao2 peng2duo1-da2.
rows.english: A: I know that you think the same way, I feel happy too. All day we look after the cattle as they graze, with no chance to meet with such leaders [visitors].

rows.translation: B：全靠党的政策好，开车子来到山上。大家一起过好日子，别忘记党的情意。
rows.tujia: B: qian3 kao2 dang1-nie3 zeng2ce3 ca2, ce1zi1 kai1-lie3 ku1ca4 ga3. hu2ni1 me da4ha3 nie4 cai2 ka1, dang1-nie3 qing3yi2 ta4 si1ma3.
rows.english: B: Thanks to the Party's good policies, vehicles can now get through to our mountains. We can live happily together, let's not forget the Party's many kindnesses.

rows.translation: A：我们是土家族，讲土家语，你别忘记土家语。我现在过着好日子，全靠领袖他们好。
rows.tujia: A: ang2ni1 bi2zi1ka3 you me bi2zi1sa3 you, me bi2zi1sa3 be2 ta4 si1ma3. nga2 jiu1 jian1 mu2la1 nie4ka1 ca2 you, qian3 kao2 me ling1xiu2, guo2 die3 ca2.
rows.english: A: We are Tujia, we speak Tujia, so don't you forget to speak Tujia! I'm saying how good our lives are now, thanks to our excellent leaders.

rows.translation: B：全靠党的政策好，大家一起过好日子。交通和自来水都解决了，大家的电灯亮光光。
rows.tujia: B: qian3 kao2 dang1-nie3 zeng2ce3 ca2, hu2ni1 da4ha3 nie4 cai2 ka1. ni2 la4 hhi2 ce3 du1 gai1jie3-liao3, hu2ni1 dian2deng1 lian2 hua1hua1.
rows.english: B: Thanks to the Party's policies, we can all live happily together. There are now roads and piped water, there are electric lights in every household.

rows.translation: A：我们一起记得以前那个时候，去靛房镇赶场就要跑。我从来没有看见过车子，晚上回来就要拿着灯。
rows.tujia: A: ang2 da4 da3bie1 ai1 si3jie3 die2 mo3 ba you, dian2huan3 cang3gang4 jiu1 you hu4ca3. nga2 cong3lai3 ce1zi1 duo3 yi3-bo3-da2 you, lang3cei1 song1kuo1 jiu1 tie4tie3 za4.
rows.english: A: Let's think back to the former times, when we had to walk to market in Dianfang. I had never seen a car, and in the evening I had to carry a lamp when I came back.

rows.translation: B：以往我也记得没有鞋子，要打草鞋。赶场劳动都穿草鞋，脚上起了泡子。
rows.tujia: B: yi1wan1 nga2 be2 you die2-bo3-la1, cuo3xie2 tai2 me you ji3ku3 ha3. cang3gang4 jie2ri1 du1 ji3ku3 da2 you, ji3 ga3ha2 me you pao2zi1 la3.
rows.english: B: I can remember not having any shoes to wear; we had to make straw sandals. When we went to market or worked in the fields, we had to wear straw sandals. We got blisters on the soles of our feet.

rows.translation: A：我现在不像那个时候，脚上穿着凉鞋了。天冷时脚上穿皮鞋，从来不冷就不肯穿。
rows.tujia: A: nga2 mu2la1 me ai1 si3jie3 da4ze3-da2 you, me ji3 ga3 me lian3hai3 da2-bo3-la1. sa4-la1-hu3 me ji3 ga3 me pi3hai3 da2 you, me cong3lai3 sa4-da2 me you a3-ta1.
rows.english: A: Now things are different for me, on my feet are proper sandals. When it gets cold I wear leather shoes, but if it isn't cold I won't wear them.

rows.translation: B：这个全靠政策好，现在大家过好日子。我回忆我以前小时候，那些苦日子不会忘记。
rows.tujia: B: eng1di1 me qian3 kao2 zeng2ce3 ca2 o, mu2la1 hu2ni1 me nie4 cai2 ka1. nga2 hui3yi2 nga2 yi1qian3 bi2cei1-zu2, a1di1 ku4ri3 si1ma3-da2.
rows.english: B: This is all thanks to good policies, nowadays life is good for everyone. I remember when I was small, how can I forget such bitter days.

rows.translation: A：我小时侯的父母，我也会记在心上。我穿的是开裆裤，臀部全都露出来。
rows.tujia: A: nga2 bi2cei1-zu2-nie3 a3nie1 a3ba1 you, nga2 be2 me3-lie1 die2-bo3-la1. nga2 ku3 me ca1ca1ku3 lao4 da2, se3gu3li1 duo3 yi2si1 wo4ta3 la2.
rows.english: A: I remember well my parents when I was small. My trousers were split-crotch trousers that babies wear, with my bottom sticking out.

rows.translation: B：你比我年纪也大不了多少，我们以往的日子不要再提了。现在党的政策好，我在女儿家里也在过好日子。
rows.tujia: B: ni2 nga2 be2 nian3ji3 hang2 ri3-da2 you, yi1wan1 me ang2 nie1 hu3 bai4 li3-ta1. nga2 mu2la1 me ni2 dang1-nie3 zeng2ce3 ca2, ni2 nga2 be2 biu2 da4 nie4 cai2 ka1.
rows.english: B: You are not much older than I am, let's not talk anymore about those days. Now the Party's policies are good, I live happily in my daughter's home.

rows.translation: A：我那时候不像现在，现在天不干不冷，我们又不饿。我们全部都有衣服穿，我们常常有大米饭吃。
rows.tujia: A: nga2 ai1 si3jie3 mu2la1 da4ze3-da2 you, me2 ga3-ta1 sa4-da2 you a1-da2 ou. nga2 ku3 si1ba1 yi2si1 duo3 da2-ci3 xie2, nga2 si1li1 mang1mang1 a cang3si2 ga2.
rows.english: A: Things were different then, now we don't suffer drought or cold, nor are we hungry. We all have clothes to wear, and we eat rice regularly.

rows.translation: B：嘿！以往我一岁左右的时候，地主都不像现在一样。那时候有钱人都要吃麦子和玉米，现在穷人都不要吃玉米了。
rows.tujia: B: hei yi1wan1 nga2 be2 jiu1 sui2 ba1 you, di2zu1 duo3 mu2la1 da4ze3-dao2. a1di1 xie2ma1 me me2zi1 bao1gu1 ga2 you, mu2la1 qiong3-ma1 duo3 bao1gu1 be2 ga2-da2.
rows.english: B: Ah! When I was about one, the landlords were very different from now. In the past, even the rich had to eat wheat and maize; nowadays even poor people don't need to eat maize.

rows.translation: A：你啊！看见我就说我的生活比你好。啊！我们真的是地主人家。父母亲都很节约，放好钥匙后就到自己的田地去。
rows.tujia: A: ni2 ya jiu1 nga2 ya3-lie3 nga2 ga3ha2 you, me ang2 cu1 me zeng1di1 di2zu1-ka3. a3nie1 a3ba1 me zang4 you2 zang4, yan1si1 la2-lie3 pe2ti1 zao3.
rows.english: A: When you see me, you say that my life is better than yours and that I'm truly a landlord. My parents were both very thrifty, they locked the house [hiding the key] and went to work in their fields.

rows.translation: B：我们说的都是实话，我们以前是地主人家。他穿得不好，但是吃得好，三天就有一次会餐。
rows.tujia: B: ang2 da4 eng1ge1 li3-nie3-xi2 be2 si2hua1, ang2ni1 wan1tian3 a1di1 di2zu1-ka3. guo2 da2-xi2 be2 ca1huo4 you, ga2-xi2 me ca2 suo1 nie1 ping3huo3 la2 mong2 ha3.
rows.english: B: Everything I've told you is true, we used to be landlords. He didn't dress well, but he ate well and had a feast once every three days.

rows.translation: A：我么实话对你讲，说得情况这么不好。那时客人来才煮肉，没有客人就看不见肉。
rows.tujia: A: nga2-nie3 si2hua1 ni2 bo3 la2 you, me qing3kuan2 me li3-xi2 hang2 ze3-da2. a1di1 bu1cuo3 hhi2-lu3 me si3 lao4 bang2 a, bu1cuo3 hhi2-da2 me si3 yi3-da2.
rows.english: A: I'm speaking the truth to you, things weren't as good as you said. We only had meat when visitors came, if there were no guests we would not eat meat.

rows.translation: B：啊！我说的是真话，你们节约的富家人！我们穷人个个又做工，真的不能看见肉！
rows.tujia: B: ang a1di1 li3-xi2 zeng1di1hua1, zang4-nie3-xi2 me xie2ma1ka3! ang2 qiong3-ma1 guo2 guo2 me you2 hu3ri1 ei, zeng1di1 si3 duo3 da4 yi3-da2!
rows.english: B: Ah! I'm telling the truth, you penny-pinching rich folk! All of us poor folk had to work; we wanted meat but never saw any!

rows.translation: A：你不吃时我也不吃，吃饭时都是同一个锅里的。从来也不搞另外的食物，我自己也能看见。
rows.tujia: A: ni2 ga2-da2, me nga2 ga2-da2 you, ga2-zu2 me yi2si1 ta2ku1 ga3. cong3lai3 be2 tuo2ni1 you2 gao1-da2, nga2duo3 luo2bu1 ye1 ba4-bo3-la1.
rows.english: A: When you didn't eat meat, neither did I; when we ate, we did so from a common pot. In the past we didn't cook any other food, I saw it with my own eyes.

rows.translation: B：那些日子我过不了，因为那时我只是很小。只有听父母说的，我们穷人家吃亏了。
rows.tujia: B: ai1 me a1di1 nie4 me nga2 me ka1-bo3-da2 yo, ying1wei3 ai1 si3jie3 nga2 bi2cei1-lang2. zi2you1 a3nie1 a3ba1 li3-xi2 xi4 le, qi2kui1 le ang2ni1 le qiong3ma1ka3.
rows.english: B: Those were terrible days, because I was still only small. All I could do was obey my parents, all of us poor folk got the worst of it.

rows.translation: A：地主的后代就是不一样，否则我现在怎么可以是地主人家呢？我有几块田地，我做不起就请你们。
rows.tujia: A: di2zu1-nie3 qing3 luo4 me ngeng2 da4ze3-da2 you, ai1ta1 me nga2 qing3mo1 di2zu1-ka3? nga2 se3ke1 pe2ti1 me ga4 [ke3] xie2 yo, nga2 ri1-hi1ce1 me se2 qing4.
rows.english: A: The descendants of landlords are indeed different, otherwise how could I be a landlord now? I have several fields of my own, they are too much for me to work myself so I ask others to help.

rows.translation: B：你说的是真话，我也听别人说过。有钱人总是请穷人，所以他们能过好日子。
rows.tujia: B: ni2-nie3 a1di1 li3-xi2 zeng1di1hua1 yo, nga2 be2 li3-xi2 be2 xi4-la1. xie2ma1 me, guo2 ngeng2 da4 qiong3ma1 qing4, me suo1yi1 le guo2 cu1 nie4ka1 ca2.
rows.english: B: You are telling the truth; I've also heard people say that. Rich folk always hire poor folk to do their work, so that they can live comfortably themselves.

rows.translation: A：那就没有办法，要请别人做工夫，因为我老了，已经六十八。我那时才十来岁，我没有碰到重活。
rows.tujia: A: ai1di1 bang2hua1 tai2-lie3, me hu3 qing4 la you, po3pa1cei1 lao4-alie3, lu2 si3 ba2. nga2 me ai1 si3jie3 si3 lai1 sui2 ei, nga2 guo2 me tie2ba1 ri1-duo3-da2.
rows.english: A: I can't help it, I have to get others to work my land. I'm getting old now, I'm already sixty-eight. Back then when I was ten or so, I hadn't done any heavy work.

rows.translation: B：你说的是真话，你整天在看书。所以你不会做农活，不会很多的农活道理。
rows.tujia: B: ni2 a1di1 li3-xi2 zeng1di1hua1 o, la2 nie1 hi4lie3 ni2 ci1ci1 ba4. suo1yi1 ni2 qie3pa2 me ri1-ci1hhe1 ei, heng1duo1-nie3 dao2li1-nie3 ni2 ri1-da2.
rows.english: B: What you say is true, you spent all day studying. So you don't know how to farm, there are a great many things you don't know how to do.

rows.translation: A：我对你讲的是实话，我的母亲的力气真的很大。她非常熟悉农活，我也跟在她后面做。
rows.tujia: A: nga2 me ni2 bo3 si2hua1 la2 yo, nga2-nie3 a3nie1 me zeng1di1 xie1qi1 ca2. guo2 me qie3pa2 tao1tao1 su2, nga2 be2 guo2 ta1nie1 dang1guo3-la1.
rows.english: A: I'm telling you the truth, my mother was very strong. She knew all about farming, and I learnt by following her.

rows.translation: B：你小时过好日子，你现在晚年也过好日子。你的儿孙也好，你每餐不断有酒有肉。
rows.tujia: B: ni2 bi2kui1-zu2 me nie4ka1 ca2 o, ni2 mu2la1 be2 wan1nian3 nie4 be2 ca2. ni2 re4 ca2 le bi2 le ca2 o, la2 mong2 hi4lie3 re2 si3 you2 ni2 duan2-da2.
rows.english: B: You had a good time when you were small; life is also good for you now, when you are old. Your children and grandchildren are happy, you have meat and wine at every meal.

rows.translation: A：我现在也有六十八了，花甲熬了那么大！说起来我的命好象真的很好，孙子们都在外面打工。
rows.tujia: A: nga2 be2 me mu2la1 you me lu2 si3-liao3 ba2 you, hua1jia1 ngao2-alie3 he2ri3ba3! nga2 li3-lu3 me zeng1di1 nga2 ming2 ca2 you, re4bi2-die1 duo3 wo4ta3 gong1hu1 ha3.
rows.english: A: I'm already sixty-eight, I'm no longer a young man! It seems I have been very lucky, my grandchildren have all gone off to work.

rows.translation: B：现在政策又开放，你真的命好！你每天守一下牛，别的闲事你不用管。
rows.tujia: B: mu2la1 ai1di1 zeng2ce3 you2 kai1huan2, ni2 me zeng1di1 you2 ming2 ca2! ni2 la2 nie1 hi4lie3 wu2 la1 ka4 yo, bie2di1 xian3si2 ni2 guan1-ta1.
rows.english: B: Nowadays things are opening up everywhere, you really are lucky! You look after your cow every day, and don't need to do anything else.

rows.translation: A：那么，现在我在想，儿孙可以做的事情，他们都不让我做。可以做什么就做什么，煮一下猪食，守一下牛。
rows.tujia: A: ai1me1, mu2la1 nga2 be2 me3 die2-la1 you, gao1-de1xi3 me nga2 ba4-ta1 mang. qie4 gao1-de1 me qie1xie3 gao1, zi4 bo3 ye3 luo2-lie3, me wu2 la1 ka4 yo.
rows.english: A: Well, now I have to bear in mind, what my children and grandchildren can do, they won't let me do. I do what I can, cooking food for the pig, looking after the cow.

rows.translation: B：我们两个不继续唱了，那个老书记在听着。你们又打算怎么发表你们的意见呢？我们一起休息吧。
rows.tujia: B: ang2ni1 me nie1 hu3 me jing1 ta4 cang2, a1di1 lao4 su1ji1 me ru3-bo3-la1. ni2 lian1-di yi2jian1 you2 qing3mo1 la1 li3 me? ang2duo3 da4 xiu1xi3 ba.
rows.english: B: The two of us have sung enough, that retired Party Secretary has been listening to us. What do you to have to say? Let's have a break now.

rows.translation: A：我今早说的是含糊话，我们一起休息，别把它们放在心上。你们在我们前面坐着，你的录音机别再对着我吧！
rows.tujia: A: nga2 jing1zao1 li3 me hang3 hua1 you, ang2 da4 me xiu1-alie3 suai4 mo3 la2. ni2 be2 nga2 zi1ge1 me you2 ong3-bo3 o, ni2 guo2 lu3ying1ji1 ni2 nga2 ta4 ba4-bo3!
rows.english: A: What we've said today is just off the top of our heads; we are going to have a rest now, don't take our words to heart. There you are sitting in front of us, don't point your cassette recorder at me any more!
