rows.translation: 土家族人一团和气，坐在突出的山丘上，大家都有田和地。
rows.tujia: bi2zi1ka3 luo4 yo wei, da4 bo3 ca2 luo wei, ku2bi1 bao1bao1 ga3 ong3-bo3-la1 yo wei, se3ke1 pe2ti1 jie3-xi2 xie2 luo wei.
rows.english: The Tujia are good to one another, sitting on Kubi Outcrop, we have our own fields and land.

rows.translation: 做了一年什么都有，我们一起做农活去，做农活去。
rows.tujia: la2 long1 ri1-lie3 qie4 duo3 xie2 luo wei, ang2 da4 ai1ka2se1pa2 ri1 ya, se1pa2 ri1 yo wei.
rows.english: A year's work gives us all we need, we work in the fields together, work in the fields.

rows.translation: 情歌二首
rows.tujia: da4 li3-nie3 nie1 ze2 ze2
rows.english: A love song in two parts

rows.translation: 男：大姐大姐我喊你，喊了十句没答应。哪件事上有意见，从头到尾告诉我。
rows.tujia: Boy: a2da1 a2da1 nga2 ni2 jie3, hi2 ze2 jie3 duo3 ti2-bu1ce3. kei2di1 sa3 ga3 me3ga2-lie3, la1bai1la1bai1 ngo1 bo3 ze2.
rows.english: Boy: My sister, my sister, I was calling you, ten times I called without reply. Why are you angry with me - tell me from beginning to end.

rows.translation: 女：大哥大哥别这样说，父母在家应不得。哪天父母不在家，扯着猪草看你来。
rows.tujia: Girl: a3kuo1 a3kuo1 hang2 ta4 li3, nie3ba3 cu1 xie2 ti2-ta1ti1. qi2du1 nie3ba3 cu1 tai2-zu2, zi4si3 wu4-bo3 ni2 ba4-di2.
rows.english: Girl: My brother, my brother, don't speak so, my parents were at home and I could not reply. When my parents are not at home, I will go out to gather pigweed and visit you.

rows.translation: 织呀！织呀！我在你们家屋后院挖土。
rows.tujia: pa3tai1 pa3tai1 ka1pu1 ta4 a! nga2 se2 cuo4ni3 li4hong1 ga4
rows.english: Listen to the sound of weaving! I'm digging the fields at the back of your house.

rows.translation: 啊！啊！我又渴又饿啊！啊！你连吃午饭都没叫我。
rows.tujia: a! a! nga2 ze2ga3 le li2a4 a! a! ni2 nga2 ong1ga3 ga2-xi2 you jie3-da2!
rows.english: Oh! I'm thirsty and hungry, but you haven't called me over for lunch.

rows.translation: 那么，阿哥啊！我说真话，没有看见你，你在我后面挖土。
rows.tujia: ai1me1 a1guo1! nga2 me zeng1di1hua1 ni2 you yi3-da2, ni2 me nga2 ta1nie1 jiu1 li4hong1 ga4.
rows.english: Now, my brother! I'm telling the truth; I couldn't see you, you were digging behind me.

rows.translation: 你那么渴，为什么又不叫我一声呢？
rows.tujia: ni2 hang2la4la3 jiu1 ze2ga3 la, qi2mo1 you nga2 la2 ze2 jie3-ta1.
rows.english: If you were thirsty, why didn't you call over to me?

rows.translation: 清明时节雨纷纷，路上行人欲断魂。
rows.tujia: qing1ming1 si3jie3 me2 ce3 ze3, la4qiu1 luo4die1 bu1ce3 bie4.
rows.english: During the Qingming Festival the rain falls, Passers-by are bowed down with sadness.

rows.translation: 借问酒家何处去，牧童遥指杏花村。
rows.tujia: re2 tu2 luo4die1 kei2-bo3 zu2, wu2 ka4 luo4bi3 a2re1 xing2hua1cun1 xie2.
rows.english: Where are the people who serve wine? "Xinghua Village," the young cowherd replies.

rows.translation: 我们都是土家族，谁说汉语我就想笑；我说一句中间话，谁说汉语就像乞丐。
rows.tujia: ang2ni1 da4ha3 bi2zi1ka3, a4se3 pa1 li3 nga2 nie4-ca2; nga2 guo2 zong1gang1 la2 ze2 li3, a4se3 pa1 li3 pa1 kuo3ha3.
rows.english: We are all Tujia, if anyone speaks Chinese I want to laugh; I say something as a middleman, someone who speaks Chinese is like a beggar [borrowing a language].

rows.translation: 为人谚：烧柴要空心，做人要忠心。
rows.tujia: ka3 wu2 me3 tong1-duo3, luo4 ri1 me3 zi2-duo3.
rows.english: Unless the heart of a fire is open [to draw in air], wood will not burn; unless your heart is honest you cannot be a man.

rows.translation: 交往谚：你好我也好，一个鸡蛋吃不完。
rows.tujia: ni2 ca2 nga2 ye1 ca2, ra3lie3 la2 bu2 ga2-ji2-da2.
rows.english: If you are good friends, then you will share even your last egg.

rows.translation: 谨慎谚：路走错了可以回头，话说错了难以收回。
rows.tujia: la4 hhi2-duo3-da2 song1kuo1-de1xi3, sa3li3-duo3-da2 song1kuo1-ta1ti1.
rows.english: Wrongly taken steps can be retraced, but wrongly spoken words cannot be recalled.

rows.translation: 祖德谚：前人栽树，后人乘凉。
rows.tujia: pa3pu1 ka3mong3 se1, re4-die1 me2lu1 ye4.
rows.english: The grandfather plants the tree, and his grandchildren benefit from its shade.

rows.translation: 农耕谚：农务年成好，地里肥莫少。
rows.tujia: jie2ri1 long1 ca2-duo3, pe2ti1 se3 tu2-duo3.
rows.english: He who would see a harvest from his toil must also put manure on his fields.

rows.translation: 天气谚：午盐出汗，明天雨降。
rows.tujia: la2bu1 gu1ce3-zu2, lao2zi1 me2ze3-hu3.
rows.english: When salt weeps, rain is on the way.

rows.translation: 细心谚：说话时想一想，坐下时吹一下。
rows.tujia: sa3li3-hu3 die2-li1la1di3, ong3-bo3-hu3 mie2-li1la1di3.
rows.english: Think before you speak; and blow your seat clean before you sit on it.

rows.translation: 哲理谚：人饿了不怕丑，鸡饿了不怕人。
rows.tujia: luo4 li2a4 ru1ga3-da2, ra3 li2a4 luo4 ge4-ta1.
rows.english: A hungry man will do anything for food; a hungry chicken will not avoid people.

rows.translation: 乞丐背不起东西--自讨的。
rows.tujia: kuo3ha3 ye3 wo4-hi1ce1: guo2duo3 guo2-bo3-xi2.
rows.english: A beggar unable to shoulder the fruits of his begging - just deserts.

rows.translation: 脚底板擦油--开溜。
rows.tujia: ji3la1pi3 se3si2 za4: ra2-lu3.
rows.english: Oiling the soles of your feet - slipping off quietly.

rows.translation: 野猫看鸡--不怀好意。
rows.tujia: zuo2ku1, guo2 ra3 ba4: me3 cai2 tai2.
rows.english: A wildcat eyeing a chicken - bad intentions.

rows.translation: 老鼠上秤勾--自称。
rows.tujia: re3 qi4 ga3 gu3: guo2duo3 qi4.
rows.english: A rat on a steelyard - measuring oneself.

rows.translation: 躲在树后打松鼠--幕后作鬼。
rows.tujia: ka3mong3 ta1nie1 ye4-bo3 ze4ga3 ha3: ta1nie1 ye4-bo3 a1ye3 ri1.
rows.english: Hiding behind a tree to catch squirrels - making trouble behind the scenes.

rows.translation: 用鸡蛋打石头（以卵击石）。

title: 如何制造咚咚喹
documentTitle: 程序性文本: 如何制造咚咚喹

sections.description: （播放整段）程序性文本: 如何制造咚咚喹
sections.meta:
龙山县靛房镇彭武根先生
记录日期 20 七月 2002

rows.translation: 做一把笛子，小孩们好玩啊！我做笛子你们看着，去砍一根竹子来吧！
rows.tujia: dong3dong3kui1 la2 pa1 ri1 o, ang ge3ci2 ca2, bai1die1 o! dong3dong3kui1 ri1, se2 ba4-bo3, mu4nie3 la2 zi2 ta4-xie2 la!
rows.english: Making a dongdongkui flute, that's fun, children! To make a dongdongkui flute, you watch, first cut a piece of bamboo and bring it here!

rows.translation: 不要（一种竹子），不要（一种竹子），不要（一种竹子）。（一种竹子）最好了,（一种竹子）的顶部很合适，那个就筷子那么小。
rows.tujia: mu4nie3 bang1zu1 ta3hong2, lang3zu1 ta3hong2, sang1zu1 ta3hong2, sui1zu3 zui2 sang2jing1 le, sui1zu3 dian1dian1 ngang3huo1, ai1di1 bu1zi1 he2kui1.
rows.english: 'Bangzu' and 'Langzu' bamboo are no good, nor is 'Sangzu' bamboo. 'Suizu' bamboo is the best, the top part of 'Suizu' bamboo is suitable, just the width of a chopstick.

rows.translation: 去砍这一种，然后做笛子呢，声音又好，又响亮，它的声音，字音又吐得好。
rows.tujia: eng1di1 yi2 hao1 ta4-xie2, ai1lie1 dong3dong3kui1 ri1 eng, a2re1 you2 ca2, you2 xian1lian2, guo2-nie3 a2re1 zi2ying1 you2 tu4-xi2 ca2.
rows.english: Cut a piece of that and bring it here, then we can make a dongdongkui flute, with a fine, clear note, producing a fine quality sound.

rows.translation: 你们看着我做，看着哦。在此之前，把这个竹子的树枝剃了。一节一节剃了呢，你讲，你认为这个竹子哪一节好一些，你就雕哪一节。
rows.tujia: se2 ba4-bo3 nga2 ri1 mang, ba4-bo3 o. xian1kui1xian1lie1 le, mu4nie3 le, eng1di1 a2jie1 ti1-lie3, yi2 ting1 yi2 ting1 le ti1-lie3, ni2 jian1 kei2, ni2 reng2wei3 eng1di1 mu4nie3 kei2 yi2 jie1 ca2-nie1, ni2 jiu1 kei2 yi2 jie1 diao1.
rows.english: You look at what I'm doing, look carefully. I've already stripped off the outer bark, pared it off section by section. You tell me, which section of bamboo do you think is best, then we'll carve that one.

rows.translation: 我认为这一节很美丽，又顺坦，又光滑，头尾又全是一样大，那我就搞这一节了。
rows.tujia: nga2 reng2wei3 eng1 yi2 jie1 re4-xi3tai2, you2 sun2tang1, you2 bi3lian1li2, you2 tu3 wei3 a yi2si1 da4ze3 ci4, ai1 nga2 jiu1 eng1 yi2 jie1 gao1 o.
rows.english: I think this section is just perfect, smooth and shiny, both ends equally large, so we'll use this section to make the flute.

rows.translation: 你看着我用这个做，这一节，一节，用这一节开始做。哼！其他的不好，这一节弯的，这一节合适，这个不瘦不肥。
rows.tujia: ni2 ba4-bo3 nga2 eng1 huo3lie3 ri1, eng1 yi2 jie1, yi2 jie1, eng1 yi2 jie1 huo3lie3 gao1-hu3. eng qi3ta1di1 ca1huo4, eng1 yi2 jie1 wan1-ga1ca3, eng1 yi2 jie1 ngang3huo1, eng1di1 bu2 wai1 bu2 hui3.
rows.english: You watch how I make it from this, this section, this section, I will make it with this section. Hmm! The others are no good, that section is curved, but this one is suitable, neither too thick nor too thin.

rows.translation: 你用这个做，把这个折下来，这个美丽，这边不要。这个就是尾部，用这边的这个竹子的尾部。
rows.tujia: ni2 eng1di1 huo3lie3 gao1 ang, eng1di1 kuo1, eng1di1 re4, ge3la1bi1 ta3hong2, eng1di1 jiu1 si1 lie3pong2, ge3la1bi1-nie3 eng1di1 mu4nie3 lie3pong2 huo3lie3.
rows.english: You make it from this one, break it here, this is beautiful, this part we don't need. This then is the lower end, we'll make this end of the bamboo the lower end.

rows.translation: 这个要做笛子的头部，这个首先把那个整整齐齐地一切。那个结合处呢，你把它削一下，削一下，你要用刀子，刀子要锋利。
rows.tujia: eng1di1 dong3dong3kui1 kuo1ba1 ri1-duo3, eng1di1 sou1xian1 ai1di1 zeng1zeng1qi3qi3 mo3 yi2 suo4. ai1di1 ting2ting1 le, ni2 guo2 xie4-li1 xie4-li1, ni2 guo2 su1ku1 huo3lie3, su1ku1 xi4-duo3,
rows.english: We have to make the mouthpiece for the flute, first of all I'm slicing here to tidy it up. This joint, you pare it away a bit, pare it away, you use a firewood knife, which must be sharp,

rows.translation: 要锋利，锋利了，锋利了，用锋利的，（削声），要削完，你要有条理地把它削完，削完呢，削得平衡的。
rows.tujia: xi4-duo3, xi4-lie3 xi4-lie3 mo3, [xi4-nie3-xi2] huo3lie3... sai3 sai3 mo3 xie4-ji2-lie3, ni2 la1bai1la1bai1 xie4-ji2-lie3-duo3, xie4-lie3 le, xie4 mo3 ping3heng3 la le.
rows.english: must be sharp, sharp, use one which is sharp ... (sound of paring) ... that's done. You must pare it down systematically, when you've done it, it will be pared equally all round.

rows.translation: 厚的外壳不要，薄薄的，这样薄薄地削。
rows.tujia: hou2-nie3 kuo2kuo1 le ta3hong2, bo2bo1-di sa3sai1 sa3sai1 mo3 hang2 xie4-xie2.
rows.english: A thick outer surface is no good, pare it thin, thinly.

rows.translation: 你削了，然后你就要在舌簧上面沾口水。要沾口水，口水这样一沾，口水一沾。然后，竹子是很软的，否则竹子太硬了，就不能做，不说话（吹不响）。
rows.tujia: ni2 xie4-lie3, ai1lie1 ni2 jiu1 tian3ge3 ca3bi1ce3 ci4-duo3, ca3bi1ce3 ci4-duo3, ca3bi1ce3 hang2nie3 yi2 ci4, ca3bi1ce3 yi2 ci4, ai1lie1 guo2 mu4nie3 si1 be3bei1 hang, ai1ta1 guo2 mu4nie3 ki4 heng4-liao3 la, gao1-ya1ti1 la, sa3li3-ta1 la.
rows.english: When you've pared it, you have to moisten the reed with saliva, moisten it with saliva, moisten it with saliva like this, moisten it with saliva. Then, the bamboo will be pliable, otherwise the bamboo will be too rigid, you can't work it, and it won't make a noise.

rows.translation: 切这个舌簧的时候，你们别说话（要专心），说话舌簧就会破，听到了没有？孩子们，你们听到了没有？别说话，我开始切舌簧。
rows.tujia: ai, eng1di1 yi2la1qi1, yi2la1qi1 suo4-nie3 si3jie3, se2 jiu1 sa3 ta4 li3, sa3li3-lie3 si1 yi2la1qi1 pi3 la, xi4 huo1 xi4-da2? bo1li3-die1, se2 xi4 huo1 xi4-da2? sa3 ta4 li3, nga2 yi2la1qi1 suo4-hu3.
rows.english: The reed, when you are cutting the reed, all of you, be quiet, if you speak I will damage the reed, are you listening? Children, are you listening to me? Be quiet, I'm about to cut the reed.

rows.translation: 我开始切，你们别说话，用舌头暖和一下。（吹声），这么一下，然后就用菜刀，用柴刀切，（刀声）。耐烦耐烦地（慢慢地）切，切比较匀，别乱用力气啊！
rows.tujia: nga2 le suo4, kai1si4! se2 sa3 ta4 li3 o, yi2la1 huo3lie3 huo3lie3 luo4-li1la1di3, ha3... hang2 la2 dong2, ai1lie1 jiu1 tuo3tuo3 huo3lie3, su1ku1 huo3lie3 suo4 sa3... lai2huan1 lai2huan1 suo4, suo4 le yun3 lian1di3lang1, xie1qi1 le luan2 ta4 si4 la!
rows.english: I'm starting to cut it! All of you, keep quiet, I'm warming it a bit with my tongue, (sound of blowing), like that, now I use a vegetable knife, a chopper to cut it (sound of knife). Slowly, slowly does it, I'm cutting it nice and evenly, don't use too much force!

rows.translation: 推得重了呢，它就会破，推得轻了呢，刀子就不会走路（前进），柴刀，（刀声），越慢越好，越快越不行，越慢越好。慢一下，好好地，好好地剖开得到（好的舌簧），好好地剖开得到。
rows.tujia: si3-xi2 zong2-liao3 le guo2 you2 pi3 si3-xi2, qing1-liao3 le guo2 you2 la4 hhi2-ta1, su1ku1 eng si3... ye2 mang2 ye2 ca2, ye2 kuai2 ye2 bu2xing3, ye2 mang2 ye2 ca2, mang2-li1lian1di3, cai3mo1 cai3mo1 lao4 ha2 ti3 o, cai3mo1 lao4 ha2 ti3 o,
rows.english: If you push too hard, you will break it. If you push too softly, the knife won't be able to cut. The firewood knife, (sound of knife), the slower the better, the faster you do it the worse it will be, the slower the better, a bit slower, carefully, carefully cut the reed free, carefully cut it free.

rows.translation: 别搞坏了，好好地剖开得到，别搞坏了，我很难搞，我急用我就要，我要吹。我悄悄地看一下，好！舌簧切好了，切好了。
rows.tujia: ta4 gao1-si3, cai3mo1 lao4 ha2 ti3, ta4 gao1-si3, nga2 gao1 kuo1ki1, nga2 ji2yong1, nga2 jiu1 di4, nga2 cui1-duo3. nga2 ka3ki1 la1 ba4, hao4! yi2la1qi1 suo4 ti3-liao3, suo4 ti3-liao3.
rows.english: Don't mess things up, carefully cut it free, don't mess it up, it's really difficult, I need to have [the flute] quickly, I want to blow it. I give it a silent look over, fine! The reed is cut correctly, cut correctly.

rows.translation: 然后你就把舌头扔了（即不管它，做别的），要用刀子薄薄地刮。（刀声）...好了没有？我又用手指甲掐着看一下。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 ni2 jiu1 yi2la1qi1 la2-liao3, su1ku1 huo3lie3 sa3sai1 sa3sai1 gua2-duo3, sai3... cai3... ya2-hao1 tai2? nga2 you2 jie2mi1ti3 huo3lie3, jie2mi1ti3kuo2ta1 ku2su1 mo3 ba4-duo3,
rows.english: Now you cut away the [excess thickness of the] reed, you need to use the knife to scrape it thin. (sound of knife) Is that better? I need to use my finger, my fingernail, to pinch it and see what it's like.

rows.translation: （掐声）光滑了，还要搞一下，轻轻地削几下。（刀声）...搓一下，搓一下，全（吹声），全（吹声），（吹声），搓一下，搓一下，（吹声）。
rows.tujia: ka3tai3, you3guan3ga1-liao3, ai1 la2 dong2 gao1-duo3-nie2, mo3-li1 mo3-li1 mo3, mo3-li1 mo3-li1 mo3. si3... yi2 rua3, yi2 rua3, yi2si1 ha3, yi2si1 ha3, ha3, yi2 rua3, yi2 rua3 ha3...
rows.english: (sound of pinching) It's smooth, but it needs a bit more work, pare it down it a little, little by little by little. (sound of knife) Rub it a bit, rub it a bit, blow on it, blow on it, rub it a bit, rub it a bit. (sound of blowing)

rows.translation: 吹着看一下，还硬，不能做，还是硬。嘿！还硬，削一点说话的舌簧，舌簧削一点，（刀声），舌簧削一点。
rows.tujia: hang cui1 mo3 lao4 ba4 ba4, ki4, ri1-ti2, ki4-bo3-la1-nie2. ai! ki4-bo3-la1-nie2, li3-xi2 yi2la1 qian2 mo3, yi2la1 qian2 mo3 si3 si3, mo3, mo3,
rows.english: I'll blow the flute a bit to see what it's like. It's still hard, it doesn't work, it's still too hard. It's still too hard, we need to pare the reed down a bit more to make it sound good, pare the reed down (sound of knife), pare it,

rows.translation: 削了，很薄，像纸一样薄，越削越气息很软了。越削越气息软软的，很好吹，声音好听，又大，字音吐得又好。（刀声）好！（吹声）吹一下看看。
rows.tujia: mo3-lie3 eng, bao3hui1hui1, zi1zang1zi1bo3, ye2 mo3 ye2 si2si1 be3bei1, ye2 mo3 ye2 si2si1 be3bei1 be3bei1, cui1 ca2-xi3tai2, sa3 ru3 ca2, a2re1 you2 ci4, zi2ying1 tu4-xi2 you2 ca2. si3 si3 hao4 ha3.. la1 cui1 ba4 ba4,
rows.english: pare it, now it's very thin, paper-thin, the more we pare it down the softer its note, the more we pare it down the softer the note. It's easy to blow now, it sounds good, it's loud and clear. (sound of knife) OK! (sound of blowing) Let's blow it and see.

rows.translation: （刀声）（笛子声），声音很尖，很好！嘿！声音很尖，很好！嘿！很好！嘿！声音最好了。这一把声音最好，很尖，它又听话。
rows.tujia: si3 dong3... a2re1 jian1 lie3 jian1, sang2jing1! ai! ong a2re1 jian1 lie3 jian1, sang2jing1! ai! ong sang2jing1! ai! hai a2re1 zui2 ca2-lie3, eng1 a la2 pa1 a2re1 zui2 ca2 le, jian1 lie3 jian1, guo2 you2 sa3 ru3 ca2.
rows.english: (sound of knife) (sound of flute) It sounds really crisp. Excellent! Hey! The sound is very crisp, that's great, excellent, really good. This sound is very good, very crisp, it plays well.

rows.translation: 这个用钱都没有地方可以买到，要给谁我都舍不得。我那个笛子很难办，汗水（流水声）都出来了，不好办。
rows.tujia: eng1di1 die3 tong3qian3 huo3lie3-duo3 pu1-zuo3 tai2, a4se3 bo3, a4se3 bo3 lie2-duo3 nga2 se1bu1die3, nga2 ai1di1 die3 bang2 kuo1ki1 le, gu1ce3 hao3 dong2 zu2-liao3 a, bang2 ca2-da2 ming.
rows.english: Money can't buy you one like this, not anywhere, to whom, to whom shall I give it, I'm reluctant to give it away. Making that [flute] was very hard, I'm covered in sweat, that's not good.

rows.translation: 我感到累了，虽然只是做那么小的笛子，但是不容易。没有手艺，谁都办不好。这是事实，做笛子，又是细工夫，又不是粗工夫。
rows.tujia: nga2 ai1di1 die3 lao1huo4-liao3 la, sui1rang3 si1 dong3dong3kui1 he2kui1-lang2 bang2, bu2 rong3yi2, sou1jiao3 tai2, a4se3 guo2 duo3 bang2-bu1hao1. ni2 le hong3huan4, ni2 le huan2 ngeng2-di, you2 xi2 gong1hu1, you2 bu2si1 cu3 gong1hu1.
rows.english: I'm tired now, even though it's only a small flute, it's not easy to make, if you don't have the skill, you can't do it properly. It's hard work, hard work, it's fine workmanship, nothing crude.

rows.translation: 然后你捅洞，捅做“敲公鸡”那个游戏的食指按的那个洞。（刀声）从这下面捅洞，那个中间的呢，别那么宽，太宽就不行。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 ni2 dong3ga2 tong1, jie2mi1ti3 tuo4 ni3ga3 ra3ba3 tuo4-nie3 ai1 la2 dong3ga2 tong1. si3 sai3... gai2 ba3ti3-lie1 dong3ga2 suo4, ai1 zong1gang1-nie3 le hang2 ta4 kuan1, kong1, kong1-liao3 bu2xing3.
rows.english: Then you need to make the finger-holes, to poke the hole covered by the finger that we use for the 'knock the cockerel' game. (sound of knife) We cut the hole from below, the one in the middle, not too wide, if it's too wide it won't work.

rows.translation: 它不能吐字，洞大了不行，小了不行，也要合适，就一起合适了，洞一捅，捅了。
rows.tujia: guo2 zi2 you2 tu4 mo3 hhi2-ti2, dong3ga2 ci4-liao3 bu2xing3, suan4-liao3 bu2xing3, ye1 ngang3huo1-duo3, jiu1 da4 ngang3huo1-liao3, dong3ga2 yi2 tong1, tong1-alie3.
rows.english: It won't play a note if the hole is too big, or if it is too small, it needs to be just right, all of them just right, make the hole, done.

rows.translation: 嘿！然后你把它暖和一下，用小棍子（刺声）一刺，（刺声）一雕。雕了，洞好了。
rows.tujia: ai! ai1lie1 ni2 guo2 yi2 luo4, ka3zu3 bi2 huo3lie3 ka3cei3 die3 yi2 he4, ka3cei3 die3 yi2 diao1, diao1-le dong3ga2, dong3ga2 ca2-liao3.
rows.english: Then you warm it a bit, and use a small stick to puncture it (sound of puncturing) and carve it out, done, the hole's made.

rows.translation: 又捅第二个洞，那个洞又（刀声）一切，这个又（刀声）一切。切了，你又把它一雕，雕了，洞又搞好了。
rows.tujia: di2ai2 guo2 ngang3ngang3 dong3ga2 you2 tong1, ai1 dong3ga2 you2 si3 sai3 si3 sai3 la2 suo4, ge3 you2 si3 sai3 si3 sai3 la2 suo4 ang, suo4-le, you2 ni2 guo2 yi2 diao1, diao1-le you2 dong3ga2, you2 gao1-hao1-liao3.
rows.english: Now we poke the second finger-hole, we cut this one (sound of knife), we cut this one too (sound of knife), done, you carve this one out too, carve it out, and there's your hole.

rows.translation: 第三个洞，第三个洞，第三个洞，第三个洞，你又捅第三个洞。（刀声）一切，又（刀声）一切，切了，又一雕，雕了，搞好了。
rows.tujia: di2sang1 guo2 ngang3ngang3, di2sang1 dong3ga2, di2suo1 dong2, di2suo1 dong2, dong3ga2 suo1 dong2, ni2 you2 tong1, sai3 die3 yi2 suo4, you2 sai3 die3 yi2 suo4, suo4-lie3 you2 yi2 diao1, diao1-alie3 gao1-hao1-liao3 ang.
rows.english: The third hole, the third hole, the third one, the third one, the third one, you also poke through, (sound of knife), and cut it (sound of knife), cut it and then carve it, carve it. There you are.

rows.translation: 这边呢，你把半边缺口（削声）要这样搞，半边缺口，一边长，一边短（就不行）。
rows.tujia: ge3la1bi1 le, ni2 guo2 bang2bian1 ha1pa3 sai3 die3 huo2 gao1-bo3-duo3, bang2bian1 ha1pa3, yi2 bian1 hhe3-nie1, yi2 bian1 zong4-nie1.
rows.english: This side, you need to use the knife to tidy up this half, and this half, not too long, not too short.

rows.translation: 然后就是到关键时刻，怎么搞呢？你把一条小竹子折断，折断以后，你要把竹子中间的东西取出来。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 jiu1 guan1jian1 si3ke3, qing3mo1 gao1 le? ni2 guo2 mu4nie3 jie2zuo4bi3 lao4 kuo1, kuo1 le ni2 guo2 bo3 se3 a3-duo3,
rows.english: Then comes the crucial moment, does it work? You break off a small piece of bamboo, and you use it to clear out the pith,

rows.translation: 你不把竹子的木髓取出来，你的笛子再做得好都不会响的。你再做得好，它声音也不会好，声音叫不下去。
rows.tujia: ni2 mu4nie3 se3 a3-ta1 ya, ni2 dong3dong3kui1, ni2 zai2 ni2 bang2-bo3-xi2 re4 duo3 guo2 mo2hu1-ta1, zai2 ni2 gao1-bo3-xi2 ca2, guo2 si1 a2re1 ca1huo4, a2re1 mo2hu1 mo3 da3-i-ti2,
rows.english: if you don't clear out the pith, your flute, even if everything else is right, it won't play. Even if everything else is ok, its sound will be poor and it won't play properly,

rows.translation: 它为什么不能叫出来？因为它里面的东西堵塞了，它不能呼吸。里面堵住了怎么叫呢？所以你必须把它肚子里面的木髓捅出去。
rows.tujia: guo2 qing3mo1 mo2hu1 mo3 da3-i-ti2? ying1wei3 guo2 se3 ying2zi1 ga3 wo2tu1 song3-liao3 mang, guo2 si2si1 a3-ti2, wo2, qing3mo1 mo2hu1-i le? suo1yi1 ni2 bi2xi1 guo2 ai1 wo2tu1-nie3, me3gu3 wo2tu1-nie3 se3 tong1-alie3-duo3,
rows.english: why won't it play properly? Because inside it's all blocked up with pith, and it can't breathe. [If it's blocked] inside, how can it play? So you must poke out the pith from the inside of the bore,

rows.translation: 掏完了，掏完了。它里面的木髓没有堵了，你可以随便搞。它就说话，它好呼吸。
rows.tujia: gu1zu4-ji2-lie3, gu1zu4-ji2-lie3, guo2 se3 wo2tu1 song3-bo3-dao2, ni2duo3 die2 mo3 gao1, guo2 jiu1 sa3 zu2, guo2 si2si1 a3 ca2 mang.
rows.english: get it out completely, all out. Now there's no pith blocking it, you can do as you please, now it will sound, now it can draw breath.

rows.translation: 它不能呼吸，它不能呼吸，它怎么可以唱一句呢？它不能唱。这个唱一句呀！它不能唱，这个歌唱一下，不能唱。
rows.tujia: guo2 si2si1 a3-ti2, ni2 guo2 si2si1 a3-ti2, ni2 guo2 qing3mo1 ai1 la2 ze2 cang2 a, guo2 cang2-ya1ti1; gai3di1 la2 dong2 cang2 ya, cang2-ya1ti1; guo2 gai2 la2 dong2 cang2 ya, cang2-ya1ti1;
rows.english: If it can't breathe, if it can't breathe, how can you play it? You can't play it; let's play a tune! It can't play this, this tune, it can't play.

rows.translation: 它就被里面的东西堵了，现在没有舌头了，堵死了。所以你要把它肚子里面的这个东西，这个东西，要全部掏出去。
rows.tujia: guo2 jiu1 long1se3 wo2tu1-lie1 song3-liao3, yi2la1qi1 tao2, song3-si3-liao3, suo1yi1 ni2 guo2 ai1di1 me3gu3 wo2tu1-nie3 eng1di1 se3, eng1di1 se3 yi2ha1lie1 a3-lie3-duo3.
rows.english: If it gets blocked by phlegm, the reed will gum up, and it will seize up. Therefore, you must completely remove the pith from inside the bore.

rows.translation: 这个是很重要的，一点都不留地掏出来，掏完了，然后这一把笛子呢！嘿！外表很好看！打扮得最好了！
rows.tujia: eng1di1 si1 dang1jing1, dian2 tai2 mo3 zu2-ji2-lie3, gu1zu4-ji2-liao3, ai1lie1 dong3dong3kui1 la2 pa1 le! ai, re4-xi3la1tai2! xiao1huo3zi da1bang2-bo3-xi2 zui2 ca2-liao3!
rows.english: This is very important, you must get every last bit out, every bit out, then what a flute you have!

rows.translation: 嘿，人家啊，人家，给爱笛子的人，他们就会把你的咚咚喹爱到流口水！嘿！给我吧。那就不能给，我做累了。给你，那不能给，大家玩得再好都不能给你。
rows.tujia: ai luo4die1 a, luo4die1, a2ci1-nie3 luo4die1 bo3 lie2 meng guo2 ni2-nie3 a2ci1 le ce3si3 ye4! hei! nga2 bo3 lie2-gu2, ai1 jiu1 lie2-ti2, nga2 bang2 mo3 lao1huo4-liao3; ni2 lie2-gu2, ai1 lie2-ti2, lie2-ti2, zai2 da4 da4 bo3 ca2 le.
rows.english: Beautiful! The outside looks beautiful! People, people, give it to someone who likes such flutes, the others will drool over it! Give it to me now. I won't give you that, I'm tired out. Give it to me now, that one I'm not giving away, not even to good friends.

rows.translation: 哼！大家一起玩得再好，不给，我吹一下看看。哼！一吹了很好！好家伙！很好，很好，就是这样。
rows.tujia: eng! zai2 da4, da4 bo3 ca2 ya, lie2-ta1 mang, nga2 cui1 ya ba4, ang! yi2 cui1-le sang2jing1 a! hao4 jia1huo1! ei! sang2jing1, sang2jing1! jiu1 hang2la3.
rows.english: It's better to play it together, I'm not giving it away, let me play it, it sounds great! Good friends! Excellent, excellent, indeed it is.

title: 土家族过年的传统风俗
documentTitle: 程序性文本: 土家族过年的传统风俗

sections.description: （播放整段）程序性文本: 土家族过年的传统风俗
sections.meta:
龙山县他砂乡鲁邦珍先生
记录日期 27 一月 2003

rows.translation: 腊月二十三日快要过小年了，家里不能纺棉花了，南瓜都要给猪。
rows.tujia: la2ye1 nie1 hi2 suo1 nie1 ci1 bi2 ka1-hu3, cu1 mian3hua3 za2-ta1tiu1, la2tu1 zi4 bo3 lie2-ji2-lie3-duo3.
rows.english: 'Little New Year' starts on the twenty-third of the last [lunar] month; we can't spin any more cotton at home, and all the gourds must be fed to the pigs.

rows.translation: 过小年的日子，过了小年，（也就是指）从小年那天天亮开始，晚上要烧香。还没烧香之前呢，要打锣，（锣声）。
rows.tujia: ci1 bi2 ka1 nie4, ci1 bi2 ka1-liao3, ka1 nie4 me2su3-lie1, lang3qi1-cai3 xian1 wu2-duo3, xian1 wu2-da2-nie2 zi1ge1 le qing2 ha3-duo3 tang3 tang3 tang3 tang3.
rows.english: On the day of the 'Little New Year', on that day, from daybreak on that day, every evening incense must be burnt. Before burning incense, we have to strike the gongs. (sound of gong being struck)

rows.translation: 然后就要烧香，烧香要烧到哪个时候呢？要到开年正月十五日那天。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 jiu1 xian1 wu2-duo3, wu2 mo3 kei3 ye4-duo3 le? kai1nian3-lie1 zeng1ye1 la2 hi2 ong1 nie1, la2 hi2 ong1 bu2 ao1 ye4-duo3.
rows.english: Then we have to burn incense; how long do we need to burn it for? Until the fifteenth, the fifteenth of the first [lunar] month.

rows.translation: 过了小年呢，大人、男孩们、男人们、妇女们，全部要说好话，不能说不吉利的话。
rows.tujia: ci1 bi2 ka1-liao3 le, luo4ci1ba1, luo4bi3-die1, guo1guo1-ma1, a2da1-ma1, yi2si1 sa3 cai2 li3-duo3, die2ka1la1 li3-ta1ti1.
rows.english: After celebrating 'Little New Year', grown-ups, children, young men, young women, everyone must speak wholesome words, they mustn't say anything bad.

rows.translation: 腊月，腊月，腊月二十九日的时候，快过大年，过大年的时候，过大年的那时，快过大年了，灯笼要挂完，
rows.tujia: la2ye1, la2ye1, nie1 bu2 la2ye1, nie1 bu2 ge1 bu2 si3jie3, ci1 tie2ba1 ka1-hu3, ci1 tie2ba1 ka1-nie3 si3jie3, ci1 tie2ba1 ka1-nie3 ai1 si3, ci1 tie2ba1 ka1-hu3, deng1long3 gua2-ji2-duo3,
rows.english: The last month, the last month, on the twenty-ninth of the last month, New Year is celebrated, when New Year is celebrated, when New Year is celebrated, when New Year is about to be celebrated, we must finish hanging up lanterns,

rows.translation: 圆灯走廊那里也要挂，桌子前上方；猪脚要摆在桌子上面。要摆着一个大糍粑，要烧像手指那么大的长香。
rows.tujia: yan3deng3, pa2qie1-ta3 be2 deng1long3 gua2-duo3, ka1tao1 si3tie2 zi1ge1, si3tie2 ka1tao1 zi4ji3pa3 bai4-bo3-duo3, ba1ba1-ni3ga3 bai4-bo3-duo3, cang3xian3 tie2ba1 jie2mi1ti3 he2ba3 xie2 wu2-duo3,
rows.english: round lanterns, we must hang lanterns by the walkways, and in front of the table. We must put pig's trotters on the table, and a large 'baba' glutinous rice cake, as well as burning a large incense stick as thick as a finger.

rows.translation: 神龛上面要供两块糖馓，要靠着神龛。要点两根蜡烛，两根蜡烛中间前面一点要点着神灯。
rows.tujia: sa1mi1 nie1 ci3 seng3kang3 ga3 gong2-bo3-duo3, hong2-bo3-duo3, la2zu1 nie1 zi2 ti2-bo3-duo3, la2zu1 nie1 zong1gang1 zi1ge1-cai3, seng3deng3 ti2-bo3-duo3.
rows.english: We must put two 'tangsa' crisped rice cakes on the shrine, lean them against the shrine, and light two candles, and a lamp at the front between the two candles.

rows.translation: 那一夜呢，家里就要敲大锣，一个锣，一个鼓。老人家们懂事的就会这样敲，（鼓声），
rows.tujia: ai1 la2 pe1 le, cu1 jiu1 ci4 luo2 tuo4-duo3, luo2 la2 da2, he3 la2 bu2, lao4reng3ga3-die1 sa3 hao4ri3-ma1 jiu1 dong1 dang3 dang3 dong1,
rows.english: That night, we must strike a large gong in the house, a gong and a drum. Old folk who know how to must strike them, (sound of drums)

rows.translation: 要这样打。点了灯呢，灯你就吹，你就不能吹，它自己要熄。儿童们呢，大人们呢，全部要坐在家里守着年。
rows.tujia: huo2 ha3-duo3. tie4tie3 ti2-lie3 le, tie4tie3 ni2 guo2 jiu1 mie2, ni2 guo2 jiu1 mie2-ta1ti1, guo2duo3 mo3 xi2-duo3. bo1li3-die1 le, luo4ci1ba1-die1 le, yi2si1 cu1 ong3, ci1 ka4-bo3-duo3.
rows.english: just like that. Once the lamps are lit, you blow them, you musn't blow them out, but must let them burn themselves out. Children and adults must all sit together at home to see the New Year in.

rows.translation: 孩子们快睡了呢，要去挖银子。搞到半夜了呢，大人们全部一起开始挖银子。
rows.tujia: bo1li3-die1 nie2-hu3 le, ngo4-ti1ke1 di3-i-duo3, gao1 mo3, bang2ye1 ye4-liao3 le, luo4ci1ba1-die1 yi2si1 da4 ngo4-ti1ke1 di3-i-hu3.
rows.english: When the children have gone to bed, we must go and dig for silver, far into the night, all the adults start digging for silver together.

rows.translation: 大年三十日，那么更加隆重一些。然后灯呢，上半夜呢，就对着神龛，下半夜呢，就对着外面。
rows.tujia: suo1 bu2 la2 hi2 ai1me1 ye2geng1 seng2zong2-nie1, ai1lie1 tie4tie3 le, sang2 bang2ye1 le, jiu1 seng3kang3 dui2-bo3, xia2 bang2ye1 le, jiu1 wo4ta3-bo3 dui2-bo3-duo3.
rows.english: On the thirtieth, things are even more splendid. The lamps, for the first half of the night they are set facing the ancestral shrine; for the latter half they must face outwards.

rows.translation: 那一夜呢，就全家，老人家也好，小孩们也好，女儿、妇女们也好，男人们也好，
rows.tujia: ai1 la2 pe1 le jiu1, la1cuo1la1lai1, lao4reng3ga3-die1 ye1 hao4, bo1li3-die1 ye1 hao4, biu2 a2da1-ma1-die1 ye1 hao4, guo1guo1-ma1-die1 ye1 ca2,
rows.english: That night, the whole household, whether they are old people, children, young girls, young women, or young men,

rows.translation: 全部一起听着鸡啼，（公鸡啼声），不能动的老人家就（坐在那里）。
rows.tujia: yi2si1 da4 ra3 rong2-xi2 ru3-bo3-duo3, ra3 ga3gi1 die3, bong2long1-ta1ti1-nie3 lao4reng3ga3-die1 jiu1...
rows.english: they must all wait together to hear the cock crow, to hear the cock crow, old people who can no longer move will also sit there ...

rows.translation: 那堂屋呢，就放鞭炮了（鞭炮声）。神灯呢，然后就往外面看了。然后就要舂碓，（舂碓声）。
rows.tujia: ai1 tang3long3 le jiu1 pao2zu1 ra3ra3... po1-liao3, seng3deng3 le, ai1lie1 jiu1 wo4ta3-bo3 ba4-liao3, ai1lie1 jiu1 song2ga1 bu2-i-duo3 kuan3tang3...
rows.english: In the main hall, firecrackers are let off, (sound of firecrackers) and the shrine lamp is turned to face outwards. Then the pounder is put to work. (sound of pounding)

rows.translation: 好！碓舂完了，就要推磨，（推磨声）。搞完了，那全部一起就泡糖馓吃，泡着糖馓吃。
rows.tujia: hao4! song2ga1 bu2-ji2-liao3 le jiu1 bo1zuo1 bo4-duo3, gang3lang3lang3... gao1-ji2-liao3, ai1di1 yi2si1 da4ha3 jiu1 sa1mi1 za1-bo3 ga2, sa1mi1 za1-bo3 ga2.
rows.english: OK! When the pounding is done, we have to turn the grindstone. (sound of grinding) When that's done, everyone soaks 'tangsa' crisped rice cakes in hot water, soaks 'tangsa' and eats them.

rows.translation: 天亮了呢，就要敬菩萨。敬了菩萨呢，然后又一起贴纸。
rows.tujia: me2su3-lie1 le, ai1lie1 you2 pu3sa3 jing2-duo3, pu3sa3 jing2-lie3 le, ai1lie1 you2 da4 ci1ki1ta1 ba1-duo3,
rows.english: At daybreak, we must worship the gods. After worshipping the gods, we paste pieces of paper together

rows.translation: 大门上面一边五张，四个门都要贴完。犁头、耙、打谷盒全部贴完了之后就算了。
rows.tujia: da2meng1 ga3ha2 ao2mian1 ong1 hhi1, si2 la1meng3 jie3-xi2 ba1-ji2-duo3, li2kuo1tong1, pa2, da1dong1, yi2si1 ba1 mo3, ba1-ji2-liao3 zi1hou2 jiu1 suan2liao1.
rows.english: above the main door, five pieces on each side; paper must be pasted on all four doors. Also on the ploughshare, harrow, threshing trough, paper must be pasted on all of them. When that's done, it's finished.

rows.translation: 然后就看日子，要把轭挂在牛上，一直要搞到十五。搞到十五了呢，就把那个墙纸撕掉，自己要找自己的路。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 nie1 ba4-bo3 wu2 ka3 zuo1-duo3, yi2zi1 gao1 mo3 si3 wu1 ye4-duo3, eng, gao1 mo3 si3 wu1 ye4-liao3 le jiu1 ai1 qian3zi3 ci1ca4-ji2-liao3, guo2duo3 guo2duo3 le la4 ni1-duo3.
rows.english: On an auspicious day, we have to put the yoke on the ox, and these activities continue until the fifteenth. And when the fifteenth comes, then we tear down all the paper on the walls, and everyone gets on with his normal work.

title: 如何做糖馓
documentTitle: 程序性文本: 如何做糖馓

sections.description: （播放整段）程序性文本: 如何做糖馓
sections.meta:
龙山县他砂乡彭仕翠女士
记录日期 30 一月 2003

rows.translation: 打糯米，用打米机打，用打米机打了呢，用风车吹一下。吹了呢，然后又用筛子隔一下，隔一下。
rows.tujia: qie1hhe1 ha3, da1mi1ji1 lie3 ha3, da1mi1ji1 lie3 ha3-lie3 le la2 dong2 ce1, ce1-lie3 le, ai1lie1 you2, you2 xie3qi3 lie3 la2 dong2 ge2,
rows.english: You thresh the glutinous rice with a threshing machine. After threshing it with a threshing machine, use a mill to remove the chaff. After removing the chaff, then use a sieve to separate it.

rows.translation: 隔了呢，又最上面的，筛子里面粗的，就用那些，用米头子（留在筛子里的米）做糖馓。
rows.tujia: la2 dong2 ge2-lie3 le you2 pi3-sang1, xie3qi3 cu3ga3la2-nie3 ai1di1 jiu1, ai1 huo3lie3 jiu1, tu3zi3 lie3 jiu1 sang1mi1 ri1-duo3 la.
rows.english: After separating it, the surface, the coarsest stuff left in the sieve, use those grains, use the largest grains to make 'tangsa' crisped rice cakes.

rows.translation: 哼，用那个做得好一些，哼，大颗大颗的，大颗大颗的，那个出的（指炸了之后）比较好一些。
rows.tujia: eng, ai1 huo3lie3 ri1-bo3-xi2 ze3-nie1 hang, leng3kuo3 leng3kuo3, ai1 zu2-bo3-xi2 ya2 ca2-nie1.
rows.english: Hmm, it's best to use those grains, the large ones, the large ones, they come out [after frying] best.

rows.translation: 然后呢，然后洗了就蒸。最好洗三次再蒸，洗完以后又浸一夜，
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 le, ai1lie1 you2 wo1-lie3 me tong4. wo1-lie3 me, you2 lian1 dao2 wo1, lian1 dao2 wo1-lie3 you2 tong4, ai1lie1 la2 pe1 bu4.
rows.english: Next, next, wash the rice and steam it. After washing it, wash it again twice; after washing it twice again, steam it. After washing, then soak it overnight.

rows.translation: 浸了一夜呢，第二天早晨就，然后，太阳像今天一样（即没有太阳），你，没有太阳呢，要早晨洗。看着太阳洗了呢，你就马上临时蒸。
rows.tujia: la2 pe1 bu4-lie3 le, di2ai2 zao4gu1die1 jiu1, ai1lie1 lao3ci3, lai4 da4ze3, ni2, lao3ci3-da2 me zao4gu1die1 wo1-duo3, lao3 me2 ba4-bo3 wo1-lie3 me jiu1, ni2 geng1dao1 leng3si3 tong4.
rows.english: After soaking overnight, the next morning, if it isn't sunny like today, you, if it's not sunny you must wash it that morning, if it's sunny you wash it and then steam it straight away without soaking.

rows.translation: （浸了）一天就蒸，就熟了，几个人一起就赶快做。
rows.tujia: yi2 guo2 dui2si3 (null)-lie3 jiu1, tong4-lie3 jiu1 a1jie1-liao3, jiu1 gang1kuai2 ri1, ga4 hhi3 da4ha3,
rows.english: After soaking for some time, then steam it. When it's cooked, then a few of you together, quickly make the cakes.

rows.translation: 然后就做完了呢，就晒着，你就不用管了。你那然后呢，就干了，要翻过来，就翻一下。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 jiu1 ri1-ji2-liao3 me jiu1, lang3lang2-bo3 me jiu1, ni2 guan1-ta1-duo3, ang ni2 ai1, ai1lie1 jiu1 me, ni2 jiu1 ga3-liao3 me huan4-duo3-hu3 jiu1 la2 dong2 huan4,
rows.english: When you've finished making them, let them dry in the sun, you can just leave them out. Then when they are dry, turn them over, turn them over.

rows.translation: 翻了呢，像今天一样不能翻，明天就能翻。像明天一样翻了呢，明天晚上就可以收了。
rows.tujia: huan4-liao3 me, lei4 da4ze3 huan4-ti2 me lao2zi1 da4ze3 huan4 ang, lao2zi1 da4ze3 huan4-liao3 me jiu1, jiu1, lang3qi1-cai3 me jiu1 sou1-duo3-hu3 ang.
rows.english: When you've turned them over, if it's like today you can't turn them, turn them tomorrow instead, if it's like tomorrow you can turn them, then in the evening you can bring them in.

rows.translation: 那到了晚上么，可以把它们装着收好，这样的天气在山里也不好，白天把它们晒在有太阳的地方，像这样晚上晒在外面就不好，
rows.tujia: ai1 guo2 lang3qi1-cai3 me, guo2 cu4-bo3 jian1si3-duo3-hu3, eng1di1 qie4 kang3ku1 be2, lao3ci3-ku1 lang3lang2-bo3 me, ni2 gai2 da4ze3 la3ye2 [lang3lang2],
rows.english: So in the evening, you bring them in and store them. Here in the mountains, you can dry them during the day in a sunny place, but you can't leave them out in the evening,

rows.translation: 而且还怕别人偷，所以比收更加麻烦了。都用毛毯子，用那个床单在外面盖着。
rows.tujia: wo4ta3 you2 luo4die1 geng2jia1 ai1di1. mao3tang1zi1 lie3 duo3 ai1di1, ai1di1 ba2dang1 lie3, ai1di1 wo4ta3-lie1 du3-bo3-duo3,
rows.english: as there are a lot of people around [because they may steal it]. You must use a blanket, a bedsheet, to cover them outside.

rows.translation: 盖了呢，一两夜以后，盖了就收在家里。收了呢，忘记说了，做糖撒要用木圈圈。
rows.tujia: du3-lie3 le la2 pe1 nie1 pe1-lie3 jiu1, du3-lie3 jiu1 cu1 jian1si3-duo3-hu3, jian1si3-lie3 le... mu3 qian1qian1 huo3lie3 li3-xi2 you2 si1ma3-liao3.
rows.english: After covering and leaving them outside for a night or two, then bring them in and store them in the house. After storing them, ... I forgot to say that you should use wooden hoops to make it.

rows.translation: 然后就又像这几天一样炸，像这几天一样炸了，那你就用老油（沸油），老了，就是指油要沸。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 jiu1 you2 gai2 ga4 nie1 da4ze3 qi3-nie3-xi2, gai2 ga4 nie1 da4ze3 qi3-lie3 le, ni2 ai1, ni2 jiu1 se3si2, se3si2 lao4 le, lao4-lie3 jiu1, guo2 jiu1 se3si2 pe4-duo3 la,
rows.english: Then just like what we have been doing here these past few days, you fry them, fry them just like these past few days, you need to use [hot] boiled oil, boiled oil, the oil must be boiling hot.

rows.translation: 沸了呢，又糖馓，糖馓赶快放在油里面，放了糖馓，它自己就会（油炸声）得浮出来。
rows.tujia: pe4-lie3 le, you2 sang1mi1, sang1mi1 gang1kuai2 jiu1 ai1 tu1 la2, sang1mi1 la2-lie3, guo2duo3 sao3 die3 zu2-di2-hu3,
rows.english: When it's boiling, put a raw 'tangsa' cake in straight away, put the raw 'tangsa' in, and it will float up to the surface by itself.

rows.translation: 出来了，用漏锅，要转。转了呢，然后它自己，然后它全部出来了。
rows.tujia: sao3 die3 zu2-liao3 le, ai1lie1 jiu1 ni2 eng1di1 lao1su1 huo3lie3, lao1su1 huo3lie3 zuan2-duo3, zuan2-lie3, guo2duo3 ai1lie1, ai1lie1 wan3qian3, guo2duo3 zu2-ji2-diu2 hang,
rows.english: When it's done, then use this strainer, use this strainer, you must stir it, stir it, then it will be done, it will float up by itself.

rows.translation: 出来了呢，然后你就用漏锅捞。捞了呢，又那，然后又熟的，出的，又捞，然后又把生的干的糯米往锅里面放。放了，它又有（油炸声）出来。
rows.tujia: zu2-ji2-liao3 le, ai1lie1 ni2 jiu1 lao1su1 huo3lie3 lu1, lu1-lie3 le, you2 ai1, ai1lie1 you2 a1jie1-bo3-xi2, zu2-bo3-xi2 me you2 lu1-lie3 me jiu1, ai1lie1 you2, you2 a1hong1 zi3ga3, you2 ai1 ta2ku1 wo2tu1 la2, la2-lie3 guo2 you2 sao3 die3 zu2-diu2,
rows.english: When it has floated up, then you use the strainer to drain it. After draining it, then the cake that's cooked, that's floated up, you drain it and then put another raw 'tangsa' cake into the wok. You put it in, it fries and floats up.

rows.translation: 然后它就变成了糖馓，然后就可以吃了，是这样的，然后炸完了。所以油要老，老了它就（油炸声）出来了。
rows.tujia: ai1lie1 jiu1 guo2 jiu1 sang1mi1 zi2-liao3, ai1lie1 jiu1 ga2-duo3-hu3, hang2nie3. ai1lie1 qi3-ji2-liao3. ai1mo3 se3si2 lao4-duo3 mang, lao4-lie3 jiu1, guo2 jiu1 sa3 die3 zu2-diu2 mang.
rows.english: Now it has become 'tangsa', and then you can eat it, it's like this, then it's completely cooked. So you must use old [boiling] oil, old, so that it floats up when it's done.

title: 两篇演说词
documentTitle: 演说: 两篇演说词

sections.description: （播放整段）演说: 两篇演说词
sections.meta:
永顺县大坝乡田心桃女士
记录日期 05 八月 2002

rows.translation: 今天我来到贵州印江，湖南的土家族干部，湖北的土家族干部，重庆的土家族干部，大家都来了。
rows.tujia: nga2 lei4 gui2zou1 ying2jian1 eng3qie2, hu3lang3-nie3 bi2zi1ka3 sa3li3-ma1, hu3be3-nie3 bi2zi1ka3 sa3li3-ma1, cong3qing2-nie3 bi2zi1ka3 sa3li3-ma1, hu2ni1 eng3jiu3.
rows.english: Today, I have come to Yanjiang in Guizhou Province, along with Tujia cadres from Hunan, Hubei, and Chongqing. We're all here.

rows.translation: 我一言，你一语，他一句，说的都是土家族的事。
rows.tujia: nga2 la2 ze2, ni2 la2 ze2, guo2 la2 ze2, yi2xi1 bi2zi1ka3-nie3 sa3 la2 li3.
rows.english: A word from me, one from you, another from him; all that we talk about are Tujia matters.

rows.translation: 要吃饭，要挖土；要吃肉，要养猪；要穿衣，要织麻；要住房，要裁树；
rows.tujia: zi3 ga2-duo3, li4 ga4-duo3; si3 ga2-duo3, zi4 long4-duo3; xi1ba1 da2-duo3, ce3ku1 ce4-duo3; cuo4 ong3-duo3, ka3mong3 se1-duo3;
rows.english: We need to dig the soil so we can have rice to eat; we need to raise pigs so we can have meat to eat; we need to weave hemp, so we can have clothes to wear; we need to plant trees, so we can have homes to live in.

rows.translation: 老头老婆要抱孙子；青年人要干活；小孩们要读书；老师们要好好地教。
rows.tujia: po3pa1-die1, pa2ni1-die1, re4bi2 re4biu2 be4-duo3; luo4ba1-die1, jie2ri1-duo3; qing3nie2-die1, ci1tu1-duo3; po2ga1-die1, cai3mo1 ri1-duo3.
rows.english: Old folk need to look after their grandchildren; young men need to labour; children need to study; teachers need to teach well.

rows.translation: 现在有吃有穿，日子越过越好。今后还要好好干，永远感谢共产党。
rows.tujia: mu2la1, ga2-ci3 xie2, da2-ci3 xie2, la2 nie1 la2 nie1 ka1 ca2 lie3 ka1 ca2. qing3nie2 a4duo3 cai3mo1 ri1-duo3, gong2cang1dang1 ye4-bo3-duo3.
rows.english: Nowadays we have food to eat and clothes to wear, and life is getting better day by day. From now on, we must continue to work hard, forever grateful to the Communist Party.

rows.translation: 我的话讲完了，祝大家好！再见！
rows.tujia: nga2-nie3 sa3 li3-ji2-liao3, hu2ni1 ca2, qing3nie2 yi3!
rows.english: My speech is at an end: I wish you all the best and hope to see you again!

sections.title: 8.1.1: 中国土家族经济文化协作会
sections.meta_en:
Tian Xintao, Daba Township, Yongshun County
recorded on 05 August 2002
sections.description_en: The following two texts are formal introductory speeches made at seminars convened for cadres largely drawn from the Tujia ethnic minority.

sections.meta:
永顺县大坝乡田心桃女士
记录日期 05 八月 2002

rows.translation: 各位领导，各位朋友，各位老师，各位女士，你们好！今天我来到张家界，参加张家界市土家族研究会成立大会。
rows.tujia: ga2me1-die1, zuo4ni3-die1, po2ga1-die1, ma3ma1-die1, se2ni2 ca2! lei4, nga2 zang1jia1jie2 eng3qie2, zang1jia1jie2-nie3 bi2zi1-nie3 sa3li3-nie3 yi2xi1-nie3.
rows.english: Leaders, friends, teachers, ladies: greetings to you all! Today I have come to Zhangjiajie to attend the convention of the Zhangjiajie Tujia Research Society.

rows.translation: 我首先感谢共产党，有了民族政策，土家当家作主人。土家族苗族自治州有了两个；土家族苗族自治县有了九个。
rows.tujia: nga2, da3bie1 gong2cang1dang1 ang2zai1, ming3cu3 zeng2ce3 xiao2, bi2zi1ka3 sa3 za4-la1, bi2zi1ka3 [be2ka3] zi2zi1 zou1 nie1 cuo1 xiao2; bi2zi1ka3, be2ka3 zi2zi1 xian2 ge1 cuo1 xiao2.
rows.english: First I would like to thank the Communist Party. Because of their minorities policy, the Tujia can manage their own affairs. We have two Tujia-Miao autonomous prefectures, and nine Tujia-Miao autonomous counties.

rows.translation: 张家界的人好，张家界的水、菜都特别好吃。
rows.tujia: zang1jia1jie2-nie3 luo4 ca2, zang1jia1jie2-nie3 ce3, ha1ce1 ga2-xi2 ca2.
rows.english: Zhangjiajie folk are very kind; the food here is good to eat and the water is good to drink.

rows.translation: 昨天我们到黄石寨，金鞭岩游览，山林很大，好像长在天上，树林美极了。
rows.tujia: pong3nie2, ang2ni1 huan3si3zai2 jing1bian1qi4 ge3ci2, ka3kuo3 gei1 qi4, me2 ga3ha2 si3-bo3 da4ze3, ka3kuo3 re4-xi3tai2,
rows.english: Yesterday, we went sightseeing at Huangshizhai and Jingbianqi; the trees were huge, reaching towards the skies, and the forest was very beautiful.

rows.translation: 外地到这里来的游客很多，大家都留连忘返。
rows.tujia: wo3ta2 luo4die1 ge3du1 ge3ci2-nie3 luo4 ri3di2ri3ga2, hu2ni1 ge3ci2-lie3 song1kuo1-bo3 xi1ma3 la.
rows.english: Very many tourists come here from other areas, and all of them linger, forgetful of home.

rows.translation: 昨天晚上我们去秀华山馆参观，屋里陈列的雅床、桌子、椅子、衣服、被子都美极了，它们都是土家族人的产品。
rows.tujia: pong3ni2 la3tie2, ang2ni1 xiu2hua3sang1 la1 ba4, cuo4 wo2tu1 po1-bo3-xi2 nie2pong1, xi3tie2, cuo1ke1, xi1ba1, xi1lang1 re4di3re4ga2, ge4 yi2xi1 bi2zi1ka3 luo4die1 ri1-bo3-xi2.
rows.english: Yesterday evening we visited the Xiuhuashan Museum. Inside, beautiful beds, tables, chairs, clothes, and quilts were on display, all the work of Tujia people.

rows.translation: 土家族风情园里的房屋修得很好，木匠李宏进只读过两年书，一年修成一个大寨子一样，他是土家族木匠老大哥。
rows.tujia: bi2zi1ka3 hong1qing3yuan2 cuo4 su2-bo3-xi2 ca2di3ca2ga2, ki2zuo4 li4hong3jing2 nie1 long1 ci1tu1, la2 long1 cuo4 su2-xi2 luo1you1 da4ze3, guo2 bi2zi1ka3-nie3 ki2zuo4 tie2ba1.
rows.english: The Tujia buildings in Hongqingyuan Park were well-constructed. Li Hongjin, a carpenter with only two years of schooling, built the whole village-like complex in just a year; he is truly a great Tujia craftsman.

rows.translation: 现在土家族人有吃有穿，还有娱乐场所，土家族日子越过越好。
rows.tujia: mu2la1, bi2zi1ka3 ga2-ci3 xie2, da2-ci3 xie2, ge3ci2-xi2 be2 xie2, bi2zi1ka3-nie3 luo4 ka1 ca2 lie3 ka1 ca2.
rows.english: Nowadays the Tujia have food to eat and clothes to wear. They can even enjoy leisure activities; life for the Tujia is getting better every day.

rows.translation: 以后大家要好好地干，我还要在党中央领导下好好地干。
rows.tujia: qing3nie2, hu2ni1 da4ha3 cai3mo1 ri1-bo3; nga2 a4duo3 dang1zong1yan1 ling1dao1 xia2 cai3mo1 ri1-duo3.
rows.english: Let us all continue to work hard in days to come; I, too, must continue to work hard under the leadership of the Party.

rows.translation: 我的话说完了，谢谢！谢谢！再见！
rows.tujia: nga2 ni2-nie3 sa3 li3-ji2-liao3, ang2zai1, ang2zai1, qing3nie2 yi3!
rows.english: My words are coming to an end: Thank you! Thank you! Goodbye!
